[INPUT]
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean traditional clinic advertisement poster, vertical A4-style promotional layout for acupuncture, moxibustion, herbal medicine, and pharmacopuncture services.
Editorial healthcare brand poster with a calm, premium, trustworthy oriental-medicine aesthetic for clinic promotion, including realistic clinic information, reservation cues, service details, and printed-poster finishing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main layout: vertical medical poster with a balanced 60/40 split; {한의원명_로고} anchored in the upper-left brand band, {헤드라인} centered in the upper-middle, and {한약_hero} occupying the mid-lower focal area.
- Background treatment: warm beige hanji-inspired paper texture with subtle fiber grain, deep green accent panels, muted gold separators, faint meridian-line diagram overlays, and small botanical line-art details from {디자인_장식}.
- Information density: build a real clinic advertisement with readable headline, service scope, exactly four service boxes, consultation benefit badge, clinic hours, address, phone number, QR reservation block, and a short medical notice.
- Use {진료분야}, {헤드라인}, {한약_hero}, {서비스_박스}, {컬러_팔레트}, {상담_혜택}, {운영시간}, {주소_연락처}, {예약_CTA}, {하단_고지}, and {디자인_장식} as the main variable content.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top brand zone: place {한의원명_로고} as a compact logo/title lockup with Korean primary text and a small English subtitle beneath; add a tiny vertical spine credit on the right edge reading “K-Clinic Wellness Poster / 2026 Spring”.
2. Upper headline zone: set {헤드라인} in a restrained serif-and-sans combination, centered horizontally, with a smaller subline using {진료분야}; add a small date-style label such as “2026 봄 진료 안내” near the headline.
3. Central hero zone: render {한약_hero} as a polished still-life arrangement of herbal packets, porcelain cup, dried medicinal ingredients, brass spoon, folded prescription envelope, and a small acupuncture needle case, lit like a premium editorial product shot.
4. Service grid zone: place {서비스_박스} as exactly four evenly spaced boxed items with icon-like line illustrations; each box should include a short Korean label and a one-line descriptor.
5. Promotion and reservation zone: add {상담_혜택} as a deep-green rounded badge near the service area, then place {예약_CTA} beside a scannable-looking QR code block and a small “네이버 예약 / 전화 상담” micro-label.
6. Footer information zone: include {운영시간} and {주소_연락처} in a structured footer band with thin gold dividers, a small map-pin icon, phone icon, and a brief {하단_고지} line.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for headings, Noto Sans KR Medium for body/service labels, and a refined serif like Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the quoted headline; headline size should feel about 2.5x the service text.
- Color palette: deep green, gold, warm beige, and charcoal from {컬러_팔레트}; use gold for thin rules, small badges, and decorative highlights, while beige and green carry the main poster structure.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px gold rules, subtle 8px blur shadow at 12% opacity under the hero still-life, soft cream service cards, rounded 8px corners, and tactile print-like ink edges.
- Graphic details: include faint herbal specimen labels, small acupuncture-point diagram fragments, paper grain, and refined botanical accents from {디자인_장식} so the poster feels like a realistic printed clinic advertisement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product-photography look, 85mm lens at f/4 for the hero still-life, with crisp object separation and controlled depth of field.
- Lighting: soft diffused key light from upper-left at 45°, slight warm fill from front-right, gentle shadow falloff to preserve a calm clinic atmosphere.
- Color grade: deep green + warm beige + muted gold + charcoal with a slightly desaturated editorial finish, similar to premium Korean wellness brand ads.
- Print finish: matte coated paper impression, subtle ink absorption, realistic poster typography alignment, and premium healthcare brochure polish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium oriental-medicine clinic editorial — calm, trustworthy, refined, and informative, with a high-end Korean wellness brand feel combining herbal apothecary still-life, contemporary clinic advertising, and tactile printed-poster design.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함.
  - {한의원명_로고}
  - {진료분야}
  - {헤드라인}
  - {서비스_박스}
  - {상담_혜택}
  - {운영시간}
  - {주소_연락처}
  - {예약_CTA}
  - {하단_고지}
- Rendered poster copy should include readable Korean micro-text such as “2026 봄 진료 안내”, “네이버 예약”, “전화 상담”, “초진 상담 안내”, “월–금 09:30–19:00”, and “토요일 09:30–14:00”.
- Layout invariants: maintain a strict vertical poster hierarchy; the hero still-life must remain centered, and the service boxes must appear as exactly 4 boxes in a structured grid.
- Keep all Korean characters sharp, natural, and legible with no distortion or broken glyphs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures

studio:prompts3:ours-871.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean dental clinic advertising flyer, A4 vertical social-media/print hybrid. Realistic premium medical promo layout for implant, orthodontics, whitening, and root canal services, with clinic-contact details, consultation information, seasonal campaign labeling, and a polished healthcare advertising finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top-left logo zone: {치과명·로고} placed inside a professional header block, occupying about 12% of the canvas width, paired with small clinic identity text such as “DIGITAL DENTAL CARE” and a compact date label “2026년 5월 상담 안내”.
- Header utility zone: add realistic small print details on the top-right: “예약상담 02-1234-5678”, “서울시 강남구 테헤란로 00”, and “월·수 야간진료”, aligned with the clinic brand system.
- Hero zone: {미소 hero} fills the upper-middle 38–42% of the poster, photographed as a natural dental-ad smile portrait with real skin texture, realistic teeth alignment, soft cheek detail, and a confident but believable expression.
- Headline zone: {헤드라인} centered or slightly upper-right, sized as the primary attention anchor, with crisp Korean typography and supporting subcopy beneath: “임플란트부터 교정까지, 내 치아에 맞춘 상담”.
- Service information zone: {시술 안내} arranged in two balanced comparison cards in the lower-middle area, easy to scan at a glance, with realistic labels for “진료 포인트”, “예상 상담 시간”, “추천 대상”, and “사후 관리”.
- Campaign detail zone: include a slim mint/beige information band with {시술 분야} as pill-style tags, plus short Korean blurbs such as “정밀 진단”, “개인별 치료 계획”, “디지털 스캔 상담”.
- Footer action zone: include consultation CTA, QR-style reservation box, small map-pin icon area, clinic hours, and fine-print treatment notice text, maintaining a premium clinic-ad structure.
- Overall background: bright clinical white base with subtle soft beige and mint accents, smooth paper-like finish, gentle editorial layering, realistic printed-flyer depth, and clear hierarchy.
- Use {시술 분야}, {컬러 팔레트}, and {비율} as controllable content anchors while keeping the dental clinic advertising subject and premium medical structure intact.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header strip (top 12–15%): place {치과명·로고} left-aligned as a compact clinic identity block, with a thin separator line beneath in muted mint/charcoal. Add small right-aligned utility text: “2026.05”, “상담 예약”, “02-1234-5678”, “강남역 3번 출구 도보 3분”.
2. Main headline (upper 18–26%): set {헤드라인} large and bold, centered over the hero area, with crisp Korean spacing and modern medical-ad hierarchy. Add a smaller supporting line in Korean: “평생 쓰는 치아를 위한 첫 상담, 오늘부터 차근차근.”
3. Hero portrait area (middle 28–60%): feature {미소 hero} as a bright close-up with natural teeth detail, softly integrated into the page with a subtle beige/mint editorial frame, faint dental-chair clinic background bokeh, and realistic highlights on lips and enamel.
4. Service ribbon (mid-lower 60–72%): display {시술 분야} as segmented pill tags. Add readable micro labels such as “임플란트”, “투명교정”, “치아미백”, “신경치료”, and “정기검진” when appropriate to the theme.
5. Comparison panel (lower 68–88%): build {시술 안내} into two side-by-side boxes with subtle dividers, concise labels, and small icon-like markers for duration/price/benefit comparison. Include realistic Korean sample fields: “상담 시간 30분 내외”, “구강 스캔 안내”, “맞춤 치료 계획”, “사후 체크 일정”.
6. Footer balance (bottom 88–100%): add a grounded clinic information footer with CTA button text “지금 상담 예약하기”, QR-style square marked “예약 QR”, address line “서울시 강남구 테헤란로 00, 5층”, phone number, weekday/weekend hours, and small disclaimer-style copy “개인별 구강 상태에 따라 진료 계획은 달라질 수 있습니다.”

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for headline, Pretendard SemiBold for section labels, Pretendard Regular for body copy; headline around 60–78 px, labels 24–30 px, details 18–22 px, footer microcopy 12–15 px.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} specifically as white #FFFFFF, clean mint #66C7B7, charcoal #2F343A, soft beige #EDE3D6.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px dividers in pale mint, comparison cards with soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12% opacity, rounded corners 16px, subtle paper-card layering for realistic printed advertising depth.
- Graphic system: use mint pill tags, beige highlight bands, small line icons for calendar/phone/location/tooth, a QR-style reservation block, and fine-print clinic notes to make the flyer feel like a real Korean dental advertisement.
- Layout: clean editorial medical layout, high readability, strict alignment, structured spacing, premium clinic branding, and believable print/social ad details.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm portrait lens at f/2.0 for the smile hero, shallow depth of field, sharp teeth detail with soft skin rendering.
- Lighting: bright diffuse studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, controlled specular highlights on teeth, clinical but flattering.
- Color grade: fresh white + mint + soft beige with neutral charcoal text, lightly desaturated for a premium dental-clinic brochure feel.
- Material realism: slightly tactile matte paper texture, realistic ink density, subtle card shadows, natural skin texture, enamel translucency, and a softly blurred clinic interior impression behind the hero portrait.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean dental clinic brochure — polished modern healthcare advertisement with a clean magazine-editorial finish, similar to a high-end clinic landing page and realistic printed appointment flyer. Trustworthy, calm, precise, warm, and approachable, emphasizing consultation clarity rather than exaggerated claims.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "평생 가는 치아, 한 번에 똑바로."
- Korean text accuracy: {치과명·로고}, {시술 분야}, {시술 안내}의 한글 표기가 깨지지 않아야 함.
- Korean text accuracy: 추가 정보 문구는 자연스러운 한글로 표시: "2026년 5월 상담 안내", "지금 상담 예약하기", "예약상담 02-1234-5678", "강남역 3번 출구 도보 3분", "개인별 구강 상태에 따라 진료 계획은 달라질 수 있습니다."
- Anatomy/layout invariants: smile hero must look anatomically natural, teeth aligned and realistic, no warped lips, no extra teeth, no distorted facial proportions.
- Composition invariants: keep a clean A4 vertical promotional layout, with headline, hero, service ribbon, consultation details, footer CTA, and comparison boxes clearly separated and easy to scan.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-870.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Medical advertising poster for a general hospital or internal medicine clinic, formatted as a polished vertical promo card for print, elevator signage, lobby display, and SNS.
Designed to communicate trust, professionalism, and quick access to key visit information through a realistic Korean clinic advertising layout with visible operational details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster uses a tall A4-style vertical layout with a strong top-to-bottom reading flow in {비율}, optimized for 1024x1536.
- Top-left header area holds {병원명·로고} as the primary brand anchor, paired with a small department subtitle such as "종합검진 · 만성질환 관리 · 당일 진료 상담" and a compact date label "2026년 5월 진료안내".
- Add a slim top-right utility area with a realistic phone line "대표전화 02-2188-0900", weekday label "평일 08:30–18:00", and a small QR-style reservation block.
- Center hero zone is dominated by {의료진 컷}, occupying the largest visual weight in the frame; the doctor should appear in a real clinic corridor or bright consultation-room setting with subtle depth, glass partition reflections, and soft blue-sage environmental accents.
- Mid-lower section presents {대표 카피} as the main message block, sized larger than the service list, with a supportive subline: "정확한 진단과 세심한 설명으로 오늘의 건강을 확인하세요."
- Service information uses {진료 분야} as capsule tags, with small medical line icons such as stethoscope, heart rhythm, stomach, thyroid, lungs, and glucose marker.
- Practical details sit in organized box modules using {포인트 안내}, aligned in a grid for "진료시간", "예약전화", "주차", and "교통" with realistic microcopy, icon labels, arrows, and small separators.
- Include a bottom footer with address line "서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 123, 4F", website "www.goodclinic.co.kr", SNS handle "@goodclinic_official", and a small map-pin icon area.
- Background should feel like a premium Korean medical brochure: white clinical paper texture, pale blue-gray panels, soft sage dividers, light glass reflections, and subtle consultation-room context rather than a blank mockup.
- Keep edges crisp, spacing balanced, and information easy to scan while allowing realistic clinic-ad details such as labels, icons, QR block, address, and footer text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): place {병원명·로고} in the upper-left with a compact logo mark feel; include a subtitle line "내과 중심 통합진료센터", a month label "2026년 5월 진료안내", and a top-right call/reservation strip.
2. Hero zone (center 40%): place {의료진 컷} as the main focal image, cleanly integrated with a soft realistic shadow, natural edge blending, and a real clinic background impression such as frosted glass, consultation desk, or hallway signage.
3. Message zone (mid-lower 15%): set {대표 카피} in a bold, highly legible line directly beneath the hero image; add a smaller supporting Korean caption and a tiny physician credit line such as "대표원장 김도현 내과 전문의".
4. Specialty zone (lower-middle 10%): display {진료 분야} as a concise service strip or capsule labels, evenly spaced and visually consistent, with small colored dots or medical pictograms for each specialty.
5. Info zone (bottom 15%): organize {포인트 안내} into four rounded boxed icon items for hours, booking, parking, and transportation; include realistic detail lines such as "평일 08:30–18:00", "토요일 08:30–13:00", "예약문의 02-2188-0900", "건물 지하 2시간 지원", "2호선 역삼역 3번 출구".
6. Footer balance: add a slim footer bar containing address, website, SNS handle, small QR reservation area, and tiny legal-style clinic copy such as "본 안내는 병원 진료 일정에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다." without overpowering the main message.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; header in Bold 700–800, body in Medium 500–600, caption text around 22–30px, headline around 48–64px, micro footer text around 16–20px.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트}; prioritize white, medical blue #2A6FB5, soft sage, charcoal, with pale blue-gray support tones for panels, dividers, QR block, and clinic information modules.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px light-gray separators, rounded 12px boxes, and a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for the hero and info panels.
- Use realistic medical-ad graphic details: small line icons, appointment badge, section labels, thin arrows, check marks, calendar symbol, phone icon, map-pin icon, and a muted QR placeholder pattern.
- Keep all Korean type sharp and print-ready, with clear hierarchy between hospital name, headline, service strip, appointment details, and footer contact information.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial healthcare portrait look, 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens style for {의료진 컷}, clean focal separation and natural facial proportions.
- Lighting: bright softbox key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, even clinical illumination with natural catchlights and soft shadows on the white coat.
- Color grade: cool clean white with medical blue accents, slightly desaturated sage highlights, and neutral charcoal text contrast.
- Material realism: matte brochure-paper finish, faint paper grain, subtle glass reflection in the hero background, crisp vector-style icons, and polished healthcare campaign production quality.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean clinic brochure — polished hospital advertising aesthetic with the orderly clarity of a modern healthcare brand campaign, enriched with real appointment details, medical service cues, and trustworthy local-clinic information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly as rendered in the design: "건강한 일상, 곁에서 지켜드립니다.", "내과·소화기·심장·내분비·호흡기·갑상선", "진료시간", "예약전화", "주차", "교통".
- Layout invariants: the poster must retain a clean vertical hierarchy with logo/header at top-left, doctor hero image centered, headline below, service capsules, and four information boxes at the bottom.
- Include realistic additional Korean microtext such as "2026년 5월 진료안내", "대표원장 김도현 내과 전문의", "평일 08:30–18:00", "토요일 08:30–13:00", "대표전화 02-2188-0900", "서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 123, 4F", and "@goodclinic_official".
- The medical figure must look professional and trustworthy, with a restrained smile, natural skin texture, neatly pressed white coat, visible name badge, and no exaggerated expression.
- All Korean typography must remain sharp, readable, and free of broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized real-person likeness

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean insurance/financial planner personal-brand advertisement, A4 vertical flyer for social media and print lead generation.
Premium corporate editorial promo poster with a strong left-side headline, right-side portrait hero, bottom-left contact card, and realistic campaign details that make it feel like an actual advisor advertisement from a Seoul financial firm.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left 42%: large headline block with {큰 한글 헤드라인} as the dominant anchor, followed by {부제} and {대표 서비스 강조} stacked with clear hierarchy.
- Right 38%: {원본 인물} rendered as a professional hero portrait, standing or seated in a confident 3/4-to-front pose with {인물 자세}, dressed in a tailored suit suitable for {직업·전문분야}.
- Bottom-left 24%: a polished contact card containing {명함 박스}, aligned with the headline column, designed like a real advisor business-card panel with phone, email, address, role, and consultation label.
- Top-left brand mark area: {회사명·로고} placed as a compact corporate lockup with a small campaign date label and branch-style micro text.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Border/shadow: use layered white and warm-gray cards with 1px light gray border #E6E6E6, fine sage-green divider lines, and a soft drop shadow of 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity.
- Layout treatment: maintain consistent baseline alignment, strong left-right balance, readable spacing, realistic print-safe edges, and a refined corporate editorial feel with small but purposeful supporting details.

[1. PURPOSE]

Professional realtor branding layout with a left-side Korean headline, right-side portrait hero, and detailed contact card block at the bottom, enriched with realistic real-estate office materials, consultation cues, and polished local-business advertising details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left side (about 42%): large headline block and subheadline stacked vertically, aligned flush-left with strong editorial hierarchy; include a small date/consultation label above or near the headline such as "2026 봄 이사 상담", "상담 예약 오픈", or "강남권 매물 브리핑".

- Bottom-left: {명함 박스} as a compact contact-info card with crisp borders, neat hierarchy, and realistic micro-details such as QR 예약 영역, small map-pin icon, 상담 가능 시간, and office address line.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer: bright white or very pale warm-gray studio-office backdrop with realistic depth, gentle gradient, faint city skyline/window reflection, and subtle real-estate office textures such as matte paper, glass, brushed metal, and soft desk shadows.

6. Supporting information area: add 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs in small boxes or lines, for example "오늘의 추천 매물 12건", "실거래가 기반 비교분석", "계약 전 체크리스트 제공"; include a small date stamp such as "2026.05 상담 예약" and a page/poster code like "AD-REALTY 247".
7. Hero portrait area (right side): {원본 인물} cut out or framed as a polished realtor portrait, holding {소품} naturally, wearing a suit, with a restrained smile and professional posture; nearby may include subtle realistic props such as contract folder, house key, tablet with floor plan, or rolled blueprint.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for {큰 한글 헤드라인}, Pretendard Medium for {부제}, Pretendard SemiBold for {대표 서비스 강조}, and Pretendard Regular for contact details; headline size should dominate the left half.
- Korean ad microcopy: add short, legible real-estate phrases only, such as "상담 예약 오픈", "매매·전세·월세", "실거래가 분석", "오늘의 추천 매물", "방문 상담 가능", "QR로 빠른 문의".
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with white #FFFFFF, warm charcoal #3A3530, deep gray #2B2B2B, and a restrained gold accent such as #B89B5E for thin separators, service badges, icon strokes, and small highlights.
- Border/shadow: use a soft 4px downward shadow, 12px blur, 15% opacity on the contact card and hero cutout; keep edges crisp and editorial, not glossy.
- Graphic details: include realistic small icons for phone, mail, location, QR, calendar, and building; add thin dividers, tiny footer text, subtle office-grid lines, and one or two premium geometric accents that support the real-estate theme.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, mild rim light to separate the suit from the white background.
- Color grade: clean neutral whites with warm charcoal typography, subtle gold accents, slightly desaturated premium corporate tone.
- Material realism: show natural fabric texture on the suit, realistic paper texture on brochures/contracts, slight reflection on glass or tablet screen, and believable contact-card print depth.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean real-estate consulting advertisement — trustworthy, polished, local-expert oriented, like a high-end realtor profile poster seen in a modern office, apartment brochure, or neighborhood property magazine.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — "내 집 마련, 함께 고민해 드릴게요", "강남·마곡·신촌 매물 풍부", "대표 서비스", "OO 부동산 또는 본인 사무소", "상담 담당자: 박지호", "대표 공인중개사", "Mo: 010-XXXX-XXXX", "Fax", "Mail: name@example.co.kr", "서울특별시 강남구 ...".
- Additional small Korean text may include: "상담 예약 오픈", "2026년 5월 상담", "매매·전세·월세", "실거래가 분석", "오늘의 추천 매물 12건", "QR로 빠른 문의", "방문 상담 가능".
- Preserve the exact face from the reference image.
- Right-side portrait must keep a professional suit look and a restrained smile.
- Layout invariant: large headline on the left, hero portrait on the right, contact card at the lower-left.
- All Korean typography must be clean, unbroken, and fully legible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

2) Brand area (upper-left): place {회사명·로고} as a small logo-style masthead with English + Korean subtitle treatment; add a compact campaign tag nearby: “2026 전문 상담 캠페인 · VOL.05”.

- Graphic details: include rounded service badges, small divider lines, QR-like block, date label, footer caption, and micro icons that support the professional ad rather than overpowering the portrait.

[6. MOOD]
Magazine-clean professional editorial ad — resembles a polished Korean law-firm or customs consulting campaign flyer with contemporary corporate portrait photography, trustworthy service details, and a premium consulting-office atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean professional personal-brand advertisement poster for a lawyer or legal officer, A4 vertical layout, clean editorial flyer for social media and print.
High-trust law firm promo with bold headline on the left, portrait hero on the right, and compact contact card at the lower corner.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left 40% of the frame: {큰 한글 헤드라인} set as the dominant typographic anchor, with {부제} directly below and {대표 서비스 강조} as a smaller support line.
- Right 38–42%: {원본 인물} styled as a professional hero portrait, upright and slightly angled toward camera, holding a tablet naturally, with crisp suit tailoring and restrained smile.
- Upper-left corner: {회사명·로고} as a minimal law-office brand mark, aligned cleanly with the headline block.
- Lower-left corner: {명함 박스} placed as a compact contact card with structured spacing and thin divider rules.
- Background: {배경·라이팅} in a white-to-very-light-gray studio field, no busy office clutter, with subtle depth separation behind the subject.
- Keep strong negative space around the headline and between text blocks, preserving a premium legal-ad editorial grid.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background layer: flat white studio base with a faint cool-gray gradient toward the edges, minimal texture, no distracting interior details.
2) Brand area: place {회사명·로고} in the upper-left in a small but crisp lockup, using dark navy text and a thin accent rule.
3) Main headline block: position {큰 한글 헤드라인} on the left side in very large bold Korean sans-serif, stacked over 2–3 lines with disciplined line spacing.
4) Subtitle and service line: set {부제} directly under the headline in a smaller weight, then place {대표 서비스 강조} below it as a clean service highlight with subtle gold accent or small capsule label.
5) Portrait hero: render {원본 인물} on the right half, full upper-body visible, suit sharp, tablet angled slightly inward, face preserved exactly from the reference image, with polished but realistic skin texture.
6) Contact card: place {명함 박스} at the bottom-left as a neat rectangular panel with name, phone, email, and address arranged in 4 compact lines.
7) Props and cues: integrate {소품} minimally, such as a law book edge or tablet only if it supports the legal profession without crowding the layout.
8) Overall balance: maintain magazine-clean editorial spacing, with the text-heavy left side and portrait-heavy right side clearly separated by negative space and subtle alignment guides.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the headline, ExtraBold 800–900 for {큰 한글 헤드라인}, Medium/Semibold for supporting lines; contact card in 14–18px equivalent, tight but readable.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트}, specifically white #FFFFFF, charcoal #1F1F1F, deep navy #0F2A55, and restrained gold accent #C8A45D.
- Border/shadow: apply a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12–16% opacity to the portrait cutout and contact card; use thin 1px divider lines in pale gray.
- Layout styling: clean corporate editorial design, crisp alignment, no decorative flourishes, no cluttered gradients, no neon tones.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 85mm portrait look, f/2.8 to f/4, studio fashion/editorial framing, sharp face and suit detail with natural background separation.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle rim light on the subject’s hair and shoulder, soft shadow cast onto the white background.
- Color grade: cool clean white with deep navy and charcoal balance, slight warm-neutral skin tone preservation, restrained gold accent for premium legal branding.

[6. MOOD]
Premium legal-services editorial — the clean corporate authority of a Financial Times magazine advert mixed with a modern Korean law firm identity poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: {큰 한글 헤드라인}, {부제}, {대표 서비스 강조}, {회사명·로고}, {명함 박스}의 이름·전화·이메일·주소.
- Preserve the exact face from the reference image.
- The subject must remain a lawyer/legal professional brand image: upright posture, suit, tablet, calm and trustworthy expression.
- Bottom-left contact card must include structured contact details in Korean/English mix without distortion.
- Left-side headline must be large, bold, and highly legible; do not reduce it into a decorative background element.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Extra people or duplicated faces
- Altering the reference face into another person
- Overly flashy legal clichés, courtroom drama, or aggressive sales copy
- Sexualized styling, exposed clothing, or glamorous fashion posing
- Blurry text, misspelled contact info, or unreadable small print

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean tax accountant / CPA personal-brand advertising poster, premium editorial promotional layout, A4 vertical flyer for social media and print.
Create a real-looking professional service advertisement that communicates trust, expertise, approachable consultation, and a modern financial-office atmosphere at a glance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left side (about 55%): large headline block and subheadline stacked with strong hierarchy, aligned flush-left with professional editorial rhythm and enough room for crisp Korean readability.
- Right side (about 35%): {원본 인물} as the main hero, full upper body, in {인물 자세}, wearing a refined suit and holding {소품}, facing slightly toward camera with a trustworthy expression.
- Bottom-left corner: {명함 박스} inside a polished contact card box with a clean grid, small phone/mail/location-style icons, business hours line, and a small QR-code-style consultation box.
- Top-left area: compact brand line for {회사명·로고}, plus {직업·전문분야} as a professional title label and a small date/issue tag such as “2026 세무 상담 가이드”.
- Mid-left support zone: add 3 short service chips around {대표 서비스 강조}, such as “기장대행”, “종합소득세”, “법인세 신고”, with thin dividers and blue/gold accent marks.
- Background: bright premium office-studio setting with white and light-gray walls, subtle glass reflection, blurred desk edge, tax documents, calculator, pen, and laptop shapes softly visible to create realistic context without competing with the main text.
- Bottom strip: small sponsor/partner-style information area reading “SAVETAX PARTNER DESK · 예약 상담 운영 · 평일 09:00–18:00”, styled as editorial microcopy rather than an official certification.
- Overall spacing: crisp corporate layout with clear alignment, layered content cards, subtle texture, and print-ready legibility.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background base — Use {배경·라이팅}: a bright white-to-cool-gray professional office/studio field with gentle blue gradient, soft glass highlights, desk-surface texture, faint document stacks, a calculator, and tasteful financial-workplace details in shallow focus.
2. Brand area — Place {회사명·로고} at the upper-left in a compact logo line, paired with {직업·전문분야}; add a thin blue accent rule and a small editorial label such as “TAX & ACCOUNTING GUIDE · VOL.05”.
3. Main headline area — Render {큰 한글 헤드라인} in very large bold Korean sans-serif, left-aligned, occupying the upper-left to mid-left zone with strong contrast and polished kerning.
4. Supporting copy — Place {부제} directly under the headline in smaller, medium-weight Korean sans-serif, with a realistic two-line promotional rhythm and refined line spacing.
5. Service emphasis — Add {대표 서비스 강조} as a highlighted blue-and-white label or pill-style line beneath the subheadline; include nearby short Korean service chips: “기장대행”, “절세 점검”, “신고 대행”, “상담 예약”.
6. Hero subject area — Show {원본 인물} on the right side, wearing a suit, holding {소품}, in {인물 자세}, with a restrained smile, natural skin texture, sharp facial detail, and a polished professional presence.
7. Contact card area — Put {명함 박스} in the lower-left, inside a neat rectangular card with cool-gray border, soft shadow, micro icons for 전화/메일/위치, business hours, a small QR-code-style square labeled “상담 예약”, and a small address/contact line.
8. Editorial details — Add small realistic poster information: “2026년 5월 상담 안내”, “신규 사업자 체크리스트”, “환급·세무·회계 상담”, “예약제 운영”, plus a page-like footer number “AD 01” and tiny credit text “Photo by SAVETAX Studio”.
9. Final polish — Keep the face from the reference image unchanged, preserve the corporate editorial balance, and ensure the headline, brand, service details, and contact information are immediately legible.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for headline and body, headline weight 800-900, subheadline weight 500-600, contact details 400-500, microcopy 300-400, with clear size hierarchy.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트}; include white #FFFFFF, charcoal #222222, brand blue #1E5BC6, soft gray #E9EDF3, small gold accent #C8A45D.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px cool-gray borders, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on the contact card, service chips, QR-style consultation box, and floating labels.
- Layout accents: use blue vertical rules, small gold dots, subtle document-line graphics, fine divider lines, rounded service tags, and a bottom information strip to make the ad feel like a finished premium financial-brand campaign.
- Realistic materials: show slight paper texture on the poster-like cards, glassy reflections in the background, natural fabric texture on the suit, and believable tablet reflections.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame portrait look, 85mm f/1.8 equivalent with sharp facial detail and gentle background separation.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, subtle fill from front-right, very light rim on the right edge, smooth shadow falloff; match {배경·라이팅}.
- Color grade: crisp white editorial grade with cool blue branding and neutral skin tones, slightly high-key but not overexposed.
- Rendering quality: realistic commercial photography blended with precise Korean editorial typography, print-ad sharpness, natural suit texture, clean tablet highlight, and believable office props.

[6. MOOD]
Magazine-clean corporate editorial — like a premium management-consulting ad spread in Harvard Business Review meets a polished Korean financial-brand campaign, with realistic tax-office context, confident service information, and approachable consultation energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: include and render clearly “사업자의 세무, 쉽고 안전하게”, “환급·세무·회계 상담을 더 간편하게”, “대표 서비스”, “SAVETAX”.
- Additional Korean microcopy must be crisp and correctly spelled: “2026년 5월 상담 안내”, “신규 사업자 체크리스트”, “기장대행”, “종합소득세”, “법인세 신고”, “상담 예약”, “평일 09:00–18:00”.
- Preserve the exact face from the reference image.
- The hero subject must remain a professional in a suit holding a tablet, with a restrained and trustworthy expression.
- Layout invariant: large headline stays on the left, hero subject stays on the right, contact card stays bottom-left.
- Keep {큰 한글 헤드라인}, {부제}, {대표 서비스 강조}, {회사명·로고}, and {명함 박스} crisp, correctly spelled, and fully legible.
- Maintain the vertical 1024x1536 poster format and respect {비율}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-864.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean AI chatbot advertisement poster for {브랜드·서비스}, vertical social-ad layout in {비율}, premium dark cyber-night campaign.
Designed to sell Grok AI / xAI as a fast, intelligent, image-capable chat assistant with a cinematic urban feel, while looking like a real launch poster photographed and composited for a Seoul night campaign.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Full-bleed vertical poster with the {배경·분위기} filling the entire canvas, layered with wet asphalt reflections, distant tower windows, taxi-light bokeh, faint rain mist, and subtle cyber haze.
- {모델·인물} placed in a polished side-profile hero pose on the left half, occupying about 40% of the frame height-to-width balance, wearing a black jacket with realistic fabric grain, collar seams, and small metal zipper details.
- The {디바이스 mockup} is held in the foreground on the right side, angled slightly toward the camera so the screen is readable, sized large enough to act as a second focal point and clearly present the product UI.
- The {한글 헤드라인} is arranged in the upper-left hierarchy, with a logo-like mark, English brand name, Korean subtitle, bold main slogan, and small supporting line stacked with tight editorial spacing.
- Add a compact top-right campaign label block with short Korean event details: “2026 AI NIGHT”, “2026.05.28 THU 20:00”, “서울 성수 테크라운지”, styled like a premium tech launch invitation.
- The {기능 박스 3개} are grouped in the lower-left corner as three compact floating cards, aligned vertically with equal spacing, translucent glass depth, small icons, and numbered labels.
- Add a realistic lower poster utility strip: tiny QR-style scan box, “무료 체험 코드: GROK-NIGHT”, “사전 등록 / 현장 데모”, a small barcode area, sponsor/partner text, and model credit “MODEL / 지안”.
- Use fine decorative graphic elements that belong to a tech campaign: thin cyan scan lines, small coordinate ticks, micro grid marks, subtle constellation-like node lines, and tiny UI dots around the device glow.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Background layer: build a dark metropolitan night skyline with soft bokeh lights, faint cyber haze, blurred neon traces, rainy glass reflections, and low-contrast building silhouettes; foreground elements remain dominant through lighting and depth.
- Hero subject layer: render {모델·인물} as a chic Korean woman in her 20s with black jacket, tied-back hair, a sharp side gaze, natural makeup, realistic skin texture, visible hair strands, jacket stitching, and believable hand posture holding the phone.
- Device layer: render {디바이스 mockup} as a premium dark-mode phone screen with the Grok chat interface, including the visible prompt line “무엇이든 물어보세요”, a user prompt bubble, assistant response preview, three feature chips for quick answers, deep analysis, and image generation, plus a small generated-image thumbnail preview inside the UI.
- Headline layer: place {한글 헤드라인} at the upper-left, using a strong typographic hierarchy with the logo mark, brand name, subtitle, large serif-style main line, and small supporting line beneath it.
- Feature cards layer: place {기능 박스 3개} at the lower-left in three stacked dark capsules, each with a number, simple icon, and one-line benefit statement; cards should feel like real luminous glass UI panels floating over the night scene.
- Event/detail layer: add small but readable Korean poster details around the headline and bottom strip, including “VOL.01 LAUNCH POSTER”, “SEOUL NIGHT BETA”, “지금, 더 똑똑한 대화를 시작하세요”, “SCAN TO CHAT”, “무료 체험 코드: GROK-NIGHT”, and “문의: hello@grok-night.kr”.
- Atmosphere finishing: add cinematic rim light on the model’s silhouette, a subtle glow around the phone screen, soft shadow separation between foreground elements, realistic screen reflections on the fingers, and a faint cyan edge reflection on the jacket.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold for Korean utility lines, Noto Serif KR Bold for the main slogan, and Pretendard Regular for small support copy; main slogan around 58–72 px equivalent, supporting text around 22–28 px, micro details around 10–16 px equivalent.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with deep black #0B0D12, charcoal #1A1F29, white #F4F6FA, cool gray #A7B0BF, and small neon accents in cyan #34D7FF or violet #8A5CFF.
- Borders/shadows: feature cards should have 1px borders in rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rounded 18 px corners, and soft drop shadows with 0px x-offset, 10px y-offset, 28px blur, 18% opacity; QR/ticket strip may use thinner 1px cyan dividers.
- UI styling: the phone mockup must feel like a polished dark product shot, with luminous screen contrast, realistic chat bubbles, readable Korean labels, app navigation hints, soft inner glow, and a believable black-glass bezel.
- Poster detailing: include a small barcode block, QR-style scan box, sponsor area, date/time/venue label, short CTA, and micro-credit text in a way that supports the advertisement rather than replacing the main headline.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-body editorial portrait look shot on an 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, with the phone and face both remaining crisp enough to read.
- Lighting: cinematic night setup with cool rim light from upper-right, soft key light from front-left at about 45°, faint city-bokeh spill from the background, and realistic phone-screen light reflecting on the model’s hand and jawline.
- Color grade: cool noir base with teal-blue highlights, restrained magenta neon accents, high contrast blacks with clean whites, wet-street reflection tones, and gentle filmic grain for a real advertising still.

[6. MOOD]

AI chat service vertical ad poster for social media, app-install promotion, and brand campaign use, with a bright white editorial advertising layout.
Korean commercial key visual for a ChatGPT-style product awareness campaign, featuring a friendly model, realistic device mockups, campaign information, CTA, QR/app-start area, and a premium magazine-ad finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: {모델·인물} placed in the mid-right 40% as the human anchor, with a relaxed friendly pose that feels approachable, current, and trustworthy.
- Device cluster: {디바이스 mockup} arranged in the left-center 35% as a balanced product stack, slightly overlapping the figure for an integrated product-demo ad look.
- Header zone: top-left 20% contains the OpenAI swirl-style identity mark, {메인 헤드라인}, and {서브카피}, aligned like a premium Korean tech campaign poster.
- Campaign badge zone: top-right area includes {캠페인 정보} in a small rounded badge, with a thin green divider and subtle chat-bubble icon accents.
- Feature strip: mid-lower left contains {기능 배지} as three small rounded cards with icon dots, short Korean labels, and concise benefit text.
- CTA zone: lower-right 16% contains {CTA·로고}, sized like a premium app-start button with a QR mini-card nearby.
- Sponsor / footer area: bottom band includes {신뢰 문구}, {하단 고지}, a small handle line, and simple partner-logo style text marks.
- Background treatment: {배경·분위기} with a bright white studio-cafe surface, subtle table edge, coffee cup, notebook, pen, small plant, soft glass reflection, and gentle upper-background bokeh.
- Layout framing: maintain a clean asymmetrical balance, with headline, devices, model, and CTA forming a soft diagonal from top-left to bottom-right.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left identity block: place the OpenAI swirl logo-like mark in a refined editorial style, then set the headline block beneath it with crisp alignment, readable line breaks, and confident spacing.
2. Main headline: render {메인 헤드라인} in large elegant Korean typography, with the first line heavier and the second line slightly lighter for hierarchy; place {서브카피} directly below in smaller sans-serif copy.
3. Campaign details: add a compact event-style badge reading {캠페인 정보}; include a date range, location-style label, and campaign name so the poster feels like a real published ad.
4. Model presentation: show {모델·인물} as a natural lifestyle figure, standing or seated casually with a bright but controlled smile, beige blazer, white inner top, and a friendly product-demo posture.
5. Device presentation: position {디바이스 mockup} with realistic screen depth and subtle perspective, ensuring the laptop UI and mobile UI look like genuine ChatGPT product screens in a polished marketing context.
6. Product UI details: laptop screen should show a Korean prompt area, recent chat cards, and recommended prompt chips; phone screen should show a mobile ChatGPT conversation with legible Korean snippets.
7. Feature cards: place {기능 배지} as three compact benefit cards, using small green icons, short Korean text, and light shadow so they read as real ad information.
8. CTA block: place {CTA·로고} as a rounded green pill button with high contrast, crisp edge definition, QR mini-card, and clear app-start behavior.
9. Supporting mood elements: add soft daylight highlights, a tidy desk surface, translucent chat-card overlays, small green orbital arcs, glass reflections, and lifestyle objects that support the premium studio-cafe atmosphere.
10. Brand integration: keep {브랜드·서비스} visible through the identity mark, product UI, CTA, footer line, and overall white-green tech campaign language.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for supporting copy, and a refined Korean serif such as Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the main headline; headline weight 600-700, supporting text 400-500, button text bold 700.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with dominant white #FFFFFF and soft off-white #F7F6F2, signature green #10A37F or similar, beige #D9C7B3, charcoal #2B2B2B, and warm amber #D9A15B as an accent.
- Border/shadow: use subtle soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 14% opacity on devices, feature cards, and CTA; use rounded 18-28px corners for UI cards and CTA elements.
- Surface styling: matte paper-like white background, lightly textured desk surface, restrained reflections, soft glass UI overlays, and editorial product-ad polish.
- Graphic accents: include fine green linework, tiny chat icons, floating prompt chips, QR card, footer dividers, and small campaign labels to make the poster feel complete and commercially produced.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame editorial product portrait look, shot on a Sony A7R IV with 85mm f/1.4 for the model and 50mm perspective for the device stack, shallow depth of field but readable screens.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle warm amber fill from the right, subtle rim light on hair and shoulder, and controlled specular highlights on the phone and laptop edges.
- Color grade: clean white + signature green + beige + charcoal, with slightly warm highlights and neutral mids, similar to an Apple keynote meets high-end magazine ad treatment.

[6. MOOD]
Premium tech lifestyle editorial — bright, intelligent, friendly, and polished, like a high-end Korean magazine ad for an AI productivity service used in everyday life.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보이게 할 문자열:
  - 더 똑똑하게,
  - 더 자연스럽게
  - OpenAI와 함께하는 새로운 일상
  - ChatGPT by OpenAI
  - 지금 시작하기
  - AI WEEK 2026
  - 2026.05.01–05.31
  - 서울 성수 팝업 스튜디오
  - 무료 체험 · QR로 앱 열기
  - @openai_korea
  - #일상을바꾸는AI
- Device UI Korean strings: 노트북과 휴대폰 화면에 다음 문구가 읽히게 배치:
  - 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
  - 오늘 할 일 정리해줘
  - 추천 프롬프트
  - 업무 정리
  - 아이디어 초안
  - 학습 도우미
- Layout invariants: the model must remain friendly and natural, with beige blazer and white inner top; the laptop and phone must both display ChatGPT-like interfaces; the overall composition must stay bright, white, editorial, and premium.
- The OpenAI swirl mark must appear in the top-left identity area, the campaign badge must appear near the top-right, and the CTA must be a green pill button with a nearby QR mini-card.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean AI chatbot advertising poster, dark cinematic social ad, premium app promo visual for Gemini-style service.
Vertical key visual with a sleek model, phone UI mockup, headline, CTA, campaign details, realistic footer information, and floating feature cards for a paid social placement.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {모델·인물} placed in the left-center 42% of the frame, waist-up crop, confident front-facing pose, clear silhouette separation from the background, subtle cinematic rim light along hair and shoulders.
- Device mockup: {디바이스_목업} anchored on the right-center 28% of the frame, slightly angled toward camera, screen glow visible on the model’s hand and cheek, with legible Gemini-style chat UI and recommendation cards.
- Header zone: {한글_헤드라인} positioned in the upper-right 22% area with strong hierarchy, star signature mark, and polished premium-ad typography.
- Campaign metadata: {캠페인_정보} placed as small but readable microcopy near the headline or upper-left edge, like a real digital campaign poster with date, edition code, and short launch label.
- CTA and feature cards: {CTA_기능_카드} arranged across the lower-right and lower-left areas, with floating depth, natural overlaps, readable labels, and a premium app-promo hierarchy.
- Footer and platform area: {푸터_정보} placed along the bottom edge as real ad details, including app availability, QR-style block, short legal microcopy, and campaign code.
- Background treatment: {배경_분위기} using a dark navy-to-violet diagonal gradient, soft vignette at edges, subtle star sparkles near upper-right, cinematic bokeh in the far background, and a few translucent glassmorphism panels behind copy.
- Overall spacing: asymmetrical commercial layout with the model as hero, phone as product anchor, headline above, cards at the bottom, and footer details that make the poster feel like a finished Korean tech brand campaign.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Full background — build a dark purple and blue gradient backdrop with deep navy shadows, faint nebula-like diffusion, layered glass reflections, and tiny Gemini-style sparkle accents near the top-right.
2. Hero figure — render {모델·인물} with realistic skin texture, crisp black shirt folds, direct eye contact, natural makeup detail, catchlights in the eyes, and a polished fashion-ad silhouette; separate the model from the background with a soft blue-violet rim light.
3. Phone product area — place {디바이스_목업} in the right hand area, screen facing camera clearly, with luminous UI edges, subtle reflection on the glass surface, realistic bezels, notification chips, and readable Korean chat text.
4. Headline stack — set {한글_헤드라인} in the upper-right, large title first, smaller subtitle second, with clean line breaks and high contrast white type over the dark gradient.
5. Campaign layer — add {캠페인_정보} as a small real-world ad detail: launch date, campaign label, and edition code, styled like premium tech campaign microcopy rather than filler.
6. CTA layer — position {CTA_기능_카드} as a bright gradient pill button plus two floating mini cards, each card slightly tilted by 2–4 degrees for dimensionality but still easy to read; include tiny arrow icon, sparkle icon, and app-action labels.
7. Footer layer — add {푸터_정보} with a small QR-style square, app availability text, campaign URL-style text, and fine-print disclaimer in Korean, aligned cleanly with the poster grid.
8. Glow and accents — add a controlled blue-violet halo around the phone and CTA, star-spark motif matching the Gemini identity, realistic lens bloom on bright edges, and gentle reflections on nearby glass cards.
9. Final balance — ensure the composition feels like a premium paid social ad: clear hierarchy, strong product visibility, realistic campaign information, and polished Korean typography.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline, Pretendard SemiBold for the subtitle, Pretendard Medium for CTA/card labels, and Pretendard Regular for footer microcopy; headline size should feel like a billboard-style ad, subtitle about 40–50% of headline scale.
- Color palette: use {컬러_팔레트} with dark navy #0B1020, deep violet #4B1D7A, electric blue #2F6BFF, white #F7F9FF, soft glow lavender #B38CFF, and small cyan highlights #70D6FF.
- Border/shadow: apply a soft drop shadow with 0–6px x-offset, 10px y-offset, 24px blur, 18% opacity on cards; use subtle inner glow on the CTA pill; use refined glassmorphism borders at low opacity for UI cards.
- Surface finish: glossy phone glass, matte fabric on the shirt, smooth gradient background, semi-transparent frosted cards, and crisp vector-like typography without posterization.
- Realistic ad details: include a QR-style block, app-store style micro badge, short campaign code, and footer disclaimer as small but plausible printed/digital poster elements.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 85mm f/1.4 portrait look for the model, with a secondary product-photography feel similar to a 50mm prime for the phone mockup.
- Lighting: soft key light from upper-left at 45°, cool blue rim light from upper-right, gentle fill from front, screen glow from the phone, and faint practical sparkle highlights in the background.
- Color grade: cinematic cool-toned grade with deep indigo shadows, violet mids, blue highlights, clean white text contrast, and natural slightly warm skin tones against the cool background.
- Render quality: premium Korean tech campaign retouching, realistic facial detail, controlled lens bloom, accurate hand anatomy, sharp text edges, and high-resolution social poster finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium tech brand campaign — Apple key visual polish mixed with a Netflix-style cinematic dark gradient ad treatment, elevated by realistic Korean launch-poster details and a confident futuristic AI assistant mood.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly as written: "당신의 AI 파트너", "더 빠르게 묻고, 정리하고, 만들어보세요", "지금 Gemini 시작하기", "Deep Research — 친환경 패션 트렌드 리포트", "Canvas — 여행 계획표", "안녕하세요, 민서님. 오늘 무엇을 도와드릴까요?"
- Additional Korean campaign details must be clean and legible: "2026년 5월 캠페인", "VOL.247", "gemini.google.com", "앱에서 바로 시작", "QR로 빠른 실행", "일부 기능은 국가 및 언어에 따라 제공 여부가 달라질 수 있습니다."
- Maintain the Gemini aesthetic cues: dark purple/blue gradient background, sleek female model in black shirt, gradient pill CTA button, floating feature cards, glass UI surfaces, and star sparkle motif.
- All Korean text must be correctly rendered, fully legible, and placed like a real premium paid social ad, not random filler.
- Hands must look anatomically correct and natural if visible, with believable phone grip, correct finger count, and realistic screen reflections.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or gibberish UI text
- Unlicensed celebrity composites or recognizable celebrity face swaps

- Use {브랜드·서비스}, {모델·인물}, {디바이스 mockup}, {한글 헤드라인}, {CTA·로고}, {배경·인테리어}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} as the customizable structure references.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background layer: fill the full canvas with a soft cream-beige interior environment, adding bookcase bokeh, a candle with warm flame glow, a ceramic mug, linen curtain highlights, a small plant, an open notebook, a pen, and desk still-life elements with realistic depth of field so the ad reads like a photographed magazine cover.
2) Hero model layer: place {모델·인물} in a natural seated or leaning pose at a desk, with beige blazer, white inner top, soft natural makeup, and gold earrings catching a small highlight; her expression should feel intelligent, approachable, and calm.
3) Device proof layer: position {디바이스 mockup} so the laptop UI is legible and the phone is clearly visible in hand or near the right-hand side, both integrated into the scene with realistic perspective, subtle screen reflections, finger contact shadows, and gentle screen glow.
4) Laptop UI content: show a clean AI chat workspace using Korean text, including the prompt “프로젝트 전략 문서 요약해줘”, visible document-summary cards, bullets, highlighted key points, and a warm coral accent that matches the campaign palette.
5) Phone UI content: show a compact companion screen with a short Korean chat preview, small app-style cards, and a soft notification highlight, reinforcing that {브랜드·서비스} works across devices.
6) Headline layer: render {한글 헤드라인} as the dominant typographic block, with the English “Claude ai” using a large refined serif treatment and the Korean line in elegant myeongjo styling for a premium magazine ad feel.
7) Editorial cover layer: include small but believable magazine elements: “AI LIFE MAGAZINE” masthead, “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “ADVERTORIAL”, “SPECIAL ISSUE”, “일하는 방식을 바꾸는 대화”, “회의록에서 전략까지”, “나의 생각을 정리하는 하루”, a barcode area, small price “₩7,500”, issue code, and model credit “MODEL: 한서윤”.
8) CTA and brand layer: place {CTA·로고} as a coral pill button with compact “Anthropic” brand signature and the Korean CTA “지금 시작하기”, making it instantly recognizable as the call-to-action while staying integrated with the editorial cover design.
9) Atmosphere finishing: soften edges with editorial depth of field, subtle film grain, warm highlight roll-off, paper-like contrast, and tactile shadows so the whole layout feels like a real premium lifestyle advertisement photographed for a magazine story cover.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the Korean headline, weight 600–700, with large display sizing; pair with a refined serif for the English title and Pretendard for smaller support text, issue labels, captions, price, barcode code, and feature blurbs.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with cream beige #F4EBDD, coral #F36E63, warm amber #D9A45A, charcoal #2E2E2E, and gold accents #C8A15A.
- Magazine text hierarchy: main headline largest, subheadline medium, CTA highly visible, editorial feature blurbs small and crisp; align text like a premium Korean lifestyle magazine cover rather than a flat banner.
- Cover details: add subtle rule lines, tiny page/issue markers, a vertical spine-style caption, barcode label, and small photo credit text in charcoal or warm gray; keep these believable and secondary to the headline and model.
- Device and CTA treatment: use a soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, and 15% opacity on the CTA button and device mockups; add realistic screen reflections, bevel highlights, and contact shadows on the desk.
- Surface treatment: matte paper-like tonality, lightly textured background, subtle editorial contrast, restrained saturation, natural skin texture, and warm print-ad richness.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: medium-format editorial portrait look, Phase One IQ4 style with 80mm lens at f/2.8 for the model and 35mm environmental framing for the desk scene.
- Lighting: soft natural window light from the left at about 45°, with a gentle fill from the front-right and a faint warm practical glow from candles and interior lamps.
- Color grade: warm cream + coral + amber grade with slightly lifted shadows, clean skin tones, and controlled highlight warmth reminiscent of luxury lifestyle magazine ads.
- Realism cues: natural fabric folds on the blazer, believable skin texture, slight reflections on the laptop glass, soft shadows under the mug and notebook, and small imperfections in paper and desk surfaces.

[6. MOOD]
Premium magazine advertisement — warm lifestyle campaign aesthetic with the polished editorial feel of Kinfolk mixed with a contemporary SaaS brand launch visual, enriched with realistic cover-line details, inviting desk-life context, and a calm intelligent atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: “복잡한 생각을, 더 명확하게.”, “읽고, 정리하고, 쓰고, 함께 생각하는 AI 파트너”, “지금 시작하기”, “Anthropic”, “프로젝트 전략 문서 요약해줘”.
- Additional Korean magazine text should render cleanly: “AI LIFE MAGAZINE”, “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “ADVERTORIAL”, “SPECIAL ISSUE”, “일하는 방식을 바꾸는 대화”, “회의록에서 전략까지”, “나의 생각을 정리하는 하루”, “MODEL: 한서윤”, “₩7,500”.
- The coral pill CTA button must be present and visually signature-like.
- The model should be a Korean woman in her 30s with natural makeup, gold earrings, and a beige blazer, posed naturally beside a MacBook and phone.
- The MacBook-style laptop and phone composition must stay balanced and clearly readable, with the laptop on the left and the phone on the right-hand side emphasis.
- All Korean characters must render cleanly with no distortion or broken glyphs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean first-aid quick guide poster, A4 vertical emergency manual layout for fast reading in urgent situations.
Realistic printed public-safety infographic sheet with pictograms, numbered warning steps, checklist panels, date/code labels, emergency contact strip, and clinic bulletin-board credibility.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: tall A4 poster with a white hospital-form base, strong top title band, central step-by-step guide, side safety notes, and a bottom emergency contacts strip, photographed as a real printed sheet.
- Main content block: {응급 상황} set as the headline context near the top, with the most important action steps occupying the center 55–60% of the frame.
- Step flow: use a top-to-bottom numbered sequence with strong red number badges, thin dividers, icon-led instruction blocks, and small check boxes for immediate confirmation.
- Safety emphasis: {주의·금기} should be isolated in a warning box with red accent lines, a caution triangle icon, and short Korean warning labels such as “절대 금지”, “즉시 중단”, “의식 확인”.
- Tool and contact areas: {필요 도구} and {긴급 연락} placed in smaller lower sections with compact icon rows, telephone glyphs, QR-code area, and high legibility.
- Include realistic poster metadata: “응급처치 빠른 가이드”, “현장용 1분 체크”, “개정 2026.05”, “POSTER No. 07”, “자료 코드: FA-1024”, a small barcode block, and a footer credit line “디자인·검수: 안전교육팀”.
- Add small informational micro-panels: “119 신고 전 확인”, “환자 상태 기록”, “보호자 연락 메모”, “응급실 이동 시 지참”.
- {비주얼 결} should control the illustration language: medical pictograms, clean line icons, label tags, and instructional infographic balance.
- {컬러} should define the color blocks, with white dominant, red for urgency, charcoal for text, green for safety cues, plus muted medical blue for secondary information.
- {비율} should be treated as the full-page vertical canvas ratio, with edge-safe print layout and all text fully visible.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: set the title as an emergency-manual style masthead with bold Korean typography, slightly left-aligned, with a thin rule line underneath and small metadata on the right: “2026년 5월 개정판”, “보건실·가정 비치용”.
- Situation summary block: place {응급 상황} in a compact descriptor box directly below the header, using a light gray panel or red outline to frame the scenario, with a small label “상황 요약”.
- Main steps block: render {대처 단계} as 3–4 distinct numbered instruction cards, each card containing a bold red number, a simple pictogram, one short action line, and a tiny supporting note line such as “시간 기록”, “호흡 확인”, “안전한 위치 확보”.
- Warning block: render {주의·금기} in a high-contrast caution panel with a red border, warning icon, diagonal caution stripe detail, and visually separated negative instructions.
- Supplies block: show {필요 도구} as a stacked or two-column checklist with small medical icons for 물, 거즈, 연고, 깨끗한 천, 장갑, 손전등, and a small label “준비물 확인”.
- Emergency contacts block: show {긴급 연락} at the bottom in the most readable zone, with phone-style iconography, strong spacing between numbers, and supplementary Korean labels like “응급신고 119”, “보호자”, “가까운 병원”.
- Footer information: include a realistic sponsor/credit area without official seals, such as “협력: 지역 약국 · 안전교육센터”, “문의: safety-info@example.kr”, plus a small QR placeholder labeled “신고 요령 보기”.
- Illustration treatment: keep icons flat, consistent, semi-instructional, like a hospital triage poster or public-safety pamphlet, with small labels, arrows, callout tabs, printed texture, and practical visual hierarchy.
- Layout integrity: every text block must remain fully readable, aligned to the grid, clearly separated by spacing, panels, color bars, thin dividers, or icon markers.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body, weight 600–800 for headers, 400–500 for explanatory lines, with large numerals and compact line spacing for fast scanning.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, emergency red #D7262B, charcoal #2B2B2B, safety green #2E8B57, light gray #EEF1F4, muted medical blue #DCEAF7.
- Borders/shadows: thin red outline boxes, 1–2 px dividers, practical form-like panels, subtle paper shadow about 4 px y-offset, 10–12 px blur, 10–15% opacity where the printed sheet lifts from the background.
- Icon style: simple pictograms with flat fills and clean strokes, consistent stroke width, small status badges, check marks, arrows, caution triangles, phone icons, medical cross icons, and QR/barcode graphic blocks.
- Print realism: add faint paper fiber, slight ink density variation, crisp black text, tiny registration marks near the bottom edge, and a believable clinic-poster finish while keeping the Korean copy readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: straight-on flat poster composition, equivalent to a 50mm documentary framing with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: even diffused studio light across the whole page, soft real-paper shadow at the edges, no harsh glare over text.
- Color grade: crisp hospital-memo palette with bright white, warning red, neutral charcoal, restrained green accents, and muted blue secondary blocks.
- Real-world surface: the poster can appear as a freshly printed A4 sheet mounted on a pale clinic wall or notice board, with tiny tape corners or pin shadows kept secondary to the guide content.

[6. MOOD]
Practical public-health infographic — clinic wall poster meets municipal emergency handbook, urgent but calm, professional, readable, and believable as a real posted guide.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: every rendered Korean string must be clean and correctly spelled, including {응급 상황}, {대처 단계}, {주의·금기}, {필요 도구}, {긴급 연락}.
- The design must replicate a first-aid emergency guide with pictograms, numbered red warning steps, checklist panels, QR/barcode area, footer credit text, and a hospital-style public-safety layout.
- All step numbers must be visually emphasized and easy to scan at a glance.
- Include short Korean poster text such as “응급처치 빠른 가이드”, “현장용 1분 체크”, “개정 2026.05”, “상황 요약”, “준비물 확인”, “응급신고 119”, and “신고 요령 보기”.
- Keep the poster structured, authoritative, instructional, and fully legible, with no decorative text distortion.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-859.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean pet care guide manual poster, vertical A4 infographic for daily routine planning and safe-feeding reference.
Cute, trustworthy editorial layout with practical schedule boxes, warning pictograms, realistic paper texture, small clinic-style metadata, and friendly pet illustrations.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: {동물·종} illustration occupies about 28–32% of the upper half, with the title block above and stacked schedule sections below.
- Background treatment: warm cream paper-like background with visible fine fiber grain, subtle printed-ink texture, lightly rounded poster corners, off-white edge space, and thin charcoal separators for a practical manual feel.
- Layout direction: top-to-bottom reading flow, with clearly separated day/week/month blocks, a food warning area, a tiny QR/contact zone, and realistic guide-poster metadata.
- Use {동물·종}, {일일 케어}, {주간 케어}, {월간 건강}, {주의 음식}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러}, {비율} placeholders throughout the infographic.
- Add small editorial details: “2026년 5월 업데이트”, “GUIDE NO. PET-247”, “우리동물 케어랩”, “상담 02-1234-5678”, “보호자 메모”, and a tiny page mark “CARE SHEET 01”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 12%): title in a bold, friendly Korean editorial style, centered, with a small pet icon beside it, a thin divider line below, and small header metadata: “2026년 5월 업데이트 · GUIDE NO. PET-247 · {비율}”.
- Hero illustration area (upper 30%): {동물·종} drawn as a cute but polished vector-style pet character with soft printed texture, surrounded by calendar dots, paw icons, a leash/toy silhouette, tiny heart stickers, and a light outline frame. Add a small caption under the pet: “오늘도 건강하게, 보호자와 함께”.
- Daily care panel (middle 18%): {일일 케어} presented inside a rounded rectangular schedule box with morning/noon/evening time labels and tiny pictograms for food bowl, walk, water, grooming, and rest. Include short Korean labels such as “아침 08:00”, “점심 13:00”, “저녁 19:00”, “체크 완료”.
- Weekly care panel (middle-lower 16%): {주간 케어} shown as a compact checklist card with checkmarks, bath brush, nail clipper, toothbrush, bedding, and toy-cleaning icons arranged in a tidy 2-column grid. Add small checklist text: “주 1회 확인”, “털/피부 상태”, “산책 장비 점검”.
- Monthly health panel (lower 14%): {월간 건강} displayed as a compact health reminder box with clinic cross icon, vaccine syringe icon, heartworm pill icon, weight scale icon, and a small date stamp area reading “다음 체크: 2026.06.01”. Use clear bullet spacing and a tiny note line: “이상 증상은 수의사 상담”.
- Food warning strip (lower 10%): {주의 음식} placed in a high-visibility caution band with red-orange warning pictograms, each food separated by dots or small warning triangles. Include Korean microcopy: “먹이면 안 돼요”, “소량도 주의”, “응급 시 병원 연락”.
- Bottom utility area (bottom 8%): {비주얼 결} and {컬러} summarized as small caption chips. Add a tiny QR-code-like square, contact line “우리동물 케어랩 · @petcare_note”, address-style line “서울시 반려동물 건강길 24”, sponsor/support area “협력: 동네동물병원”, and a small revision mark “REV. 05”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for title, Pretendard SemiBold for section headers, Noto Sans KR Regular for body text; title around 54–64px, body around 22–28px, compact labels 16–18px, metadata and captions around 12–15px.
- Color palette: {컬러} should resolve into cream #F6F0E4, warm amber #E6A14A, leaf green #5E8B4A, and charcoal #2E2E2E, with warning accents in muted red #D96B5F and tiny blue-gray clinic notes #6F7F8F.
- Border/shadow: rounded cards with 1.5px charcoal outlines, soft drop shadow 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), subtle paper texture overlay, fine halftone ink edges, and small sticker-like labels that feel printed on the sheet.
- Graphic details: use practical pictograms, paw-print dividers, calendar ticks, handwritten-style memo underlines, tiny barcode/QR-like utility marks, and veterinary handout cues while keeping every section readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean orthographic infographic look, like a flat-lay editorial poster shot with an overhead 35mm equivalent framing and no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: diffuse soft studio light from upper-left, very gentle fill from the right, natural paper shadows along the poster edges, and soft contrast without harsh specular highlights.
- Color grade: warm cream + amber + sage green + charcoal, with restrained saturation and slightly muted contemporary stationery tones.
- Material realism: printed A4 guide sheet with matte ink, tactile cream paper grain, lightly imperfect registration on tiny icons, and believable printed poster texture.

[6. MOOD]
Warm, dependable pet-care editorial — like a Kinfolk-style practical guide mixed with a gentle veterinary clinic handout and a caring refrigerator reminder sheet for 보호자.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문구 — “반려동물 케어 가이드”, “동물”, “일일”, “주간”, “월간”, “주의 음식”, “먹이면 안 돼요”, “2026년 5월 업데이트”, “우리동물 케어랩”.
- Visual invariants: cute {동물·종} illustration, schedule boxes, checklist cards, monthly health reminders, warning pictograms for harmful foods, QR/contact area, and bottom guide metadata must all appear clearly; layout must remain vertically structured and easy to scan.
- Text must be clean Korean without broken characters, and each care section should be readable at a glance.
- {일일 케어}, {주간 케어}, {월간 건강}, and {주의 음식} must feel like real guide content rather than placeholder filler, with concise Korean labels and practical care cues.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean clothing care instruction manual poster, A4 vertical layout, realistic printed household guide for laundry and fabric maintenance.
Laundry-symbol-led guide with a garment illustration, numbered steps, caution notes, revision/date labels, small reference metadata, and practical care details that feel like an actual insert sheet included with clothing packaging.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center a vertical A4-style care manual sheet in a 1024x1536 frame, photographed straight-on with visible paper grain, slight page curl, faint fold line, and realistic ink texture.
- Arrange the poster into a top title band, a fabric/care-symbol hero strip, three stacked step panels, a caution/footer zone, and a slim bottom metadata strip with barcode-style marks and contact-style microcopy.
- Use {의류·소재} as the main garment subject in the hero area, paired with {세탁 기호} as prominent iconography and a small fabric swatch callout.
- Keep all sections aligned to a precise editorial grid with thin dividers, rounded rectangular info boxes, section tabs, small numbering chips, and consistent panel rhythm.
- Add realistic instruction-sheet details: revision label “REV. 03”, date label “2026.05”, small storage note “보관용”, page marker “CARE GUIDE 01”, and a non-official barcode area at the lower right.
- Background may show a softly lit laundry-room tabletop surface with faint paper fibers, a subtle shadow under the sheet, and tiny printed registration/crop marks that support the manual-poster feeling.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title area (top 12%): Set a bold Korean heading reading “세탁·관리 사용설명서” centered in dark charcoal, with a smaller subline “옷감 손상을 줄이는 생활 세탁 가이드” beneath it; place “REV. 03 · 2026.05 · 보관용” as a small right-aligned label.
- Hero strip (upper-middle 18%): Show a neat garment illustration representing {의류·소재} on the left with seams, stitch hints, collar/cuff or hem details as appropriate; show a compact legend of {세탁 기호} icons on the right inside a bordered panel labeled “CARE SYMBOL CHECK”.
- Add a small fabric-info row below the hero strip with Korean micro labels such as “소재 확인”, “색상 분리”, “뒤집어 세탁”, and a tiny swatch box using {컬러}.
- Step 1 panel (middle-upper): Place “1️⃣ {단계 1}” in a numbered box with a washing-water icon, a light blue accent bar, and two short helper notes: “세탁 전 라벨 확인” and “지퍼·단추 잠그기”.
- Step 2 panel (middle): Place “2️⃣ {단계 2}” in a matching box with detergent scoop, basin, or washing-machine cue, plus concise checklist ticks such as “중성세제 권장” and “비슷한 색상끼리”.
- Step 3 panel (middle-lower): Place “3️⃣ {단계 3}” in a matching box, emphasizing drying guidance with a flat-lay towel, hanger cue, airflow arrow, and a tiny note “형태를 잡아 건조”.
- Caution block (bottom 18%): Highlight “주의 {주의사항}” in a bordered warning panel with a caution triangle icon, amber side stripe, and compact line breaks; add a secondary note line “고온·강한 마찰·장시간 담금은 변형의 원인이 될 수 있습니다.”
- Footer note (bottom edge): Add small supporting labels tied to {비주얼 결}, {컬러}, and {비율}, reinforcing that the layout is an icon-led laundry care guide; include “문의 02-1234-5678”, “www.care-note.kr”, page marker “01/01”, and a barcode-style graphic labeled “HOUSEHOLD REFERENCE”.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Border/shadow: thin 1.5 px cool-gray borders, rounded corners 14 px, soft drop shadow 0 4 px 12 px blur at 12% opacity to separate printed panels; add subtle offset ink registration and paper-fiber texture for realism.
- Use crisp vector-style laundry icons combined with realistic printed-paper rendering, small metadata labels, care checklist ticks, section tabs, dotted divider rules, and tiny barcode-like linework.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: even diffused studio light with no directional drama, like a high-key product manual photographed under large softboxes, with soft contact shadows around the paper edge.
- Color grade: cool white, slate gray, and laundry-blue with a single warning accent; realistic CMYK-style printed ink, matte paper texture, and slightly softened edges from real paper.

[6. MOOD]
Practical household instruction sheet — IKEA assembly manual clarity meets Japanese packaging infographic precision, enriched with the believable details of a real garment-care insert kept near a washing machine.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as follows: “세탁·관리 사용설명서”, “주의”, and the full verbatim content of {의류·소재}, {세탁 기호}, {단계 1}, {단계 2}, {단계 3}, {주의사항}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러}, {비율}.
- Additional Korean microcopy should be sharp and readable, including “옷감 손상을 줄이는 생활 세탁 가이드”, “보관용”, “소재 확인”, “색상 분리”, “뒤집어 세탁”, “세탁 전 라벨 확인”, “중성세제 권장”, and “형태를 잡아 건조”.

4. 6. Progress indicator: show {진행 표시} beneath or inside each screen as a dot stepper, with the active dot matching the current step and using the accent color system.

9. Color application: apply {컬러} across buttons, highlights, icons, progress dots, annotation stickers, and screen illustration accents while preserving a bright Korean fintech interface.
10. Finishing details: use crisp alignment, consistent corner radius, subtle paper grain, realistic app-screen layering, thin dividers, and restrained shadowing so the design feels polished and instructional.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Include document metadata in the header: {버전 정보}, {날짜}, {작성자}; include a bottom footer/legend using {푸터 정보}.
