[1. PURPOSE]
Korean cosmetics advertisement poster for a cover makeup brand campaign, with a product hero, polished model makeup showcase, promotional copy, price callout, and realistic retail-ad details.
Vertical commercial key visual for social, e-commerce, store display, and brand promo use, emphasizing coverage, makeup finish, shade usability, and value-driven positioning.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: product hero occupies the lower-left or center-left 35% of the frame, while the model makeup portrait occupies the upper-right 40–45%, creating a balanced ad split with strong commercial hierarchy.
- Background treatment: seamless studio backdrop with white base, soft coral-tinted accent wash, faint cosmetic powder texture, foundation smear accents, and subtle reflected light on the floor surface.
- Spacing and framing: headline/logo zone near the top, promotional badge beside the product, shade-chip strip and price/info zone anchored near the bottom, with secondary copy arranged like a real cosmetics campaign poster.
- Composition must follow {레이아웃} while keeping the product, model, headline, and campaign elements visually connected through shared lighting, coral accents, and beauty-retail typography.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 12–15%): place {카피·타이포} in a crisp brand-ad style, with the Korean logo wordmark larger than the English line, plus {캠페인명} and {프로모션기간} as realistic campaign metadata.
2) Product hero zone (middle-left 35%): feature {제품·소재} as a premium packshot cluster with realistic caps, applicator detail, compact/cushion reflection, legible label text, SKU-like shade names, and a natural shadow grounding the objects.
3) Model makeup zone (middle-right 40–45%): place a polished Korean beauty model portrait with smooth but skin-like texture, visible under-eye and blemish coverage finish, refined base makeup, coral lip/cheek harmony, and {모델캡션} as a small editorial note.
4) Coverage emphasis layer: add cosmetic swatches, beige foundation smear, cushion imprint, powder particles, before/after micro-callout, and two or three shade chips behind or beside the product to reinforce {시그니처 결}.
5) Retail information zone (bottom 10–14%): include {가격표기}, {제품혜택}, {구매CTA}, {하단정보}, a small QR-style purchase code, barcode-like retail strip, and fine-print product notes arranged as a believable beauty promotion footer.
6) Brand consistency layer: ensure the entire ad looks like {브랜드 톤} with a coherent K-beauty retail identity, while the cover-finish message remains the strongest visual and typographic priority.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean headline text at large ad-poster scale, with Noto Sans KR Medium or Inter for supporting English, price, shade labels, and retail fine print; maintain tight modern spacing and high legibility.
- Color palette: use the exact campaign family of {컬러 팔레트}, anchored by white #FFFFFF and a soft coral accent around #F48C8A to #FFB2A8, with warm beige foundation tones, light gray retail microtext, and brand-tone matching neutrals.
- Graphic details: use rounded coral promotional badges, thin divider rules, shade-chip labels, compact QR block, barcode-style footer mark, soft product drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, and subtle translucent cosmetic textures.
- Copy hierarchy: primary headline first, brand/logo second, product name and benefit third, then price and CTA; keep all Korean typography crisp enough to read at poster scale.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end beauty campaign look shot on a Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm or 110mm lens at f/8 for product clarity and controlled depth, portrait framing like a premium cosmetic print ad.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle rim light to separate hair and product edges, with clean specular control on packaging.
- Color grade: bright commercial beauty grade with clean whites, soft coral highlights, natural skin tones, warm beige cosmetic swatches, and slightly lifted highlights to preserve a fresh cover-makeup finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium K-beauty advertising editorial — polished department-store cosmetic campaign feel mixed with realistic drugstore promotion details, trustworthy coverage messaging, fresh coral energy, and approachable value appeal.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "더샘", "THE SAEM", "커버 퍼펙션", "가격", "₩7,500", "5월 한정".
- 포스터 내 실제 렌더링 문구 예시: "잡티는 가볍게, 피부는 완벽하게", "24H 커버 핏", "커버 퍼펙션 컨실러", "오늘만 온라인 특가", "전국 더샘 매장 및 공식몰".
- Layout invariants: keep the composition as a product hero plus model makeup ad, with headline, promo badge, price callout, shade chips, QR-style purchase block, and footer retail information all supporting the same cover makeup campaign.
- Render all packaging, logo typography, price, shade names, barcode-like strip, and Korean microcopy crisply, with readable product hierarchy and undistorted logo shapes.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or real person identity swaps
- Distorted packaging labels, warped logo typography, unreadable Korean copy

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean character-and-fruit cosmetic ad poster in the TONYMOLY brand family, vertical 1024x1536 retail promo layout for social feed, store POP, and poster use.
Bright, playful commercial graphic with a product hero, mascot-like character accents, glossy fruit freshness cues, and realistic retail information such as campaign title, promo dates, benefit strip, price label, QR-style coupon box, and hashtag copy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center {제품명} / {제품·소재} in the lower-middle 38% of the frame as the primary product hero, with the label facing front and the packaging finish clearly readable.
- Build a cheerful character-and-fruit frame around the hero: {캐릭터명} on one side, {대표 과일} pieces, jelly droplets, fruit slices, sticker tags, and rounded mascot shapes on the other side.
- Use a high-key beauty-ad background with pastel gradient panels, glossy acrylic platform, fruit-colored splash ribbons, soft studio shadows, and small retail sticker callouts that make the poster feel like a real cosmetic launch display.
- Place the headline and brand area in the upper third, a benefit/coupon strip near the lower third, and a compact store information footer at the bottom; keep the product visually dominant within a safe 12% print/social margin.
- Apply {브랜드 톤} across the whole ad so the execution feels like a specific Korean cosmetics campaign, not a generic cute illustration.
- Follow {레이아웃} and {비율} so the poster reads immediately as a product-first cosmetics advertisement with character collaboration and fruit visual cues.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top brand zone upper 16%: place the English wordmark text "TONYMOLY" clearly, then add {프로모션명} as a Korean campaign title and a small seasonal label such as "2026 과즙 케어 캠페인" or "NEW FRUIT EDITION".
- Main headline zone upper-middle 18%: render {메인 카피} as the largest Korean phrase, with {서브 카피} below it in a friendly ad-safe hierarchy.
- Hero product zone middle 42%: render {제품명} / {제품·소재} as a crisp commercial product object with polished highlights, readable front label, clean cap/tube/pack edges, and a beauty-retail finish.
- Character-and-fruit zone left/right flanks: build {시그니처 비주얼} using {캐릭터명}, {대표 과일}, fruit peels, floating jelly cubes, tiny hearts, sparkle decals, sticker tabs, and rounded decorative badges that feel intentionally designed.
- Promotion strip lower 14%: add readable retail information: {혜택 문구}, {가격 정보}, {행사 기간}, and {판매처}; include a small QR-style coupon square, tiny barcode-like retail mark, and a micro line "재고 소진 시 조기 종료" in Korean.
- Social footer zone bottom 10%: include {해시태그}, a small save/share icon row, customer-service style microcopy, and a store address/contact placeholder line such as "토니모리 공식몰 · 전국 매장 동시 진행".
- Decorative graphics: add fruit juice splashes, glossy pastel bubbles, label stickers reading "촉촉", "상큼", "한정 혜택", and a small character speech bubble, while preserving a polished commercial arrangement.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean copy, and a clean geometric sans-serif for English; headline around 42–64 px equivalent, subcopy 20–28 px equivalent, promo footer 14–18 px equivalent, with crisp anti-aliased edges.
- Korean headline hierarchy: {메인 카피} must be the dominant phrase; {서브 카피}, {혜택 문구}, {행사 기간}, {가격 정보}, and {판매처} should read like real cosmetic retail poster text.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} as the core scheme, with bright fruit hues like coral, strawberry pink, tangerine orange, lemon yellow, mint, cream white, and glossy translucent accents.
- Border/shadow: apply a soft studio drop shadow with 4 px y-offset, 14 px blur, 18% opacity beneath the product, fruit pieces, character stickers, QR-style coupon box, and acrylic platform.
- Layout details: include small decorative tag shapes, coupon tabs, rounded sticker labels, dotted divider lines, retail barcode-like detail, and social micro icons, all aligned to the vertical poster grid.
- Material finish: make packaging plastic, balm tube, mask pouch, or compact surfaces slightly glossy; make fruit pieces juicy with visible pulp, rind, and tiny moisture beads.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing commercial product shot, equivalent to a 70–85mm lens at f/8 for a tight, distortion-free advertising look.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, soft but defined product shadow, controlled highlight sheen on packaging and glossy fruit surfaces.
- Color grade: candy-bright retail ad grade with clean white base, saturated fruit colors, glossy pastel contrast, and lively Korean beauty-store display energy.
- Rendering finish: polished product photography mixed with premium 3D character-sticker graphics, smooth vector-like typography, and realistic printed-poster details.

[6. MOOD]
Playful Korean cosmetics campaign — magazine-grade beauty retail ad with the cheerful energy of a youthful character collaboration, fruit-scented freshness, limited-time promotion, and friendly store-poster realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: ensure every Korean string is clean and readable, especially "{프로모션명}", "{메인 카피}", "{서브 카피}", "{혜택 문구}", "{행사 기간}", "{가격 정보}", "{판매처}", and "{해시태그}".
- English text accuracy: render "TONYMOLY" clearly if used, with correct letter order, no reversed letters, and no broken glyphs.
- Required readable rendered text examples: "{메인 카피}", "{혜택 문구}", "{행사 기간}", "{가격 정보}", "{판매처}", "촉촉", "상큼", "한정 혜택", "재고 소진 시 조기 종료".
- Product priority: {제품명} / {제품·소재} must remain the hero, while {캐릭터명}, {대표 과일}, sticker tags, coupon strip, and social footer support the campaign story.
- Commercial realism: the poster should include believable beauty-ad details such as QR-style coupon square, tiny barcode-like retail mark, save/share micro icons, hashtag line, promo period, and store/online availability.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or malformed Hangul syllables
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or impersonation

1. Background layer — Build a bright white cosmetic-ad base with pastel pink and multicolor geometric accents, layered rounded blobs, washi-tape stickers, makeup swatch marks, tiny sparkle icons, soft gloss bubbles, and playful paper fragments that frame the campaign.
2. Hero product area — Place {제품·소재} in a glossy commercial pack-shot style with crisp edges, vivid product surfaces, readable label areas, clear cap reflections, and a slightly elevated center focus so the product feels immediately recognizable.
3. Character illustration zone — Add a cute energetic illustration element in the upper-right or side area, with bold outlines, simplified facial features, blush cheeks, playful pose language, and a small speech bubble that says “컬러 착붙!” or “오늘 무드 완료”.
4. Copy zone — Set the brand/copy area with {카피·타이포}: large “peripera” and “페리페라”, then {캠페인명}, {출시문구}, and {혜택문구} beneath it in a lively mobile-readable hierarchy.
5. Retail information strip — Add a lower or side information band containing {가격정보}, {날짜라벨}, {채널정보}, shade chips with short Korean labels such as “로즈핑크”, “코랄베이지”, “체리레드”, and a QR-style shopping box labeled “바로 만나보기”.
6. Social proof details — Add small UI-like micro elements: heart/save/share icons, @peripera_korea-style handle, {해시태그}, “NEW SHADE”, “1+1 WEEK”, or “오늘의 픽” sticker tags where appropriate.
7. Layout balance — Ensure {레이아웃} is clearly visible as a product-plus-character composition, with the product holding visual priority and the illustration, stickers, swatches, and promo details acting as charm-building secondary elements.
8. Final polish — Add crisp highlights, controlled reflections, dewy sparkle accents, glossy ink smears, small printed texture on stickers, and a polished magazine-ad finish so the image feels like a real cosmetics promotional key visual rather than a generic illustration.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold for Korean headline text, Noto Sans KR Medium for secondary copy, and a rounded hand-drawn accent style for small playful details; headline size should feel poster-like and mobile-readable.
- Main rendered text hierarchy: “peripera” at brand level, “페리페라” as Korean brand support, {캠페인명} as campaign headline, then {출시문구}, {혜택문구}, {가격정보}, {날짜라벨}, {채널정보}, and {해시태그} as smaller but legible poster information.
- Color palette: Use {컬러 팔레트} as the base, anchored by peripera pink, bright white, pastel peach, mint, lavender, and saturated pop colors for sticker accents, swatches, and promo badges.
- Border/shadow: Add soft drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity under the product, stickers, shade chips, QR box, and character cutout; keep product edges glossy and sharply separated from the colorful paper layers.
- Decorative graphics: Use hearts, stars, small cherries, lip-print marks, glossy droplets, rounded speech bubbles, price-badge stickers, and cosmetic texture swatches to make the advertisement feel printed, shoppable, and campaign-ready.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Studio pack-shot look, comparable to a Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.4 lens for product depth and a secondary 50mm perspective feel for balanced ad framing.
- Lighting: Bright studio key light from upper-left at 45°, soft fill from front-right, subtle rim highlights on product edges, and controlled reflection handling for a polished cosmetic ad look.
- Color grade: Clean white + candy pink + pastel rainbow grade with high clarity, vibrant saturation, smooth commercial contrast, glossy product highlights, and soft editorial warmth.

[6. MOOD]
Cute beauty campaign editorial — a playful Korean cosmetics ad key visual with a polished youth-brand pop aesthetic, similar in energy to a high-end magazine beauty spread mixed with a shoppable social-feed launch poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “peripera”, “페리페라”, “{캠페인명}”, “{출시문구}”, “{혜택문구}”, “{가격정보}”, “{날짜라벨}”, “{채널정보}”, “{해시태그}”, 그리고 사용자가 넣는 {카피·타이포} 안의 한글 문구.
- Rendered poster copy example should include natural Korean ad text such as “신상 컬러 출시”, “입술에 착붙”, “오늘의 무드 완성”, “바로 만나보기”, “공식몰 단독 혜택”, and shade labels like “로즈핑크 / 코랄베이지 / 체리레드”.
- Layout invariant: product remains the primary hero, character illustration remains secondary, and the overall composition must stay cute, colorful, shoppable, and ad-like.
- Product label areas, price badge, date label, QR-style shopping box, and Korean headline text must be sharp enough to read at mobile poster size.
- No broken Korean characters; all visible Korean text must render cleanly and legibly.

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or deepfake-like faces without permission

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

2. Product cluster (lower-middle 20%): {제품·소재} arranged as a premium lineup, slightly angled toward camera, with visible cap edges, printed shade labels, compact/palette/lip product details, clear separation between items, subtle studio reflections, and scattered color swatches on a smooth glossy surface.

6. Layout balance: keep the composition centered around {레이아웃}, with a clear commercial structure that reads instantly on mobile while still feeling like a real printed beauty campaign poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a mix of Pretendard Bold and Noto Sans KR SemiBold for Korean copy, paired with a clean condensed sans for the English brand wordmark; headline size should feel campaign-level, with tight optical alignment, crisp edges, and realistic small-print hierarchy.
- Color palette: build from {컬러 팔레트}, but sharpen it with high-contrast beauty-ad tones such as pure white #FFFFFF, vivid cherry red #E6003A, electric coral #FF5A5F, vivid pink #FF4D8D, and bright cyan #4EDBFF.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame beauty campaign look, shot on a 85mm f/1.4 portrait lens for the model and a 50mm lens for product clarity, with shallow depth of field on the face and sharp product edges.
- Lighting: studio setup with a large softbox at 45° front-left, a color gel rim from the right, and a small fill light below camera to keep the makeup readable and polished; follow {무드·라이팅} while keeping vivid rim highlights on hair, cheekbone, and product packaging.

[7. CRITICAL]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean instant ramen advertising poster, vertical product hero ad for social media, store standee, and OOH-style promotional use.
High-impact brand-forward composition with macro food realism, vivid steam, retail promotion information, and bold Korean typography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main product hero occupies the lower-middle 55% of the frame: a steaming bowl and package presentation of {제품명}, with the cooked noodles, broth, garnish, and pack front clearly identifiable.
- Top header zone contains {브랜드명} logo-like typography, {메인카피}, and a strong launch/promotion headline hierarchy.
- Mid-right or mid-left callout area includes {서브카피}, {프로모션문구}, {가격}, and a small “한정 행사” style retail badge.
- Bottom information strip includes {행사기간}, {판매처}, {매장정보}, a barcode-style graphic, QR-style square graphic, and small legal/product notes in Korean.
- Steam/backlight accents rise behind the noodles from upper-left and upper-right, creating a hot freshly-cooked cue with dramatic appetite appeal.
- Background is a studio advertising surface with subtle paper-grain texture, gradient panels, halftone dots, ramen-wave graphics, and brand-color blocks using {컬러팔레트}.
- Layout should feel commercial, energetic, and realistic: hero product first, bold copy second, then practical retail details and decorative Korean ad graphics.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer — build a studio ad backdrop with a red-to-warm-yellow tonal field inspired by {컬러팔레트}, soft vignette, diagonal retail poster panels, small noodle-line patterns, chili-flake dots, and subtle paper texture.
2. Hero product zone — place {제품명} as the central food subject with crisp macro detail: springy noodle strands lifted by chopsticks, glossy broth/oil sheen, scallion slices, chili powder, sesame, optional half egg, and the package angled behind or beside the bowl for instant recognition.
3. Product packaging realism — make the pack front readable with {브랜드명}, ramen-name typography, flavor cues, nutrition-style side panel hints, crimped packaging edges, reflective plastic highlights, and believable print alignment.
4. Steam/light effects — add dense but elegant steam trails behind the hero, backlit so vapor reads clearly against the warm background; use warm white highlights, amber rim glow, and small condensation sparkle near the bowl rim.
5. Typography block — set {메인카피} large near the top, {서브카피} beneath it, and {프로모션문구} as a bright burst label; design the type like a premium Korean supermarket/brand campaign poster.
6. Retail information block — add visible promotional details: price tag {가격}, event period {행사기간}, store/online destination {판매처}, store information {매장정보}, “오늘 저녁 한 그릇” microcopy, barcode-style mark, QR-style mark, and small Korean disclaimer text.
7. Supporting brand tone — integrate {브랜드톤} and {시그니처비주얼} through the overall structure, using Korean ramen cues such as red/yellow impact color, steam, spicy broth shine, bold Hangul, and convenience-store shelf-pop energy.
8. Composition balance — keep the product hero larger than life, layer the headlines and callouts around it with clear hierarchy, and use decorative elements only where they reinforce appetite, price, or campaign information.
9. Final polish — sharpen product edges, preserve readable package typography, maintain clean separation between steam and background, and make all Korean advertising text look intentionally printed rather than randomly generated.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main headline, with compact tracking and strong vertical presence; secondary text can use Pretendard SemiBold. Use a condensed sans style for the price, short callouts, and retail tags.
- Color palette: {컬러팔레트} anchored by 농심 red #D81F26, bright yellow #FFD200, clean white #FFFFFF, warm noodle-gold highlights, chili-red accents, and deep soy-brown shadow notes.
- Poster graphics: include a bold price sticker, angled ribbon label, small barcode, QR-style square, date strip, dotted comic burst, and ramen-wave pattern details to make the ad feel like a finished Korean retail poster.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the bowl and package, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; headline and price may use a white outline or red shadow for contrast.
- Food styling: broth should look hot and glossy, noodles elastic and separated, garnish fresh, chopsticks natural, packaging crinkled and dimensional, with realistic condensation and steam.
- Graphic treatment should remain crisp, commercial, and packaged-food-advertisement clean, with sharp product detail and saturated retail color contrast.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 look with an 80mm macro lens at f/8 for ultra-detailed food clarity, controlled perspective, and sharp product edges.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a warm softbox, plus a strong backlight/rim to catch steam; subtle fill from front-right to keep noodles and packaging readable.
- Color grade: saturated Korean convenience-store brand palette — vivid red, bright yellow, neutral white, and warm amber steam highlights with clean contrast.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean instant noodle campaign — hot, spicy, familiar, appetizing, and promotional, like a major Korean retail launch poster seen at a supermarket entrance or convenience-store window.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Required Korean rendered text must include: “{브랜드명}”, “{제품명}”, “{메인카피}”, “{서브카피}”, “{프로모션문구}”, “{가격}”, “{행사기간}”, “{판매처}”, “{매장정보}”.
- Add small realistic poster text in Korean such as “오늘 저녁 한 그릇”, “진한 국물”, “쫄깃한 면발”, “행사상품”, “매운맛 포인트”, “이미지는 연출된 예입니다”.
- The composition must clearly read as a Korean ramen commercial ad with a strong hero product, bold brand typography, real promotional information, and visible retail poster details.
- Keep all noodle strands, bowl geometry, chopsticks, packaging edges, steam shapes, barcode/QR-style graphics, and price label visually plausible and crisp.
- Maintain exact legibility for all Korean characters; no broken Hangul, no mixed-up spacing, and no accidental English substitutions for required Korean text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness
- Random unreadable pseudo-Korean text

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: Place the main Korean masthead “마켓컬리” in large type at the upper-left, with a small campaign code “MORNING FRESH 2026” and date label “2026.05 새벽 캠페인” aligned near the upper-right.

- Copy block: Set {메인 카피}, {서브 카피}, and {배송 시간} in a clean promotional hierarchy, with the brand name largest, the delivery claim secondary, and supporting copy in a compact sans-serif stack.
- Promotional details: Add a rounded badge reading {프로모션 문구}, a campaign period line {행사 기간}, and a small app instruction line {앱 안내}; include a QR-code-like square marked “APP” and a tiny barcode-style delivery label for realism.
- Layout logic: Use {레이아웃} with a premium magazine-ad rhythm; the hero should look curated and plentiful, and the typography should balance the weight of the food cluster, labels, and lower information band.
- Size lockup: Keep the vertical balance consistent with {비율}, ensuring the poster reads clearly on mobile screens, in-app banners, and social placements.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for modern sans-serif hierarchy, with bold 700–900 weight for the main title and 400–500 weight for supporting copy; small labels can use 18–24px while the headline should feel like 72–110px scale.

- Print finish: Use a premium editorial poster finish with subtle paper grain, sharp contrast on text, gentle satin highlights on packaging, and tactile details in stickers, labels, bags, and produce surfaces.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Shot like a high-end food campaign on a Phase One IQ4 with 80mm lens at f/8, top-down-to-slight-front hybrid angle for clean packaging and ingredient clarity.

- Additional Korean copy should be readable and correctly spaced: “첫 주문 5천원 할인”, “2026.05.01–05.31”, “앱에서 더 신선하게”, “오전 7시 전 도착”.

- The hero food cluster must stay neatly composed and commercially believable, with realistic proportions, ingredient textures, chilled-package details, and no unnatural deformation.

- Use a real retail poster hierarchy: brand masthead, event ribbon, hero products, oversized {메인 가격}, benefit badge, small product list, coupon/QR area, and store information footer.
- Background treatment: bright convenience-store interior with shelf rails, price-tag strips, refrigerator glow, overhead LED panels, checkout-counter hints, and glossy printed poster texture.
- Composition is upright and commercial, with a straight-on poster layout that feels mounted near the entrance of a 24-hour store; include energetic accent shapes, sale stickers, dividers, and small barcode-style retail details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]

- Coupon and store info area: add a small QR coupon box labeled {쿠폰 문구}, a barcode-like scan strip, {매장명}, {주소}, {연락처}, and {하단 안내} in the bottom footer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use bold sans-serif retail typography such as Pretendard ExtraBold / Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean, compact tracking for the price, and a clean high-visibility masthead feel for the brand line.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with crisp white fields, saturated convenience-store red/yellow/green accents, warm food highlights, cool refrigerator blues, and small black text support where needed.

- Composition invariants: product hero + large price layout, store-promo hierarchy, straight-on poster framing, crisp Korean typography, realistic convenience-store products and printed flyer texture.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Use {레이아웃} as the composition rule: big product hero, bold price ticket, secondary item grid, date/store details, coupon badge, and barcode-style membership strip arranged with retail-poster hierarchy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: Set a bold convenience-store masthead treatment using “GS25” and {프로모션명}, slightly left-aligned with compact tracking, blue header block, small “NEW ARRIVAL” tag, and a red corner sticker reading “이번 주 추천”.

5. Event information strip: Include {행사 기간}, {매장 정보}, {연락처}, membership/coupon notice {쿠폰 문구}, small barcode-style graphic, QR-coupon placeholder graphic, and a sponsor/partner area labeled “제휴 혜택 안내”.

- Top branding zone (about 15%): {브랜드명} and {브랜드톤} appear as the primary identity cue, paired with {행사명} and a small campaign ribbon reading “{시그니처메시지}”.
- Mid-to-lower price zone (about 20%): {대표가격} is placed in a large high-contrast price badge, supported by “가격 혜택”, “오늘의 특가”, and concise product benefit text.
- Bottom retail information zone (about 20%): include {행사기간}, {매장명}, {주소}, {연락처}, delivery/install notes, QR-style coupon box, and small product category tabs.
- Background uses a warm studio-retail showroom with beige wall panels, natural wood texture, soft fabric details, amber highlight, and realistic commercial depth matching {컬러팔레트}.
- Keep the framing stable and poster-like, with the furniture hero clearly readable while allowing natural showroom props and retail labels to make the advertisement feel lived-in and credible.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer — Build a studio-style Korean furniture showroom with matte beige wall panels, light wood floor, soft curtain texture, a warm area rug, small ceramic vase, and amber ambience.
2. Hero product layer — Present {주요제품} as the dominant visual element, crisp-edged and premium but approachable, with realistic perspective, visible fabric/wood grain, and tidy retail staging.
3. Brand identity layer — Place “{브랜드명}” near the upper area in a clean ad-header position with a small spine-like vertical credit strip on the left reading “LIVING VALUE CAMPAIGN · {행사기간}”.
4. Value message layer — Emphasize {시그니처메시지} through friendly commercial cues: family-friendly copy, small benefit icons, installment/delivery notes, and category labels such as “거실”, “침실”, “주방”.
5. Pricing emphasis layer — Reserve a bold price callout area connected to {대표가격}; add smaller comparison-style text such as “이번 주 한정”, “배송 상담 가능”, and “가격 확인 필수”.
6. Supporting information layer — Add realistic retail blocks: {혜택문구}, sale-period label, store name, address, contact number, QR coupon square, barcode-like event code, and small divider lines.
7. Decorative commercial polish — Add soft shadows, warm material highlights, rounded price stickers, small arrow tags, coupon perforation details, and catalog-style dividers so the composition feels like a polished furniture advertisement.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main headline and body copy, bold for pricing, medium for supporting text, with sizes roughly 72–110px for the main brand/price hierarchy and 28–40px for details.
- Color palette: use {컬러팔레트} as the base, with beige #E9DDCC, wood brown #A67C52, warm amber #D79A5B, deep text brown #3E2A1E, off-white #F7F2EA, and a red-orange sale accent #E4572E.
- Graphic system: rounded price badges, thin catalog dividers, small benefit icons, QR-style coupon box, barcode-like event code, and retail label stickers should support the product and pricing hierarchy.
- Layout: {레이아웃}; top brand banner, central furniture hero, right or lower price badge, bottom store information strip, and small category tabs arranged in a realistic Korean sale-poster hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame commercial product photography, 50mm lens at f/5.6 for balanced perspective and crisp furniture edges.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle warm rim light to separate the hero from the background.
- Color grade: warm cream + wood brown + amber commercial grade with controlled contrast and a slightly polished catalog finish.
- Material rendering: realistic sofa fabric weave, matte wood grain, soft rug fibers, paper-like coupon texture, and printed ink clarity for all Korean text.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean furniture retail campaign — warm showroom-commercial aesthetic with practical home-shopping clarity, friendly family value, and credible sale-event energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 한글 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: “{브랜드명}”, “가성비”, “가구”, “가격”, “오늘의 특가”, “{대표가격}”, “{행사기간}”, “{매장명}”, “{연락처}”.
- Include 2–3 readable feature headlines in Korean: “우리 집 분위기 새로고침”, “거실·침실·주방 가구 모음”, “배송·설치 상담 가능”.
- Include realistic retail microcopy in Korean: “행사코드 DS-247”, “QR 쿠폰 확인”, “상담 후 맞춤 견적”, “일부 품목 조기 마감”.
- Composition invariants: the hero product must remain the dominant center focus, pricing must be visually emphasized, and the layout must retain a family-friendly value-ad structure with store and sale information.
- Maintain clean Korean typography with no broken characters, no misspellings, and no warped text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or fake endorsements
- Misleading government-style badges

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean office furniture advertisement poster, premium corporate brand hero layout with product-and-solution positioning for social and print use.
Realistic editorial ad composition that communicates workspace credibility, product clarity, and brand refinement through a lived-in contemporary office scene, campaign information, product notes, and practical contact details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero area: {제품·소재} arranged as the primary focus inside a real workspace setting with desks, chairs, partitions, meeting surfaces, monitors, notebooks, cable trays, acoustic panels, documents, a small plant, and daily office objects that support the furniture story; keep the scene vertically stacked for a 1024x1536 poster.
- Brand presence: {브랜드 톤} represented through restrained corporate styling, a clear “퍼시스” brand mark, and a campaign label such as “2026 WORKPLACE COLLECTION” embedded naturally into the poster system.
- Signature structure: {시그니처 결} should be visible in how desk, seating, partitions, storage, monitor arms, and meeting surfaces relate to each other in a practical solution-oriented arrangement.
- Lighting and mood zone: {무드·라이팅} across the full scene, with clean highlights on product edges, tactile material surfaces, realistic shadows under legs and chairs, and readable copy panels integrated into the architecture.
- Palette and hierarchy: {컬러 팔레트} used to separate hero products, background architecture, product labels, and typography zones with a controlled premium corporate look.
- Typography zone: {카피·타이포} placed in a clear advertising hierarchy with strong brand recognition, concise supporting copy, small product callouts, and realistic campaign information.
- Layout balance: {레이아웃} with a tall hero upper-to-middle zone, brand and headline near the upper area, product feature blurbs along the side or lower middle, and a detailed information footer near the lower third.
- Aspect and framing: {비율} maintained as a vertical poster composition with crisp spacing, disciplined alignment, and enough environmental context to feel like a photographed office campaign rather than a sterile catalog mockup.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background plane: build a contemporary office environment with neutral architectural surfaces, glass partition lines, fabric acoustic texture, faint ceiling grid, floor reflections, pinboard details, and real workplace traces that make the furniture feel installed and used.
2. Hero furniture cluster: place {제품·소재} in a realistic office configuration that suggests actual use, with the main workstation as anchor and task chairs, partitions, storage modules, lounge or meeting table elements supporting the composition.
3. Brand atmosphere layer: infuse {브랜드 톤} through corporate confidence, polished edges, modular planning, and a solution-driven workplace presentation style; include small branded signage reading “퍼시스 WORK SOLUTION”.
4. Visual signature layer: express {시그니처 결} through modular alignment, practical spacing, cable management, desk-to-storage rhythm, chair placement, and an integrated workplace system feel.
5. Light shaping: render {무드·라이팅} with clean directional brightness, soft shadows, controlled reflections, and visible material depth on wood grain, fabric mesh, matte metal, laminate, and partition surfaces.
6. Color control: apply {컬러 팔레트} as the dominant corporate palette, using the accent color as precise cues in icon labels, small dividers, chair fabric, or poster information tags.
7. Copy block placement: set {카피·타이포} in a structured ad layout with the main Korean brand line prominent, supporting English line secondary, and compact workplace benefit copy; add short feature blurbs such as “집중을 돕는 모듈 구조”, “팀의 속도에 맞춘 배치”, “소재와 동선의 균형”.
8. Information footer: design the lower information area described by {레이아웃} as a realistic campaign footer with campaign title, date, showroom or consultation detail, QR-code area, small barcode/catalog code, website, phone number, and product material notes.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold for the main Korean headline, Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium for supporting lines, and a clean sans-serif English companion; headline around 52–72px feel, supporting copy around 22–28px feel, micro-information around 12–18px feel.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} should read as charcoal #2B2D30, white #F7F7F4, with one restrained accent tone such as muted blue-gray or muted green depending on the brand tone.
- Poster information design: include realistic advertising details in Korean, for example “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “오피스 솔루션 상담 예약”, “서울 쇼룸 10:00–18:00”, “www.fursys.com”, “1588-0000”, “CATALOG CODE FS-WORK-26”, plus a small QR area and a barcode-style block.
- Product callouts: add 3–5 small leader-line labels near furniture details, such as “인체공학 시트”, “배선 정리 시스템”, “저소음 파티션”, “모듈형 데스크”, “친환경 마감재”.
- Border/shadow: use soft editorial shadowing, roughly 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with a premium print-ad finish and tactile depth.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame commercial photography look, 35mm lens for the overall workspace scene with mild perspective depth, paired with a 50mm detail feel for product clarity.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, clean office reflections controlled for premium readability, with diffused daylight that feels like a high-end workplace shoot.
- Color grade: cool neutral corporate grade with charcoal, white, and a single accent note; preserve natural material tones and keep saturation disciplined.
- Realism details: include believable scale, seams, screws, fabric weave, subtle fingerprints on glass, paper edges, monitor glow, cable ports, chair casters, and floor contact shadows so the furniture reads as real and purchasable.

[6. MOOD]
Premium corporate furniture campaign — sleek workplace editorial with a Magma / Dezeen office feature feel, elevated by realistic showroom-campaign details, product annotations, and a calm professional workday atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — “퍼시스”, “워크”, 그리고 필요한 경우 {카피·타이포} 안에 포함된 한글 카피.
- Additional Korean text must remain crisp and readable when included: “2026 WORKPLACE COLLECTION”, “오피스 솔루션 상담 예약”, “집중을 돕는 모듈 구조”, “팀의 속도에 맞춘 배치”, “소재와 동선의 균형”, “서울 쇼룸 10:00–18:00”, “www.fursys.com”.
- Layout invariants: office hero composition, furniture-as-solution framing, vertical ad hierarchy, realistic workplace environment, product callouts, and compact information footer must remain consistent.
- Typography must stay crisp and legible with no broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

Vertical poster composition for brand campaign use, with realistic interior styling, readable Korean editorial cover text, and a premium lived-in showroom atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Keep the scene balanced and editorial, with {레이아웃} guiding the overall structure and clear visual hierarchy between hero product, masthead, cover lines, barcode area, and supporting interior accents.
- Use {브랜드 톤} to determine the brand personality, while preserving a polished luxury furniture advertisement look.
- Add magazine-cover authenticity: issue number “VOL.247”, date label “2026년 5월호”, small price “₩7,500”, barcode block at lower-right, tiny spine text along the left edge, and a small credit line near the bottom.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero zone: Showcase {제품·소재} as the dominant focal element, styled like a premium catalog centerpiece but placed within a believable furnished room; show tactile material texture, seams, grain, cushions, legs, reflections, and crisp silhouette edges.
2. Interior context: Surround the hero with luxury home elements that reinforce {시그니처 결}: walnut side table, warm ivory rug, brushed metal floor lamp, linen curtains, stacked design books, ceramic object, fresh branches in a vase, and a muted abstract artwork.
3. Lighting layer: Apply {무드·라이팅} so the furniture surfaces reveal premium depth, soft highlights, natural shadow falloff, and convincing contact shadows on the floor and rug.
4. Color hierarchy: Build the full palette around {컬러 팔레트}, keeping the warm base tones dominant and allowing gold/charcoal accents where they strengthen contrast, typography, lamp details, or small decor.
5. Typography layer: Place {카피·타이포} in a magazine-ad layout with clear hierarchy: large top masthead “CASAMIA”, Korean title line “까사미아”, main cover line “나다운 집, 깊어지는 품격”, and 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs.

7. Layout finish: Match {레이아웃} with a refined editorial grid, readable text zones, layered interior depth, and a sophisticated ad composition that feels like a premium home magazine cover.
8. Format consistency: Keep the entire visual aligned to {비율}, with all major elements comfortably readable in a tall vertical poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean copy in medium to semibold weight, paired with a refined serif-like English treatment for brand emphasis; title size should be large and editorial, subtitle and supporting copy smaller with elegant tracking.
- Required cover text placement: Top masthead “CASAMIA”; near masthead or hero area “까사미아”; main Korean headline “나다운 집, 깊어지는 품격”; feature blurbs “봄의 거실을 바꾸는 소재”, “우드와 패브릭의 조화”, “프리미엄 리빙 가이드”.
- Magazine metadata: Add “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “₩7,500”, “MODEL: 루체 소파 03”, “@casamia_living”, and tiny left-spine text “CASAMIA HOME EDITORIAL 2026 MAY”.
- Barcode area: Place a small realistic barcode block at the lower-right or lower-left, integrated into the cover design, with tiny numeric text below it.

Premium interior editorial — comparable to a Kinfolk x Architectural Digest luxury home spread with the polished elegance of a high-end Scandinavian furniture campaign. The image should feel like an expensive real magazine cover photographed in a styled apartment showroom, not a flat mockup.

- English text accuracy: 반드시 다음 영문 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: “CASAMIA”.

- Composition invariant: luxury furniture hero remains the clear focal point, with editorial typography, magazine metadata, barcode area, and interior styling supporting it rather than competing for attention.

[INPUT]

- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Modern Korean lifestyle brand advertisement poster, vertical editorial retail composition with a product hero, styled collage accents, price/event information, and realistic store-campaign details for social-media and print use.
Brand-forward home-living campaign visual that feels like a polished department-store leaflet page: aspirational, shoppable, tactile, and information-rich while keeping product clarity and Korean copy readability strong.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall frame: tall 1024x1536 poster with a centered product hero occupying about 55% of the height, a supporting style collage zone on one side, and a compact but content-rich information zone for {카피·타이포}, campaign date, prices, store details, and CTA labels.
- Background treatment: warm off-white studio backdrop with visible matte paper grain, soft beige floor plane, natural product shadows, folded leaflet texture, tiny printed registration marks, and subtle retail-page realism.
- Framing details: include realistic catalog-ad elements such as small product-code labels, price tags, coupon strip, QR-code placeholder area, barcode-like block, delivery/pickup icon row, and a small footer with address/contact information.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as the configurable direction for the campaign.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero zone (center 55%): present the main lifestyle product grouping from {제품·소재} as the visual anchor, arranged in a balanced modern home-shopping set with one dominant item and several smaller supporting items; show real tactile materials, fabric seams, ceramic edges, wood grain, woven texture, glass reflections, paper tags, and believable product scale.
- Collage zone: build a refined mini collage with 3–5 product snippets, overlapping paper-cut cards, floating swatch tiles, close-up material crops, lifestyle detail photos, and tidy editorial alignment so the assortment feels broad and retail-ready.
- Copy zone: place {카피·타이포} in a clear top or mid text block with strong hierarchy, then add short Korean retail blurbs such as “오늘의 집을 더 편안하게”, “봄 리빙 페어”, “신상품 입고”, “온라인 단독 혜택” where appropriate.
- Promotion and info zone: include realistic event details: “2026 SPRING LIVING FAIR”, “기간 05.01–05.31”, “전국 매장 · 온라인몰”, “픽업/배송 가능”, “문의 1588-0000”, plus 2–4 item price lines such as “쿠션 커버 ₩12,900”, “테이블웨어 세트 ₩29,900”, “패브릭 바스켓 ₩19,900”.
- Sponsor/partner area: add a small lower sponsor-style strip reading “with MODERN HOME STYLE” or “제휴 혜택 안내”, with tiny payment/delivery pictogram badges and a scannable-looking QR placeholder, but do not imply official certification.
- Tone zone: apply {브랜드 톤} and {시그니처 결} consistently across product styling, prop selection, paper textures, sticker labels, and small printed details so the poster reads as one unified brand page.
- Color zone: use {컬러 팔레트} as the dominant palette, with the accent color reserved for small labels, sale tags, divider rules, coupon dots, price emphasis, or short callout text.
- Layout zone: follow {레이아웃} with a premium catalog structure — hero first, collage second, information and CTA last — and keep the vertical flow easy to scan from campaign title to products to price/store details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for clean Korean ad copy, bold 700–800 weight for the main title, 400–500 weight for supporting details, tabular numerals for prices, compact leading, crisp sans-serif geometry; if English appears, match with a neutral grotesk like Inter.
- Korean text layout: use realistic retail hierarchy with a main headline, 2–3 short feature blurbs, item names, price rows, small disclaimer line, coupon label, date label, and footer contact text; all Korean must be sharply rendered and properly spaced.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} should translate into warm beige #D8C8B0, off-white #F7F3EC, soft gray #CFCAC2, natural wood/cotton tones, and a controlled accent tone that stays close to the brand’s signature hue.
- Border/shadow: use soft layered drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12–18% opacity for floating cards and product cutouts; avoid harsh outlines, heavy gradients, and plastic-looking glossy edge effects.
- Print feel: matte-paper texture, faint ink grain, realistic product photography contrast, small label blocks, coupon perforation marks, thin divider lines, editorial price-table alignment, and polished retail finish.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio product photography, 50mm and 85mm lens mix, f/5.6 to f/8 for crisp catalog clarity, straight-on composition with slight top-down adjustment for tabletop items.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a soft fill from right, plus gentle background separation light; keep shadows short, soft, and controlled for a polished home-lifestyle ad look while retaining natural material depth.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + soft amber with restrained contrast, slightly desaturated neutrals, realistic paper whites, natural fabric/wood texture, and clean accent pops that preserve product readability.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean home-lifestyle retail campaign — polished department-store catalog page with a Kinfolk-meets-modern-shopping-ad aesthetic, tactile home materials, shoppable pricing details, and a warm seasonal fair atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the rendered image must correctly show these verbatim Korean strings if used in the layout: “모던하우스”, “오늘의 집을 더 편안하게”, “봄 리빙 페어”, “기간 05.01–05.31”, “전국 매장 · 온라인몰”, and any Korean copy supplied through {카피·타이포}.
- Required realistic ad details: include a campaign/date label, 2–4 short Korean product or feature blurbs, at least two visible price lines in Korean won, a small QR/barcode-style area, and footer micro text such as store/contact/delivery information.
- Layout invariants: maintain the exact vertical advertising structure with a product hero, a style collage, and a small information block; do not turn it into a full-page lifestyle scene or a single-product packshot.
- Typography invariants: Korean and English text must be clean, sharp, and properly spaced; no broken syllables, no garbled characters, and no exaggerated display-font distortion.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean modern furniture advertisement poster for iloom, designed as a premium brand product ad with a realistic room-set showcase, readable campaign copy, product information, pricing, and promotion details.
Vertical catalog-style furniture hero advertisement suitable for a brand campaign, web banner, showroom poster, and social promotion, with enough lived-in details to feel like a real Korean home interior shoot.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero placement: {제품·소재} occupies 55–65% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center for a polished showroom-ad feel, with realistic scale, contact shadows, and believable material thickness.
- Supporting room context: a refined modern interior set with visible floor plane, wall edge, window light, rug texture, side table, ceramic vase, folded throw, art frame, magazine stack, plant, and small lifestyle objects that naturally support a furniture advertisement.
- Layout balance: follow {레이아웃} and {비율} with a clear hierarchy; place a lower or side information zone containing price, product notes, campaign period, store/contact line, and a small barcode or QR-style area.
- Surface treatment: matte oak or walnut flooring, soft beige wall, tactile fabric or leather texture, visible wood grain, woven rug fibers, subtle dust-free realism, no plastic-looking surfaces.
- Brand detail layer: include a refined iloom brand mark area, small model-name credit, product code, size/spec line, and campaign date label to make the ad feel printed and commercially finished.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, and {카피·타이포} as editable brand-specific placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero zone (upper 55%): stage {제품·소재} as the focal point, arranged like a real furniture ad shoot with crisp silhouette separation, natural shadows, and realistic Korean apartment scale.
2. Room-set zone (mid 25%): build an inviting interior context around the furniture—warm wall lines, rug boundary, shelf or low table detail, one framed print, soft textiles, books, plant leaves, ceramic decor, and daylight falling across the floor.
3. Brand message zone (lower 12–15%): place {카피·타이포} in a disciplined ad layout with strong typographic hierarchy; include a bold Korean campaign headline, short subcopy, and product naming line.
4. Information zone (bottom strip or side block): add realistic ad information such as “NEW SEASON COLLECTION”, “2026.05.01–05.31”, “모델명: 모던 리빙 시리즈”, “₩749,000부터”, “전국 일룸 매장 · iloom.com”, plus a small barcode/QR-style rectangle and customer service line.
5. Visual continuity: ensure the full scene follows {시그니처 결} with a consistent modern Korean furniture showroom aesthetic, realistic materials, layered editorial styling, and premium commercial polish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean body copy, weight 500–700; use a bold sans for the main brand line and a lighter weight for supporting details, with size contrast suitable for a 1024x1536 ad.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} translated into real design tones such as warm beige #E8DDCF, oak wood #B88A5A, charcoal #2F3135, soft ivory #F7F3ED, muted clay #B97957, and a restrained signature accent color.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft contact shadow under furniture, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12–18% opacity; use fine divider rules, small label pills, and refined product-info blocks where appropriate.
- Graphic treatment: clean editorial ad alignment with realistic catalog details—thin dividers, small page/catalog code, product spec table, campaign badge, barcode area, and tiny credit text such as “Photo styled by iloom studio”.
- Text density: include enough readable Korean ad copy to feel like an authentic printed furniture promotion while keeping the hero product dominant.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio interior shot, 35mm lens for a room-set perspective or 50mm lens for a more product-focused commercial view, f/4 to keep furniture and context crisp.
- Lighting: {무드·라이팅}; soft natural daylight from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle warm fill from the front-right; shadows should be soft, dimensional, and consistent with a premium furniture catalog shoot.
- Color grade: warm neutral editorial grade with beige, wood brown, charcoal, ivory, and muted amber highlights; maintain clean whites without cyan cast and preserve visible texture in wood, fabric, rug, and wall surfaces.
- Realism cues: believable lens perspective, slight depth in the room, realistic scale relative to accessories, accurate furniture joinery, textile seams, wood grain direction, and soft specular highlights on small decor objects.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean furniture brand campaign — calm editorial showroom aesthetic similar to a high-end interior spread from Casa BRUTUS or Kinfolk, with warm lived-in styling, precise commercial layout, and aspirational everyday comfort.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 텍스트: “일룸”, “iloom”.
- Add crisp Korean ad text such as: “나다운 집의 시작”, “모던 리빙 컬렉션”, “2026년 5월 신제품”, “₩749,000부터”, “전국 일룸 매장 · iloom.com”.
- Include small professional details: “MODEL. Living 247”, “VOL.05”, “상담문의 1577-5670”, “Photo styled by iloom studio”, and a barcode/QR-style block.
- Preserve the exact composition framing, color palette, lighting style, typography, and overall mood as a modern furniture advertisement.
- Product proportions must remain realistic; furniture must look structurally sound and properly scaled.
- Keep all text crisp, legible, and professionally aligned.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-770.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
당근마켓 스타일의 동네 광고 포스터. 중고 거래와 동네 친구 감성을 친근한 캐릭터 일러스트, 실제 동네 게시판에 붙은 캠페인 포스터 같은 정보 요소, 큰 카피, QR 안내, 쿠폰 혜택, 지역 라벨로 전달하는 세로형 광고 비주얼.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {제품·소재}와 {시그니처 결}을 중심으로, 캐릭터와 동네 오브젝트가 화면의 60%를 차지하는 세로 포스터 구성. 당근 캐릭터가 작은 거래 박스와 휴대폰 채팅 화면을 들고 골목 입구에 서 있으며, 주변에는 아파트 창문, 전봇대, 자전거, 반려견 산책줄, 작은 화분, 벤치, 장바구니 아이콘, 중고 물품 스티커, 동네 가게 간판이 자연스럽게 배치됨.
- Background treatment: 화이트 또는 아주 옅은 웜 오프화이트 배경 위에, {지역명}을 떠올리게 하는 동네 지도 조각·집·나무·놀이터 표지·버스정류장·동네 게시판·간단한 앱 아이콘을 평면 일러스트로 배치하고, 종이 포스터처럼 은은한 인쇄 질감과 미세한 종이 결을 더해 실제 광고물 같은 밀도를 만든다.
- Spacing and framing: 상단에는 브랜드 타이틀과 캠페인 날짜 라벨, 중앙에는 캐릭터/메인 그래픽, 중하단에는 {카피·타이포}와 혜택 배너, 하단에는 동네 광고 정보 블록·문의처·QR/앱 안내 박스를 배치해 시선이 위에서 아래로 자연스럽게 흐르도록 설계.
- {브랜드 톤}과 {레이아웃}이 한눈에 읽히도록, 메인 카피·캐릭터·정보 라벨·스폰서 영역·관리번호·QR/앱 다운로드 버튼이 명확한 계층을 이루며 포스터 전체에 활기 있는 동네 캠페인 분위기를 만든다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 15%): {카피·타이포} 중 핵심 한글 타이틀을 굵고 크게 배치하고, 그 아래에 영문 "daangn"을 작은 보조 타이포로 붙여 브랜드 인지를 강화. 우측 상단에는 작은 라벨 "동네광고 VOL.05"와 "2026.05"를 넣고, 좌측에는 둥근 배지 형태의 "우리 동네 소식"을 배치. 헤더 가장자리에는 작은 캠페인 라벨 "{캠페인명}"과 기간 "{캠페인 기간}"을 캡슐형 태그로 넣는다.
2) Hero zone (middle 50–55%): {시그니처 결}을 대표하는 당근 캐릭터와 {제품·소재}를 중심 배치. 캐릭터는 둥근 형태와 단순한 선으로 표현하고, 주변에 동네 집, 산책길, 거래 박스, 말풍선, 지도 핀, 작은 채팅 알림, 중고 물품 가격 스티커, 찜 하트 아이콘, 매너온도 배지 같은 친근한 요소를 덧붙여 실제 앱 캠페인 포스터처럼 풍성한 장면을 구성.
3) Supporting illustration zone: 메인 오브젝트 주변에 동네를 상징하는 작은 일러스트를 크기 차와 레이어로 분산 배치. 말풍선에는 "가까운 이웃과 거래해요", "오늘도 동네에서", "채팅 3" 같은 짧은 한글 문구를 넣고, 작은 지도 조각에는 "상도동", "마포구", "걸어서 5분" 같은 지역감 있는 텍스트를 배치. 작은 가격표에는 "자전거 ₩35,000", "식탁 ₩20,000", "무료나눔"을 넣어 중고 거래 맥락을 선명하게 만든다.
4) Copy and benefit zone (bottom 20%): {카피·타이포}를 큰 한글 카피로 배치하고, 짧은 보조 문구 "우리 동네에서 쉽고 따뜻하게"를 한 줄로 정리. 오렌지 리본 배너에는 "{혜택 문구}"를 넣고, 하단 정보 박스에는 "앱에서 당근마켓 검색", "동네 인증하고 시작하기", "문의 {문의처}"를 넣는다. 우측에는 스캔 가능한 것처럼 보이는 단순 QR 코드 영역과 작은 앱 다운로드 버튼 스타일 그래픽을 배치한다.
5) Footer and sponsor area: 최하단에는 작은 스폰서/제휴 영역을 두어 "동네 제휴 {스폰서명}"과 "동네 캠페인 포스터"를 넣고, 옆에 관리번호 "AD-LOCAL-2026-05", 작은 바코드, 배포일 "2026.05.01"을 배치해 실제 지역 광고 포스터처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold 또는 Noto Sans KR Black 계열의 굵은 산세리프를 사용하고, 보조 영문은 Pretendard Medium 정도의 작은 크기로 정돈. 카피는 약간 둥근 획과 넓은 자간으로 친근하게 보이게 구성하며, 정보 라벨은 작은 굵기 차이와 캡슐형 배경으로 읽기 쉽게 구성.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 기준으로 당근 오렌지 #FF7A00, 화이트 #FFFFFF, 연한 크림 #FFF7EF, 보조 민트/라임 계열 액센트를 소량 사용. 동네 오브젝트에는 연한 베이지, 살구색, 부드러운 브라운, 잎사귀 그린을 섞어 따뜻한 지역 광고 감성을 강화.
- Border/shadow: 캐릭터와 오브젝트에 2px 내외의 부드러운 외곽선, 요소 하단에 8px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity의 연한 그림자 적용. 작은 스티커·배지·정보 박스에는 살짝 겹쳐진 종이 레이어와 인쇄된 포스터의 미세한 잉크 번짐 느낌을 더한다.
- Poster details: 하단 가장자리에는 작은 크레딧 텍스트 "illustration by local crew"와 "동네 캠페인 포스터"를 넣고, 작은 바코드/관리번호 영역 "AD-LOCAL-2026-05"를 배치해 실제 배포용 광고 포스터처럼 보이게 한다. QR 코드는 실제 인식 여부보다 광고 시각 요소처럼 단순하고 선명하게 표현한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial flat graphic poster look, simulated with a 50mm standard framing and clean top-to-bottom poster composition, no real-photo distortion.
- Lighting: {무드·라이팅}을 반영한 diffuse studio-like soft light, even illumination from upper-left with very gentle fill from right, avoiding harsh contrast.
- Color grade: warm orange + cream + clean white with small fresh green accents, high-key and print-friendly.
- Rendering finish: crisp vector-style illustration with subtle paper grain, layered sticker-like graphics, realistic print-poster detail, barcode/QR micro-elements, coupon tag shapes, and a polished Korean mobile-app campaign aesthetic.

[6. MOOD]
Korean neighborhood app campaign poster — playful, friendly, platform-brand illustration vibe with the approachable polish of a modern mobile app launch ad. 전체 분위기는 동네 게시판이나 아파트 엘리베이터 알림판에 붙어 있을 법한 따뜻한 광고물이면서, 모바일 앱 브랜드 캠페인처럼 선명하고 전문적으로 완성된 느낌. {비율} 세로 포스터에 맞게 상단 타이틀, 중앙 캐릭터, 하단 정보/혜택 블록이 안정적으로 읽힌다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 다음 문구가 보여야 함 — "당근마켓", "daangn", "우리 동네 소식", "동네광고 VOL.05", "2026.05", "가까운 이웃과 거래해요", "오늘도 동네에서", "걸어서 5분", "우리 동네에서 쉽고 따뜻하게", "앱에서 당근마켓 검색", "동네 인증하고 시작하기".
- Additional rendered text: 포스터 안에 "{캠페인명}", "{캠페인 기간}", "{지역명}", "{혜택 문구}", "문의 {문의처}", "동네 제휴 {스폰서명}", "자전거 ₩35,000", "무료나눔", "AD-LOCAL-2026-05"가 자연스럽게 보여야 함.
- Layout invariant: 캐릭터 중심의 친근한 동네 광고 구성, 큰 카피와 보조 영문이 함께 보이는 1024x1536 세로형 포스터 구조 유지.
- Preserve placeholders exactly: {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율}, {캠페인명}, {캠페인 기간}, {지역명}, {혜택 문구}, {문의처}, {스폰서명}의 의미를 반영하고, 전체 look은 flat-illustration based로 유지.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals/certifications or government-style approval stamps
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean e-commerce advertisement poster for 11st-style marketplace promotion, designed as a vertical hero ad with bold pricing hierarchy and category variety.
Direct-response retail campaign visual for social media, app banner, and mobile display placements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: product hero cluster occupies the central 58% of the frame, with a large price/campaign area near the lower-middle and brand headline locked near the upper third.
- Background treatment: clean studio backdrop with a bright white base, subtle warm gradient accents, and crisp commercial spacing that keeps the layout airy and readable.
- Framing direction: vertical ad poster framing with strong top-to-bottom information flow, allowing {브랜드 톤} to drive the overall look and {레이아웃} to control hierarchy.
- Visual balance: mix dense shopping-energy elements with controlled whitespace so {제품·소재} feels abundant without becoming cluttered.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header zone (top 15%): place the main Korean brand/title treatment in a bold retail-promo style, supported by a small English subtitle line and compact campaign framing that reflects {카피·타이포}.
- Hero zone (center 40%): arrange {제품·소재} as a polished multi-product cluster, with the most important item slightly enlarged and front-most, while secondary items step back in staggered depth.
- Price/message zone (lower middle 18%): add a large numeric price block and discount emphasis area, visually stronger than surrounding copy but still aligned to the same grid as {카피·타이포}.
- Category zone (mid-lower 12%): organize small category cues or micro labels so the poster reads as a broad marketplace offer, reinforcing {시그니처 결}.
- Footer zone (bottom 15%): keep a clean, compact supporting strip with small legal-style or campaign-note spacing, using the same red/white/charcoal logic from {컬러 팔레트}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main Korean headline, Pretendard SemiBold for subcopy, and condensed numeric styling for price text; headline size should be dominant with tight vertical stacking.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} applied as saturated retail red, pure white, deep charcoal, and small yellow accent hits for promotions and highlights.
- Border/shadow: soft commercial drop shadows under product cutouts, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use crisp edge masking with no fuzzy halo.
- Text treatment: keep Korean and English perfectly legible, with clean kerning, strong contrast, and no decorative distortion.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product advertising look shot on a full-frame DSLR or medium-format system, roughly 70mm to 85mm equivalent for the hero cluster, with a clean f/8 product-detail rendering.
- Lighting: high-key studio setup with softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, and a subtle rim light to separate products from the white background.
- Color grade: retail-commercial grade with bright whites, vivid red accents, neutral charcoal anchors, and slightly warm yellow highlight tones for promotional energy.

[6. MOOD]
Fast-paced premium marketplace campaign — polished Korean retail platform advertising with the energetic clarity of a high-budget app launch banner.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함:
  - "11번가"

studio:prompts3:ours-768.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean fashion platform advertisement poster, editorial streetwear campaign, social-media and mobile-banner friendly vertical ad.
A premium MZ fashion promo with a strong headline, full-body model, realistic city context, shopping-campaign details, and content-rich fashion-platform typography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: full-body model occupies about 55% of the frame, slightly off-center in a confident editorial pose; large headline block takes the upper 18% to 22%; supporting copy, campaign details, and shopping CTA occupy the lower-third.
- Background treatment: modern Seoul street scene with concrete walls, shopfront glass, crosswalk markings, metal railings, subtle street posters, pavement texture, and muted architectural lines; background should feel real and lived-in while keeping the model dominant.
- Spacing and framing: maintain a tall 1024x1536 poster crop with strong hierarchy between model, headline, product details, and platform information; use layered poster modules, price/promo badges, QR or barcode area, and small campaign labels to make the ad feel commercially complete.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as the controllable brand, material, typography, and layout variables.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background layer: build a city-fashion advertising scene with urban depth, street perspective, concrete texture, asphalt, storefront reflections, traffic-light hints, stickered utility poles, and soft pedestrian blur that supports the brand tone without overpowering the model.
2) Hero model layer: place the full-body model in a confident streetwear pose, styled as the main visual anchor, with crisp silhouette separation from the background and believable garment fit.
3) Product and material emphasis: highlight the street look and new collection feeling through layered outfit styling, visible seams, stitching, rib texture, nylon sheen, denim grain, leather or mesh details, and clean product-tag callouts.
4) Headline and copy block: set the main Korean and English typography as a large advertisement headline with bold readable hierarchy. Include short Korean promo blurbs such as "신상 드롭", "오늘의 랭킹", "단독 특가", and English support like "NEW SEASON DROP".
5) Campaign information layer: add realistic poster details including date range "2026.05.01–05.15", time label "오전 11시 오픈", venue/online line "MUSINSA APP · 성수 쇼룸", ticket or benefit text "앱 전용 쿠폰", QR code box, barcode strip, small legal/credit line, and model-name credit "MODEL: JIHO K.".
6) Brand accent layer: apply signature color accents in rule lines, corner labels, small stickers, price badges, diagonal graphic blocks, and mobile-commerce UI tags using {컬러 팔레트} and {시그니처 결}.
7) Final polish: keep the layout sharply aligned for a polished fashion-platform ad look, with realistic printed-poster texture, subtle paper grain, screen-ad sharpness, accurate text placement, and no distortion in the model or typography.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline, Pretendard Medium for support text, and a clean sans-serif for English; headline size should feel poster-scale with strong contrast and precise Korean kerning.
- Main text direction: combine a bold Korean headline with compact English merchandising labels. Example cover line: "신상, 지금 바로 입다" plus "MUSINSA NEW ARRIVAL".
- Commerce details: include small but readable UI-style modules: "무료배송", "앱 전용 15%", "오늘만 공개", "찜 32K", "리뷰 4.8"; use them as realistic fashion-platform ad elements.
- Color palette: charcoal, white, and signature accent colors from {컬러 팔레트}; use high-contrast fashion commerce colors with small vivid accents for badges and CTA buttons.
- Border/shadow: use soft dimensional shadows around text cards and product tags, around 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; avoid heavy outlines and glossy effects.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm full-frame portrait look at f/2.8 for a crisp fashion-ad editorial feel, with enough depth to isolate the model from the city background.
- Lighting: natural daylight with urban bounce light, slightly from upper-left, plus subtle fill from front-right; keep edges clean and realistic while showing fabric texture and city-surface detail.
- Color grade: cool urban neutrals with charcoal, white, and a controlled accent tone; fashion-catalog contrast with a modern Seoul street aesthetic.
- Surface realism: include believable poster-print grain, tiny scuffs on pavement, faint reflections in glass, and realistic shadows under shoes to anchor the model in the scene.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean fashion commerce editorial — high-end streetwear campaign energy with a Musinsa-style Seoul city poster feel, active shopping-season momentum, and premium MZ platform branding.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "무신사", "MUSINSA", "신상".
- Additional readable Korean strings to render accurately: "신상 드롭", "앱 전용 쿠폰", "무료배송", "2026.05.01–05.15", "성수 쇼룸", "오늘만 공개".
- Layout invariants: full-body model, city background, large headline, campaign date/benefit details, QR or barcode area, and fashion-platform CTA must all be present; typography must be clean, legible, and professionally aligned.
- The overall composition, color palette, lighting style, typography, and mood must stay consistent with a premium Korean fashion platform advertisement using {브랜드 톤}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {카피·타이포}, and {레이아웃}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean delivery-service promotional poster, vertical mobile ad layout, hero-driven brand campaign for fast shipping and broad product selection.
Polished commercial graphic poster for social feed or app-launch campaign placement, centered on a bold box-and-rocket message with realistic promo information, coupon cues, and retail service details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero zone occupies the central 62% of the frame: {제품·소품} arranged as the dominant visual cluster, with {시그니처 모티프} emphasized through strong scale contrast, motion trails, parcel labels, and app-notification cards.
- Top-to-middle flow: the eye should move from {메인 카피} at the upper third into {서브 카피} and the hero cluster, then finish on a coupon / CTA area near the lower third.
- Background treatment: white-to-cool-blue gradient base with faint delivery route lines, small map pins, translucent product-category tiles, receipt snippets, and diagonal rocket streak graphics that support the retail campaign atmosphere.
- Framing direction: poster-like vertical balance with a centered product tower, dynamic side accents, readable promo chips, and a footer containing campaign terms, app/web address, partner strip, and contact-style information.
- Use {브랜드 톤} as the overall brand personality guide, while keeping the ad punchy, trustworthy, and immediately readable on a mobile screen.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header area (top 18%): place the brand lockup text “쿠팡 Coupang” with a small campaign label “ROCKET DELIVERY WEEK”, then show {메인 카피} as the primary headline in very large Korean type. Add {프로모션 기간} as a rounded date pill near the headline.
2) Brand-energy zone (upper-mid 15%): introduce a dynamic accent built from {시그니처 모티프}, using curved rocket trails, red speed arrows, blue light streaks, mini parcel icons, and a small “도착 예정 알림” app-card detail.
3) Hero cluster (mid 38%): present {제품·소품} as the dominant visual centerpiece, stacked around a large open delivery box with a rocket launching upward. Include realistic product silhouettes such as groceries, beauty items, electronics, pet supplies, and household goods to communicate broad categories.
4) Offer / ticket zone (lower-mid 17%): add a coupon-ticket panel with {혜택 문구}, a promo-code chip “CODE: ROCKET247”, a square QR-style app-download tile labeled “APP”, and three benefit badges: “빠른 배송”, “가성비”, “다양 카테”. Include {CTA 문구} as the strongest button-like element.
5) Footer zone (bottom 12%): create a structured brand finish area with {앱·웹 표기}, {협력사 표기}, customer-service style microcopy, and {하단 고지}. Use small divider lines, page-poster production details, and sponsor/partner logo placeholders rendered as simple Korean text labels rather than official seals.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the main headline, Noto Sans KR Medium for supporting copy, sizes tuned for poster hierarchy (headline very large, coupon/CTA medium-large, legal microcopy small), with slightly tightened tracking on the headline.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} anchored in Coupang blue, white, and red accent; use clean #0057D9-like blue, pure white, sharp red highlight accents, and soft sky-blue panels for information cards.
- Graphic details: combine crisp vector-like typography with semi-3D product-poster illustration; use rounded coupon tickets, barcode-like promo stripes, app notification bubbles, category icons, delivery route map lines, confetti dots, and motion sparks.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow under the hero cluster, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use subtle outline separation where needed to keep boxes, coupons, and product silhouettes readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product-poster look, 50mm standard lens perspective with mild depth separation, digitally composited like a commercial key visual rather than a real-photo scene.
- Lighting: {분위기·라이팅}; bright diffused studio light from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle fill from the right and faint rim highlights to make the package shapes, rocket, and coupon panels pop.
- Color grade: clean high-key corporate blue and white with red accent pops, controlled saturation, glossy digital-ad finish, and crisp edges optimized for 1024x1536 vertical viewing.

[6. MOOD]
Polished Korean e-commerce campaign visual — energetic retail ad aesthetic with the clarity and punch of a major digital marketplace banner, enriched by realistic promo mechanics, category variety, delivery-status details, and app-first shopping cues.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열 — “쿠팡”, “Coupang”, “로켓배송”, “빠른 배송”, “가성비”, “다양 카테”, “오늘 주문, 내일 도착”, “최대 30% 쿠폰”, “앱에서 바로 확인”, “2026.05.01–05.31”, “CODE: ROCKET247”.
- Composition invariant: keep the hero composition centered and dominant, with a clear headline-to-hero-to-coupon-to-footer hierarchy.
- Poster information invariant: include campaign period, app/web label, coupon-ticket area, sponsor/partner strip, and small legal notice so the result feels like a real Korean mobile promotional poster.
- Typography invariant: all Korean characters must be clean, properly formed, and fully legible; no broken glyphs or warped text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or impersonation

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
KB국민은행 신뢰 광고 포스터, 세로형 금융 브랜딩 카피 광고. 가족의 생활 장면과 은행 서비스 정보를 함께 보여주는 1페이지 홍보 비주얼로, 1024x1536 세로 지면에서 실제 금융권 캠페인 포스터처럼 읽히는 구성.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 가족 hero가 프레임 하단 52%를 차지하고, 상단 28%에는 큰 헤드라인과 KB 브랜드 헤더, 캠페인 날짜가 안정적으로 배치되도록 구성
- 배경은 화이트 기반에 warm amber 그라데이션, 은은한 종이 질감, KB yellow 포인트 라인, 얇은 금융 그래픽 패턴을 더해 실제 은행 광고 지면처럼 완성
- 중앙의 가족 hero에서 상단 메인 카피로 시선이 올라가고, 하단의 상담 안내·앱 CTA·캠페인 코드까지 순서대로 읽히는 세로형 정보 흐름 설계
- {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {금융 서비스}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {메인 카피}, {보조 카피}, {레이아웃}을 각각 독립적인 디자인 지시로 반영
- 실제 포스터 디테일로 {캠페인 날짜}, {캠페인 코드}, {상담 안내}, {지점 위치}, {앱 CTA}를 작고 선명한 정보 요소로 포함

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 18%): 좌측 상단에 “KB 국민은행” 워드마크형 타이포와 짧은 영문 “KB Kookmin Bank”를 배치하고, 우측에는 {캠페인 날짜}와 {캠페인 코드}를 작은 정보 라벨로 삽입
2. Main headline zone (upper-center 22%): {메인 카피}를 Pretendard Bold 대형 한글 타이포로 배치하고, 바로 아래 {보조 카피}를 2줄 이내로 넣어 금융 신뢰 메시지가 즉시 읽히게 구성
3. Main hero zone (center-lower 45%): {금융 서비스}를 중심으로 부모와 자녀가 통장·모바일뱅킹 화면·생활비 계획표를 함께 확인하는 장면을 배치, 표정은 단정하고 안정적인 일상형 신뢰 이미지
4. Signature service layer (mid-lower 14%): {시그니처 결}이 느껴지도록 작은 서비스 카드 3개를 배치 — “우리 가족 자산관리”, “든든한 생활금융”, “모바일 상담 예약” 같은 현실적인 금융 서비스 텍스트 포함
5. Brand finish zone (bottom 12%): {브랜드 톤}과 {레이아웃}에 맞춰 하단에 {상담 안내}, {지점 위치}, {앱 CTA}, QR-style square placeholder, 작은 약관 안내 문구를 광고 지면처럼 정돈

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for main Korean headline, Pretendard Medium for supporting lines, size hierarchy 64–80px / 28–34px / 18–22px; 영문 “KB”는 세미볼드 산세리프로 짧고 견고하게 처리
- Color palette: KB yellow, charcoal #2B2B2B, white #FFFFFF, soft amber #E8C27A, muted gray #EDEDED; {컬러 팔레트}의 느낌이 과하지 않게 금융 광고용으로 정제
- Graphic details: thin KB yellow accent bar, rounded service cards, small app icon-style pictograms, fine paper grain, subtle financial line-chart motif behind the headline
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity under hero subjects; soft rounded card shadows and print-ad depth for realistic layering
- Text placement: headline, subcopy, campaign information, CTA, service cards all remain crisp and readable at 1024x1536 portrait resolution

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.8 portrait look for the family hero, combined with a clean commercial editorial framing; shallow depth of field but faces remain crisp
- Lighting: soft natural window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, slight warm rim light to separate subjects from the background
- Color grade: warm cream + KB yellow + charcoal contrast, lightly desaturated highlights, clean bank-ad print finish
- Realism: natural Korean family styling, everyday smart-casual clothing, realistic hand positions around phone and documents, believable printed poster typography and small disclaimer text

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean banking brand campaign — polished editorial trust feel like a high-end corporate advertisement seen in a major financial magazine, with warm family confidence, practical service information, and calm financial reliability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구: “국민은행”, “KB”
- 반드시 포함할 렌더링 문구: “오늘의 안심이 내일의 힘이 됩니다”, “KB 국민은행”, “우리 가족 생활금융”, “2026년 5월 캠페인”, “상담 예약은 KB스타뱅킹에서”
- 하단 정보 예시 문구는 선명하게 표기: “문의 1588-9999”, “서울 중구 남대문로 84”, “CAMPAIGN KB-TRUST-0526”
- Layout invariant: family hero remains the primary focal point, large headline stays in the upper area, and the overall composition must remain a calm financial-advertising poster with clear hierarchy
- Text must be clean, sharp, and fully legible in Korean and English with no broken glyphs

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable main text
- Celebrity composites or real-person identity mimicry
