[1. PURPOSE]
KakaoBank-style friendly character advertisement poster for app promotion, vertical editorial ad with a playful fintech brand feel.
Designed for social-media and mobile-first campaign use, combining character-led storytelling, clear product/UI emphasis, campaign information, and realistic mobile ad details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: character hero occupies the center-left 45% of the frame, with {레이아웃} structured so the app screen and card sit in a balanced right-side column.
- Background treatment: clean white base with Kakao yellow blocks, soft pastel accent shapes, subtle flat illustration texture, small motion stickers, rounded benefit chips, and playful fintech-themed icons.
- Spacing and framing: strong vertical stacking with headline, character, product, CTA, QR area, footer information, and campaign microcopy arranged like a polished real Korean mobile banking poster.
- Use {브랜드 톤} as the overall brand direction, keeping the layout cheerful, approachable, and ad-ready.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (upper-middle 50%): {시그니처 결} character illustration placed prominently with a lively welcoming pose, rounded shapes, clean outline treatment, soft shadow anchor, and small floating reaction marks such as hearts, sparkle dots, and coin icons.
2. Product cluster (mid-right 30%): {제품·소재} arranged as a layered fintech showcase, with the app screen slightly larger than the card; app UI should show a balance card, transfer button, savings goal widget, and friendly yellow navigation bar.
3. Copy zone (top and lower-left): {카피·타이포} set in a bold, friendly headline hierarchy, with a smaller English subtitle beneath and a short MZ-style supporting line.
4. Campaign information zone: include {캠페인명}, {혜택문구}, {행사기간}, {CTA문구}, QR-style download block, app store button shapes, and a small URL/contact line placed near the lower third and footer.
5. Decorative realism pass: add sponsor/service micro labels, tiny legal disclaimer text, card benefit tags, rounded sticker labels, page-safe ad footer, and subtle UI details so it feels like an actual Korean fintech campaign poster.
6. Color balance pass: {컬러 팔레트} applied across background blocks, accent labels, UI highlights, character detailing, CTA buttons, and footer dividers so the composition reads immediately as Kakao-inspired.
7. Final layout control: keep the poster vertical and campaign-like, with the hero, product, copy, QR area, and CTA all clearly readable at thumbnail size.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main Korean headline, Pretendard Medium for supporting copy, and a clean sans-serif English subtitle; headline size should dominate the upper third, while CTA and benefit chips use rounded button-like type.
- Color palette: Kakao yellow #FEE500, white #FFFFFF, deep black #111111, soft gray #EAEAEA, and friendly accent tones from mint, peach, and light blue.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on character and product elements; use crisp vector edges, rounded app-card corners, and clean layered depth.
- Poster detail styling: use realistic Korean ad hierarchy with headline, subheadline, benefit badges, QR block, app store buttons, date line, URL, customer center microtext, and fine-print disclaimer in the bottom footer.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-resolution poster composite look, like a commercial key visual shot with a 50mm equivalent framing and clean front-facing alignment.
- Lighting: bright studio-style diffuse lighting from upper-left, gentle fill from right, even exposure with polished commercial contrast.
- Color grade: vivid Kakao yellow + clean white + pastel accent grading, with slightly boosted saturation and smooth digital illustration clarity.
- Finish: premium Korean mobile app campaign design, sharp typography rendering, glossy-but-flat product UI surfaces, and friendly vector character polish.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean fintech campaign graphic — cheerful Kakao-style brand ad with a polished MZ-friendly commercial poster feel, lively benefit stickers, trustworthy app UI, and warm everyday banking energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "카카오뱅크", "오늘도 쉽게, 내 돈 관리", "앱에서 바로 시작하기", "2026.05.01 - 2026.05.31", "QR로 다운로드".
- Render realistic campaign copy in Korean: main headline "카카오뱅크와 더 가볍게", benefit chip "첫 이체 수수료 0원", supporting line "친구처럼 쉬운 모바일 뱅킹", footer microcopy "자세한 내용은 앱 내 이벤트 페이지를 확인하세요".
- Layout invariant: friendly character hero, app screen, card, CTA button, QR block, and footer information must all remain clearly separated and legible in one vertical ad composition.
- Keep character proportions friendly and rounded, and keep all UI-like elements clean, simple, and readable.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unlicensed celebrity composites

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Toss-like fintech advertisement poster, designed as a vertical app-promo editorial for social feeds, subway screen ads, and paid mobile placements.
Friendly, clean, MZ-oriented brand visual with a realistic app-screen hero, debit card detail, character illustration, benefit modules, event information, and bold Korean copy hierarchy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero area (top 52%): {제품·소재} arranged as the primary focal cluster, with the app screen slightly larger than the card and character to establish a clear visual anchor. Show believable UI details such as account balance cards, spending graph, transfer button, notification pill, and small icon rows.
- Secondary support area (mid-to-lower 28%): add friendly illustration elements, floating rounded badges, tiny receipt snippets, coin icons, and benefit chips placed around the hero so the ad feels like a real fintech campaign rather than a blank product mockup.
- Campaign information area (lower 20%): include short Korean headline/subcopy, CTA button, QR code block, app-store style download buttons, campaign period, small legal disclaimer, and a tiny customer-center line.
- Background treatment: warm white or near-white matte studio surface with gentle depth, subtle paper texture, realistic ambient shadow, faint pastel glow behind the app screen, and a polished social-ad finish.
- Spacing and framing: centered vertical layout with energetic layered placements, readable typography blocks, and a balanced poster rhythm that feels approachable, premium, and content-rich.
- Apply {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, and {비율} as the organizing logic for all placements.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero cluster: place the app screen front-most, with the card slightly offset behind it and the character illustration adjacent, creating a layered fintech product spotlight. Add tiny UI labels such as “소비”, “송금”, “혜택”, “자산” inside the screen.
2. Copy zone: set a large Korean-first headline near the lower-middle area, supported by two short feature blurbs in pill cards. Example feature blurbs: “이번 달 소비 리포트”, “숨은 혜택 자동 확인”, “1분 만에 송금 완료”.
3. Campaign details: add small but legible poster information such as “2026.05.01–05.31”, “앱에서 바로 확인”, “QR로 혜택 보기”, “광고 코드: TOSS-MAY-247”, and a compact disclaimer line.
4. Accent shapes: add rounded geometric accents in {컬러 팔레트}, including soft circles, capsule tags, small check icons, graph dots, and sticker-like labels. Keep their scale supportive and integrated with the product story.
5. Shadow treatment: give each object a gentle, believable drop shadow that separates it from the matte background while maintaining a light fintech campaign feel.
6. Brand finish: keep the entire scene consistent with {무드·라이팅} and {브랜드 톤}, maintaining a modern fintech ad feel with real promotional context, not a catalog-style product mockup.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main headline, Pretendard SemiBold for subcopy, and Pretendard Regular for microcopy/disclaimers, with strong sans-serif proportions and large size contrast for ad readability.
- Color palette: use Toss Blue, clean White, and friendly accent tones from {컬러 팔레트}; keep saturation crisp, polished, and premium rather than neon-heavy.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, 14% opacity; use subtle rounded cards, translucent UI panels, and light keyline dividers where useful for a real app-campaign design.
- Typography behavior: set the headline as a strong Korean-first lockup with optional small English support, using compact line breaks and confident spacing. Place microcopy, QR label, and date text smaller but still legible.
- Graphic detail: include believable app icons, spend-category chips, mini charts, notification badges, and small sticker labels such as “NEW”, “혜택”, “무료 송금” to add realism without overwhelming the main message.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product-render look inspired by a 50mm lens perspective at f/5.6, straight-on vertical framing, clean ad composition.
- Lighting: high-key studio lighting with softbox key from upper-left at 45°, very subtle fill from right, faint ambient bounce on the white surface, and a soft blue glow behind the app hero.
- Color grade: cool-clean fintech palette with Toss Blue, white, and soft pastel accent support; keep contrast crisp, edges polished, and UI text sharp.
- Material realism: app screen glass should have a controlled reflection, card should have matte plastic texture with slight edge thickness, and paper-like background texture should be faint but visible.

[6. MOOD]
Premium mobile-finance campaign ad — friendly startup UI aesthetic with a polished Toss-like brand finish, realistic promotional details, smart benefit storytelling, and energetic Korean social-feed readability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as rendered text if used in the design: “토스”, “Toss”, “오늘도 돈 관리, 쉽게”, “이번 달 내 소비 리포트”, “혜택 확인하기”, “2026.05.01–05.31”, “QR로 혜택 보기”.
- Maintain a fintech ad composition with an app-screen hero, friendly illustration, large copy hierarchy, QR/download CTA area, campaign date, and small disclaimer line.
- Objects must remain clean, non-distorted, and product-ad polished; avoid any uncanny facial or object deformation.
- Keep the layout centered and vertical, with clear separation between hero objects, benefit cards, CTA, and typography.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-763.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
신한카드 모던 럭셔리 광고 포스터, 세로형 브랜드 캠페인 비주얼, 카드 혜택과 프리미엄 라이프스타일을 함께 보여주는 정교한 광고 컴포지션.
고급 카드 광고의 히어로 컷, 작은 라이프스타일 서브컷, 혜택 정보, 캠페인 디테일, 약관형 마이크로 텍스트가 함께 배치된 현실적인 프리미엄 매거진 광고 포스터.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 프레이밍: 세로 1024x1536 기준으로 카드 히어로가 화면 하단~중앙 약 55%를 차지하고, 상단 20%는 헤드라인과 영문 부제, 우측 또는 하단 일부에는 작은 라이프스타일 컷과 혜택 라벨이 들어가는 비대칭 럭셔리 레이아웃.
- 배경 처리: 프리미엄 스튜디오 배경 위에 은은한 크림-화이트 그라데이션, 미세한 종이 질감, 금속성 하이라이트, 얇은 골드 라인 장식을 더해 실제 금융 광고 지면처럼 구성하고, 화이트 계열 바탕에 신한 블루와 골드가 또렷하게 돋보이게 처리.
- 포스터 정보 요소: 상단에는 브랜드명과 캠페인 카피, 중앙에는 카드 히어로와 라이프스타일 컷, 하단에는 혜택 3종, 가입 안내, QR 코드 영역, 작은 바코드형 관리 번호, 캠페인 날짜 라벨, 법적 고지용 마이크로 텍스트를 배치.
- 시선 흐름: 브랜드 헤드라인 → 영문 부제 → 카드 히어로 → 라이프스타일 컷 → 혜택 정보 → 하단 안내 영역 순으로 자연스럽게 읽히도록 조명과 타이포 크기를 조절.
- {브랜드 톤}은 전체 톤앤매너의 기준으로 반영하고, 텍스트 밀도와 프리미엄 감도를 그에 맞게 조절.
- {시그니처 결}은 카드 매크로 디테일과 라이프스타일 컷의 조합 방식으로 표현.
- {제품·소재}는 카드 실물 질감, 표면 반사, 함께 놓인 라이프 오브제로 구체화.
- {무드·라이팅}은 스튜디오 조명 방향과 하이라이트의 질감으로 재현.
- {컬러 팔레트}는 배경, 카드 엣지, 액센트 라인, 텍스트 컬러에 일관되게 적용.
- {카피·타이포}는 상단 메인 카피, 영문 부제, 혜택 카피의 계층 구조로 배치.
- {레이아웃}은 카드 히어로와 작은 라이프 컷, 큰 카피의 상대 비율을 결정.
- {비율}은 최종 세로 광고 포스터 비율로 유지.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer: premium studio backdrop with soft off-white base, subtle cream-to-white gradient, fine paper grain, faint brushed-metal sheen, and a few thin metallic gold rules that frame the campaign information.
2. Hero card area: a glossy premium Shinhan-style card rendered as the main subject, angled slightly in a controlled three-quarter view, occupying the lower-center to mid-frame with crisp edge definition, realistic reflective highlights, fine laminated texture, embossed dummy digits, IC chip, contactless symbol, and a small printed member-name credit.
3. Lifestyle inset: a smaller supporting lifestyle cut placed near one side of the hero card, showing an elegant everyday premium scene such as a hotel lounge table, leather wallet, espresso cup, phone screen with payment confirmation, boutique receipt, and soft bokeh city light; it should suggest benefits and usage while staying secondary to the card.
4. Header copy block: large Korean headline placed in the upper section with strong hierarchy, followed by a smaller English subtitle, short Korean benefit copy, and a campaign label such as “2026 프리미엄 라이프 캠페인”.
5. Benefit information strip: add three concise benefit modules with icon-like markers and short Korean labels, for example “프리미엄 적립”, “호텔·다이닝 혜택”, “해외 이용 우대”, each with small supporting microcopy.
6. Poster utility details: include a small QR-code placeholder area, barcode-like campaign management strip, date label “2026.05”, tiny customer-center line, website-style line “shinhan.card/luxury”, and fine-print terms across the bottom as realistic advertising details.
7. Accent details: thin gold rules, refined light streaks, micro reflections, small registration marks, and editorial grid notations used to signal premium finance branding with realistic printed-ad depth.
8. Brand anchoring: {브랜드 톤} expressed through restrained luxury composition, precise spacing, controlled contrast, and real-world financial campaign information.
9. Signature expression: {시그니처 결} translated into a polished card-macro + lifestyle combination that feels like an upscale editorial ad.
10. Product emphasis: {제품·소재} shown with believable material texture, polished surface, chamfered card edge, tactile foil detail, and clean separation from the background.
11. Mood rendering: {무드·라이팅} used to create a studio-lit, warm, high-end commercial finish.
12. Color integration: {컬러 팔레트} applied across card accents, typography, icon modules, QR area, and subtle background reflections.
13. Copy hierarchy: {카피·타이포} arranged with the brand name most prominent, English subline smaller, benefit copy compact and legible, and fine print realistically small but not broken.
14. Layout balance: {레이아웃} maintained so the hero card, small lifestyle cut, large copy, benefit modules, and bottom information band feel editorial and intentional.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the Korean headline in bold 700–800 weight, large display size; use a clean sans-serif English companion line in medium weight; keep spacing tight and premium, with realistic hierarchy for headline, subhead, benefit labels, and legal microcopy.
- Color palette: apply Shinhan blue, white, and gold accent as the main system, with off-white #F6F4EF, deep blue #0046A6, rich navy #0B1F3A, and metallic gold #C8A24A.
- Shadow and depth: use a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 15% opacity for the card and inset elements; add natural contact shadow under the card, glossy edge reflections, and subtle paper grain so the poster feels physically photographed and print-ready.
- Texture: smooth laminated card sheen, tactile chip detail, metallic foil accents, subtle paper-like background grain, faint brushed-metal highlight, and believable lifestyle-object textures such as leather, ceramic, glass, and printed receipt paper.
- Graphic details: include refined gold dividers, small benefit icons, QR-code area, barcode-like campaign strip, tiny grid labels, and bottom disclaimer text as part of a premium financial advertisement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end commercial product photography look, Phase One IQ4 style capture with 100mm macro lens at f/8 for the card hero, plus a separate 85mm f/1.8 feel for the lifestyle inset.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, slight rim highlight to define card edges, with warm specular control and clean reflections; lifestyle inset uses shallow-depth warm lounge lighting with soft highlight rolloff.
- Color grade: cool clean white base balanced with Shinhan blue, restrained gold highlights, and a slightly warm luxury finish reminiscent of premium bank campaign photography.

[6. MOOD]
Premium financial brand editorial — a polished Vogue Business / Aesop-adjacent luxury ad aesthetic with precise corporate restraint, realistic campaign details, tactile product materiality, and a confident modern Korean credit-card advertising tone.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - "신한카드"
  - "한글"
  - "영문 부제"
  - "혜택 카피"
- Additional Korean text to render clearly in the image: "나다운 선택이 가장 좋은 답", "2026 프리미엄 라이프 캠페인", "프리미엄 적립", "호텔·다이닝 혜택", "해외 이용 우대", "2026.05", "자세한 내용은 신한카드 앱에서 확인".
- Layout invariants: card hero must remain the dominant subject, the lifestyle cut must stay secondary, and the large copy must be clearly legible with a luxury ad hierarchy.
- Composition invariants: preserve realistic card geometry, readable Korean typography, controlled reflective highlights, and a credible premium finance poster structure with benefits, QR area, barcode-like strip, and fine-print information.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, awards, or certifications
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable typography
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean travel and hotel advertising poster, app-style promotional key visual for lodging discovery and booking.
Designed to feel like a mainstream OTA campaign card with clear price-led hierarchy, recognizable Korean travel context, app-commerce convenience, and category variety.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero area (top 55%): a bright Korean lodging travel scene showing {숙소 카테고리} as a polished booking-app hero image: a modern hotel room with crisp bedding, window sunlight, suitcase, keycard, coffee cup, travel tote, and small inset thumbnails for motel, pension, and guesthouse options.
- Campaign headline zone (middle 20%): {메인 카피} set in a strong, readable hierarchy with "야놀자" as the largest brand word, {영문 부제} beneath it, and {시작가} displayed as a bold booking price badge.
- App booking info zone (lower 18%): category chips, star rating, review count, map-pin location tag, coupon strip, QR/app download cue, and CTA button using {CTA 문구}.
- Footer strip (bottom 7%): practical campaign details including {프로모션명}, {예약 기간}, {체크인 기간}, {쿠폰 코드}, {앱핸들}, and {푸터 정보}, arranged like a real mobile commerce promotion footer.
- Overall framing: vertical 1024x1536 ad composition with a premium but approachable mass-market travel look, combining photographic lodging imagery, rounded app UI cards, lively decorative travel icons, and price-led conversion design.
- Color treatment: use {컬러 팔레트} across background, accents, coupon badge, CTA, and micro UI details, keeping the signature pink as the dominant highlight with warm amber support.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero visual: place {숙소 카테고리} as the main subject cluster, led by a welcoming hotel-room image and supported by small realistic thumbnail cards labeled 호텔, 모텔, 펜션, 게스트하우스 to communicate breadth of choice.
2) Brand headline: set {메인 카피} in a bold Korean-first ad layout, ensuring "야놀자" anchors the poster while {영문 부제} sits just beneath in smaller English type.
3) Price emphasis: integrate {시작가} as a compact booking promotion badge near the middle-lower area with high contrast, small calendar icon, and coupon-sticker styling.
4) Promotion details: add realistic OTA campaign information such as {예약 기간}, {체크인 기간}, {쿠폰 코드}, review count, app download QR placeholder, and a small terms line in the footer.
5) Category cue: reinforce {여행 테마} with visual cues like a Seoul map-pin label, weekend travel tag, suitcase, keycard, amenity tray, breakfast voucher, and category chips.
6) Tone pass: apply {브랜드 톤} so the whole composition feels like a recognizable Korean travel app advertisement rather than a generic hotel poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main Korean headline in Bold 800-900, with a smaller English subtitle in Medium 500-600; price text should be ExtraBold with tight tracking and strong legibility.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with supporting off-white #F7F4F2, deep charcoal #2B2B2B, warm highlight amber #F2B36C, and soft sky-blue travel micro accents for icons or map labels.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 0px 8px 18px at 18% opacity under the hero image and app UI cards, rounded booking-card edges, glossy coupon sticker highlights, and tactile layered paper-card depth.
- Graphic finish: clean commercial ad polish, crisp edges, mobile feed readability, realistic OTA interface details, small iconography for calendar/location/review, and a bright booking-app campaign finish.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame advertising photography look, equivalent to a 24–35mm lens at f/5.6 for a clear promo-key-visual perspective with moderate depth and readable space.
- Lighting: {무드·라이팅}; natural daylight mixed with warm amber practical accents, soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right to keep text zones clean and shadow detail stable.
- Color grade: warm pink + white + charcoal with light amber lift, slightly soft contrast, clean commercial retouching, bright booking-app campaign finish, and realistic Korean accommodation texture.

[6. MOOD]
Mainstream Korean OTA campaign visual — polished app-commerce travel ad with the approachable energy of a large hotel-booking service launch banner, friendly weekend-trip excitement, and practical price-saving appeal.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "야놀자", "한국 여행", "가성비", "다양", "호텔", "모텔", "펜션", "게스트하우스".
- 추가로 보이는 한글 요소: "오늘 예약하면 더 싸게", "국내숙소 특가", "서울·부산·제주", "쿠폰코드: {쿠폰 코드}", "예약기간 {예약 기간}", "체크인 {체크인 기간}", "앱에서 바로 예약", "리뷰 12,482개", "평점 4.8".
- Typography hierarchy must clearly separate brand name, English subtitle, price badge, CTA button, category chips, and footer terms; Hangul spacing must be natural and readable.
- Include realistic ad micro-details: QR/app icon placeholder, calendar icon, map-pin tag, star rating, coupon strip, small legal line, and travel props such as suitcase, keycard, coffee, amenity tray, or breakfast voucher.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity or politician composites implying endorsement
- Distorted people or altered human anatomy

[1. PURPOSE]
Airbnb 감성의 세로형 숙소 광고 포스터이자 라이프스타일 매거진 커버처럼 보이는 예약 유도 비주얼.
실제 숙소 사진, 표지형 발행 정보, 짧은 특집 헤드라인, 예약 안내, 지역 정보가 함께 들어간 따뜻한 감성 스테이 광고로 제작한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero: {숙소 유형}가 화면 중앙 55~60%를 차지하도록 배치하고, 공간의 가장 매력적인 한 면이 정면 또는 3/4 각도로 보이게 구성한다. 창가, 침구, 우드 가구, 조명, 바닥 질감이 실제 숙박 공간처럼 자연스럽게 드러나야 한다.
- Supporting details: 하단 또는 우측에 세라믹 머그, 린넨 슬리퍼, 펼친 동네 지도, 작은 꽃병, 객실 키 태그, 게스트북, 로컬 베이커리 봉투 같은 생활 소품을 배치해 머무는 감각을 만든다.
- Cover/ad elements: 상단에는 Airbnb masthead와 {발행 정보}, {지역명} 라벨을 배치하고, 중앙 사진 위에는 {메인 카피}를 얹는다. 좌우에는 2~3개의 표지형 특집 헤드라인을 잡지 커버처럼 자연스럽게 배치한다.
- Booking details: 하단 정보 영역에는 {숙박 가격}, {예약 문구}, {체크인 정보}, {편의시설}, {주소 연락처}를 작은 카드 형태로 넣고, 우하단에는 바코드와 예약 QR처럼 보이는 그래픽 코드를 함께 둔다.
- Apply {브랜드 톤} and {시그니처 결} consistently across the whole layout so the image feels like one coherent branded stay advertisement.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header zone (top 15%): Airbnb 로고타입 느낌의 masthead를 크게 두고, 그 옆이나 아래에 {한글 부제}, {발행 정보}, {지역명}을 표지 정보처럼 정렬한다.
- Hero zone (middle 48~52%): {숙소 유형}의 대표 공간을 가장 크게 보여주되, 실제 숙소 촬영 광고처럼 침구 주름, 원목결, 커튼의 빛 투과, 창밖 식물 그림자까지 현실감 있게 연출한다.
- Feature headline zone (side 15% overlay): {특집 헤드라인1}, {특집 헤드라인2}, {특집 헤드라인3}를 좌측 세로 라인 또는 우측 작은 박스에 배치하고, 코랄색 위치 핀, 작은 별표, 둥근 스티커 라벨 같은 장식 그래픽을 곁들인다.
- Lifestyle zone (lower-mid 18~20%): 머그, 책, 트레이, 조명, 로컬 지도, 손글씨 웰컴 카드, 작은 조식 바구니를 배치해 숙소에서 보낼 아침의 생활감을 보여준다.
- Info zone (bottom 15%): {숙박 가격}, {예약 문구}, {편의시설}, {체크인 정보}, {호스트명}, {주소 연락처}를 실제 예약 광고 하단 카드처럼 정리하고, 우측에는 {바코드 번호}가 적힌 바코드와 작은 QR-style booking code를 넣는다.
- Spine credit: 왼쪽 세로 가장자리에는 {스파인 크레딧}을 얇은 세로 타이포로 넣어 매거진 커버 같은 인쇄물 느낌을 강화한다.
- Texture layer: 전체 화면에 은은한 매거진 인쇄 질감, 종이결, 미세한 잉크 번짐을 더해 디지털 렌더보다 고급 편집 광고 인쇄물처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR 기반의 깔끔한 산세리프를 사용한다. Airbnb masthead는 세미볼드 56~72px, {한글 부제}는 28~36px, {메인 카피}는 38~48px, 특집 헤드라인은 22~30px, 하단 예약 정보는 16~22px로 계층을 만든다.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 기본으로 하되, 코랄 #FF5A5F, 아이보리 #FFF8EF, 베이지 #F3E7D3, 월넛 브라운 #8A6448, 차콜 #2F2F2F를 중심으로 따뜻한 중간톤을 유지한다.
- Graphic accents: 코랄색 위치 핀, 작은 별표, 둥근 amenity chips, 얇은 구분선, 바코드, QR-style code, 날짜 스티커, 로컬 지도 라인 그래픽을 사용해 실제 광고 포스터의 정보 밀도를 만든다.
- Grid: 12-column editorial grid를 사용해 숙소 이미지, masthead, 특집 헤드라인, 정물 사진, 예약 정보 카드, 바코드의 위치가 안정적으로 맞물리게 한다.
- Print finish: 텍스트와 사진 카드에는 아주 약한 soft drop shadow 0px 4px 12px 12% opacity를 적용하고, 종이 질감 위에 인쇄된 듯한 matte editorial finish로 마감한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 35mm lens at f/2.8 for the hero space, with a secondary 50mm look for lifestyle details so the scene feels like a high-end interior editorial.
- Lighting: {무드 라이팅}. Natural window light from upper-left at 45°, soft bounce fill from right, warm sunlight tone with no harsh hotspot; shadows stay gentle and realistic.
- Color grade: warm amber highlights + neutral beige mids + slightly desaturated coral accents + charcoal text, with a clean magazine-grade contrast curve.
- Material realism: linen bedding, wood grain, paper map, ceramic cup, matte printed poster texture, soft curtain fabric, subtle dust in sunlight, and realistic room depth should all be visible.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Airbnb-style boutique stay editorial — a Kinfolk x The Local Project interior spread feel, with the warmth of a Korean local travel magazine cover and the clarity of a real booking advertisement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 선명하게 렌더링할 화면 문구는 Airbnb, {한글 부제}, {메인 카피}, {발행 정보}, {지역명}, {특집 헤드라인1}, {특집 헤드라인2}, {특집 헤드라인3}이다.
- Booking text accuracy: 하단 정보 문구 {숙박 가격}, {예약 문구}, {편의시설}, {체크인 정보}, {호스트명}, {주소 연락처}, {바코드 번호}는 실제 광고처럼 읽을 수 있어야 한다.
- Layout invariant: 상단 masthead, 중앙 숙소 hero, 측면 특집 헤드라인, 하단 예약 정보 카드, 바코드/QR-style code의 구조가 유지되어야 한다.
- Text integrity: 한글은 깨짐 없이 선명해야 하고, 영문 Airbnb 표기는 오탈자 없이 정확해야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / verification badges
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable typography
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or lookalike endorsements

[1. PURPOSE]
Premium Korean luxury hotel advertisement poster, editorial-style vertical layout for brand campaign use. Designed to feel like a high-end hospitality print ad with suite room, Korean fine dining, scenic Seoul view, reservation information, and refined campaign copy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject block should occupy the upper 60% of the frame, with a polished hero composition built around {제품·소재}: a luxury suite interior, Korean dining table detail, tea service, linen, seasonal floral accent, and a window view toward Seoul/Namsan.
- Background treatment: refined luxury setting with tactile hanji-inspired paper grain, deep hotel-tone wall surfaces, warm wood, brushed brass, polished stone, soft fabric texture, and realistic hospitality details that naturally belong in a luxury hotel advertisement.
- Keep the layout vertically balanced with the hero scene slightly offset to one side for magazine-ad sophistication; build a clear typographic hierarchy with headline, subheadline, campaign period, booking information, and footer identity.
- Brand tone, signature texture, mood, palette, copy, and layout direction must follow {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, and {레이아웃}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero scene (top 60%): Present {제품·소재} as a polished luxury hospitality visual: suite bed corner or lounge chair, low dining table with refined 한식 코스 plating, porcelain tea cup, brass room key tag, folded menu card, fresh flowers, and a soft scenic depth cue through the window.
2. Secondary atmosphere layer: Add subtle Korean luxury hotel accents such as hanji texture, embroidered fabric, traditional lattice-inspired shadow, lacquer tray reflection, warm amber table lamp glow, and restrained gold line details.
3. Copy block (lower 25%): Place {카피·타이포} with the main Korean headline {메인 헤드라인}, English identity {영문 브랜드}, and supporting line {서브 카피}; the text should feel like a premium hotel campaign poster rather than a plain logo lockup.
4. Information footer (bottom 15%): Add realistic poster details: campaign period {캠페인 기간}, reservation line {예약 정보}, address {주소}, website {웹사이트}, and small footer note {푸터 문구}; include a neat sponsor/partner-style micro area labeled {파트너 표기} without using fake official certification marks.
5. Color application: Use {컬러 팔레트} across deep charcoal, muted gold, hanji beige, warm amber, ivory white, natural wood brown, and fine shadow gradients so the whole poster reads as one unified Korean luxury hospitality campaign.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main headline, with secondary English in a refined sans-serif; headline size should feel large and assertive like a premium hotel campaign poster, while footer information remains legible and realistic.
- Color palette: apply {컬러 팔레트} with dark charcoal hotel tones, restrained gold accents, warm beige hanji textures, ivory typography, and amber highlight details.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow at 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; avoid hard outlines and glossy 3D bevels.
- Decorative graphics: include fine gold divider lines, small hanji fiber speckles, a discreet Korean pattern motif, room-service style icon marks, and a reservation footer bar that supports the advertising layout.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame editorial advertising shot, 85mm f/1.8 for the hero details and shallow depth separation, with crisp luxury-commercial clarity.
- Lighting: natural daylight mixed with warm amber accent light, soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, controlled highlights on surfaces.
- Color grade: deep luxury blacks, warm amber highlights, muted gold, hanji beige, and clean white—high-end Korean hospitality editorial grading.
- Surface realism: emphasize tactile linen weave, porcelain glaze, brushed brass, stone tabletop, polished wood, hanji paper grain, and subtle reflections in glass without making the image look synthetic.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury hotel campaign editorial — akin to a premium Korean travel magazine spread with a polished The Shilla brand sensibility, intimate Korean hospitality, calm Seoul evening atmosphere, and refined dining-and-suite storytelling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 이미지에 정확히 들어가야 하는 문자열: "신라호텔", "The Shilla", "{메인 헤드라인}", "{서브 카피}", "{캠페인 기간}", "{예약 정보}", "{주소}", "{웹사이트}".
- 하단 정보 영역에는 "{푸터 문구}"와 "{파트너 표기}"를 작게 넣고, 실제 호텔 광고처럼 날짜·예약·주소가 읽히게 구성할 것.
- 객실, 다이닝, 남산 전망, 한지 질감, 금박 디바이더, 예약 정보가 함께 보이도록 하며 타이포그래피가 찌그러지거나 깨지지 않게 할 것.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Overly glossy AI-smooth rendering

[1. PURPOSE]
Luxury hotel advertisement hero layout for Marriott-style brand marketing, combining room hero, lounge, dining, and scenic hospitality cues into a polished editorial ad.
Designed for premium web banners, hospitality campaign posters, and social ads with a global magazine-like finish, with realistic booking information, campaign copy, and hospitality details integrated into the image.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject area: {제품·소재} arranged as a layered hospitality showcase, with the 객실 hero taking about 60% of the frame and the supporting 라운지·식당·풍경 elements integrated as secondary visual blocks.
- Background treatment: deep charcoal-to-warm-neutral hotel interior surface with visible marble veining, woven linen bedding, walnut wood, brushed brass, ceramic tableware, velvet seating, folded towels, fresh flowers, a room key card, and warm lamp reflections.
- Framing direction: strong horizontal premium-ad composition with a refined editorial grid; use a dedicated typography panel over the darker architectural portion while allowing the room, dining table, skyline window, and lounge vignette to feel inhabited and believable.
- Brand feel: apply {브랜드 톤} as the dominant visual voice, while keeping the scene aligned to {시그니처 결}.
- Realistic ad additions: include a small booking information strip, property/location label, campaign date label, rate line, website/contact line, and a discreet QR or barcode-style reservation area.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero zone (left or center-left, 55–60%): a cinematic luxury hotel room scene with crisp bedding, layered pillows, a textured throw blanket, elegant bedside lighting, polished marble nightstand, city-view window, warm reflections, and premium architectural depth.
- Secondary story zone (right or lower band, 25–30%): {제품·소재} elements such as lounge seating with a brass side table, refined dining details with wine glass, plated dessert or breakfast tray, menu card, linen napkin, and a softly lit exterior or cityscape cue, arranged as a curated hospitality story rather than a flat montage.
- Typography zone (upper-right or upper-center, 15–20%): place the main Marriott brand headline and supporting Korean subcopy in a crisp hierarchy, aligned to the grid and balanced with the imagery.
- Detail accents: introduce subtle gold highlights, soft edge glows, thin divider lines, small campaign tabs, corner labels, and premium editorial annotations so the advertisement reads as upscale corporate hospitality.
- Copy integration: place {카피·타이포} so the English and Korean text feel balanced, with the headline visually dominant and the smaller information supporting it.
- Information strip: add realistic short Korean ad details such as 2026 SUMMER STAY, 서울 리버사이드 스위트, 체크인 15:00, 조식 포함 패키지, 1박 ₩320,000부터, 예약 marriott.com/kr/stay, 문의 02-0000-2026.
- Layout logic: follow {레이아웃} exactly, keeping the hero image dominant and the text hierarchy clear.
- Proportion: maintain {비율} with a premium banner/poster feeling suitable for 1536x1024.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean body copy, paired with a clean serif or high-end sans serif for the headline; headline weight bold or semibold, subcopy medium, small info regular, with generous tracking on the brand line.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}; Marriott dark charcoal #1C1C1C, gold #C8A76A, warm white #F7F4EE, beige #D8CBB8, deep brown #4A3A2A.
- Border/shadow: soft luxury drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; thin gold separators, small label rules, and subtle frame lines may be used where they support the editorial ad hierarchy.
- Surface finish: polished editorial print look with slight paper grain or satin poster texture, not glossy plastic.
- Graphic details: include tasteful campaign microtext, tiny reservation icons, a small QR/barcode reservation block, and sponsor/partner-style text lines without making them look like official certification seals.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame architectural/hospitality photography look, 24mm wide-angle for room and layout balance, plus 50mm or 85mm detail feel for accents; f/4 to f/5.6 for clean depth separation.
- Lighting: {무드·라이팅}; soft natural daylight from large windows on one side, combined with warm amber practical lamps and a gentle rim light to define furniture edges; reflections controlled and realistic.
- Color grade: warm cream, gold, espresso brown, and charcoal black with a refined editorial contrast, similar to a luxury hospitality campaign in Condé Nast Traveler or The New York Times T Magazine style.
- Material realism: show believable hotel-scale proportions, natural fabric folds, real marble reflections, brushed metal edges, glass highlights, wood grain, and soft shadows from furniture and table objects.

[6. MOOD]
Premium global hotel campaign — Condé Nast Traveler / T Magazine hospitality editorial feel with a refined Marriott corporate-luxury finish.
The mood should feel like a real luxury suite advertisement photographed during golden hour: inviting, polished, aspirational, and ready for booking.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these exact visible text elements clearly where appropriate: Marriott, 한글 부제, 럭셔리 카피, 서울 리버사이드 스위트, 2026 SUMMER STAY, 조식 포함 패키지, 1박 ₩320,000부터, 예약하기.
- Include short Korean feature blurbs in the layout, such as 도심 속 프라이빗 휴식, 라운지 애프터눈 티, 한강 전망 스위트, 주말 한정 혜택.
- The composition must clearly present one dominant luxury hotel hero scene plus supporting hospitality scenes, without looking like a generic collage.
- Keep all typography sharp, evenly spaced, and fully legible; no broken Korean characters.
- Maintain upscale, realistic hotel proportions and materials; architecture, furniture, bedding, tableware, and window perspective must feel physically plausible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Extreme mountain outdoor brand advertisement poster in North Face-like editorial style, built for hero product promotion, expedition storytelling, and bold campaign messaging.
Wide landscape layout with cinematic alpine scale, optimized for web banner and print ad use, with realistic poster details such as campaign date, route information, sponsor strip, ticket/QR-style info block, and short Korean callouts.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero composition: a mountain landscape occupies the upper 55% of the frame, while the model sits on the right third in side profile, creating a strong diagonal tension from lower-left terrain to upper-right peak.
- Product emphasis: {제품·소재} must be clearly readable on the model or as the primary gear cluster, with crisp silhouette separation against the background and visible fabric grain, zipper lines, straps, buckles, snow dust, and wet rock reflections.
- Background treatment: dark alpine cliffs, wind-swept snow, rugged natural environment, spindrift, ice crystals, layered cloud bands, and deep atmospheric depth.
- Text placement: large headline area on the left or lower-left integrated into the terrain and sky, with supporting copy stacked beneath it and small expedition metadata aligned along the lower edge.
- Poster enrichment: include a campaign label such as “SUMMIT FIELD TEST 2026”, a Korean date/time/venue line, GPS-style coordinate strip, elevation marker, route-map graphic, sponsor/partner bar, small ticket or QR-style block, barcode-like inventory label, and realistic production credits.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as the guiding variables for the final render.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background base: establish a vast mountain range with sharp ridgelines, snow cornices, dark rock faces, drifting cloud, wind-blown powder, and natural texture filling the full canvas behind all foreground elements.
2) Hero terrain: place the most dramatic peak slightly off-center, with cloud break, depth haze, falling ice dust, and compressed telephoto scale to create an expedition-grade atmosphere.
3) Subject block: position the model in side profile on the right side, with strong outdoor posture, gloved hands, hood/helmet or beanie detail, visible backpack straps, trekking pole or ice axe attachment, and gear alignment that supports the extreme-mountain identity.
4) Product read layer: feature {제품·소재} with high clarity, clean edges, realistic material texture, weathering, seam construction, reflective trims, snow residue, and enough surrounding mountain context to make the gear feel field-tested.
5) Typography block: set {카피·타이포} as a bold campaign headline cluster, with the English brand line and Korean supporting copy locked into a disciplined editorial grid; add short Korean blurbs such as “한계선 위의 보온”, “바람을 가르는 레이어”, and “정상까지 4.8km”.
6) Layout balance: keep the left-side copy field and right-side action field so the composition feels like a premium expedition advertisement rather than a generic sports poster, while adding practical poster information along the top and bottom edges.
7) Event and detail layer: add “2026.02.14 SAT 05:30”, “강원 설악 능선 테스트”, “ALT. 2,708M”, “ROUTE A-17”, “입장 안내 ₩0 / 사전 등록”, “문의 outdoor@field.kr”, tiny map contour lines, red technical arrows, and small credit text “Photo: KIM JIHO / Model: LEE HAJUN”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use bold condensed sans serif styling such as Helvetica Neue Condensed, DIN Condensed, or Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline; Korean support text in Noto Sans KR Bold; headline size large and tightly tracked.
- Color palette: deep charcoal #111111, alpine red #D71920, forest green #2E5B3F, cold gray #BFC7CF, snow white #F4F6F8.
- Graphic system: use hard-edged red expedition rules, small white metadata labels, barcode-like black blocks, route-map contour lines, thin altitude ticks, and technical annotation arrows that feel printed on a premium outdoor campaign poster.
- Depth and separation: subtle hard-edged separation with low-opacity shadow 15%, 6px y-offset, 16px blur; create contrast through sunlight, rock texture, snow haze, and terrain layers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: shot like a premium outdoor campaign on a Canon EOS R5 with 70-200mm f/2.8 at 135mm, f/4 for compressed mountain scale and subject separation.
- Lighting: dramatic overcast break with hard directional sunlight cutting through cloud gaps from upper-left, plus cool ambient fill from snow bounce on the lower half.
- Color grade: cold alpine blacks, deep red accents, muted green terrain, and slightly steel-blue shadows with high local contrast.
- Realism detail: natural lens compression, fine snow particles, fabric weave, condensation on gear, scratched metal hardware, boot tread, wind tension in jacket fabric, believable facial profile, and printed poster typography that sits cleanly on top of the photographic scene.

[6. MOOD]
Premium extreme-sport campaign — like a The North Face expedition ad shot with National Geographic-level mountain grandeur, modern editorial grit, tactical outdoor confidence, and a real commercial poster finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “노스페이스 톤”, “extreme 산악 + 등산 + 다이나믹 자연”, “다운자켓 / 등산화 / 백팩 / 텐트”, “산·자연 풍경 + dramatic 라이트”, “다크 + 빨강 (노스페이스) + 자연 그린”, “영문 The North Face + 한글 + extreme 카피”, “산 풍경 hero + 모델 측면 + 큰 카피”, “1536x1024”, “한글·영문 정확”.
- Required poster text to render crisply in Korean: “한계선 위의 보온”, “정상까지 4.8km”, “강원 설악 능선 테스트”, “2026.02.14 SAT 05:30”, “ALT. 2,708M”, “ROUTE A-17”, “입장 안내 ₩0 / 사전 등록”, “Photo: KIM JIHO / Model: LEE HAJUN”.
- Framing invariant: keep the mountain hero scale dominant, the model in side profile, and the headline zone clearly separated from the subject silhouette while still containing realistic expedition poster details.
- Typography invariant: all Korean and English text must remain crisp, correctly spelled, aligned to a premium ad layout, and legible as printed campaign graphics.

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]

- Background treatment: deep dark studio arena backdrop with smoky floor haze, diagonal motion streaks, subtle turf / track texture, backlit dust particles, and high-contrast rim highlights that make the hero feel fast and physical.
- Spacing and framing: create a clear top campaign headline zone, a central hero-action zone, and a bottom information zone with launch details, QR-style ticket block, sponsor strip, and product specification tags.
- Typography zones: set {메인 카피} as the oversized headline, place {한글 부제} directly beneath it, add {모델명} and {컬렉션명} near the hero, and include the pop-up event information in the lower third.

2. Hero area (mid 55%): stage the athlete and/or product from {제품·소재} in a dynamic jump, sprint, or kicking motion with fabric tension, flying laces, scuffed sole details, sweat highlights, and sharp rim-lit contours against the dark arena-style backdrop.
3. Signature element layer: integrate a large PUMA cat-style graphic slash behind or beside the hero, using {컬러 팔레트} as an energetic accent; add diagonal speed lines, micro grid marks, and small technical labels such as “GRIP CONTROL”, “LIGHTWEIGHT FIT”, “TRAIN FAST”.
4. Accent and product detail layer: emphasize outsole texture, stitched panels, synthetic upper sheen, rubber grip pattern, and impact marks with crisp highlights; include a small close-up product callout box with “{제품 특징}”.
5. Footer area (bottom 15%): add realistic poster information: “{행사명}”, “{행사일시}”, “{행사장소}”, “입장 {티켓 정보}”, store / online release note, sponsor area reading “SUPPORTED BY {스폰서명}”, and a compact QR-code-like square with label “SCAN FOR DROP”.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Graphic treatment: use subtle soft drop shadows 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity on text and floating elements; add premium editorial grain, angled crop bars, product spec chips, and motion overlays without weakening the hero hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: studio setup with a strong key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, hard-edged rim light from right, and controlled fill from front-low; create athletic highlights, dramatic shadow shape, and glossy edge definition on footwear materials.
- Color grade: high-contrast black/white base with vivid PUMA accent color, slightly cool-neutral skin and product tones, clean commercial finish, sharp blacks, bright controlled whites, and premium magazine-ad polish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium global sports campaign — high-energy PUMA launch poster with Adidas/Nike-style commercial intensity, kinetic Korean retail-event realism, dramatic studio lighting, and a polished magazine-ad finish.

[7. CRITICAL]

- Layout invariants: keep the poster vertical at 1024x1536, with a dominant hero, oversized headline, clear launch-event footer, visible product callouts, and sharp PUMA-style graphic clarity.
- Preserve the intended PUMA dynamic sports advertising feel, with strong motion, premium contrast, realistic product texture, and campaign-ready typography.

Premium athletic-lifestyle ad for a New Balance classic sneaker, designed for social commerce, e-commerce listing thumbnails, and in-store digital poster use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero placement: the sneaker occupies the central 55–60% of the frame as the main product hero, angled in a polished 3/4 view with a small secondary apparel cue nearby such as folded rib socks, spare laces, or a fabric hangtag that reinforces lifestyle context.
- Background treatment: off-white to light gray studio surface with visible matte paper grain, seamless vinyl texture, faint scuff marks, soft grounding shadow, and subtle layered paper-card inserts behind the shoe for a real photographed campaign set.
- Retail poster framing: balanced square composition with clear ad zones for product name, Korean subtitle, price, model info, launch date, small barcode/QR-style retail block, and store/contact details.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as controllable variables for tone, product focus, lighting, palette, typography, and layout density.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main hero area (center 60%): showcase the {제품·소재} as the dominant object, cleanly separated from the background, with realistic mesh, suede or leather material detail, visible stitching, perforations, lace weave, outsole texture, and a soft natural shadow beneath it.
2. Supporting detail zone: place a small close-up inset card or lower-corner product cue showing side-panel stitching, outsole tread, spare laces, or a sock cuff; label it with short Korean microcopy such as "프리미엄 스웨이드", "클래식 쿠셔닝", or "데일리 핏" while keeping it secondary to the main sneaker.
3. Copy block area: build a structured ad hierarchy using {카피·타이포}: one large brand line, one smaller Korean subtitle, one model-number line, a price line, and a compact release-date label. Include short Korean campaign copy such as "클래식은 매일 새롭다", "한글 부제", "2026 봄 에디션", "₩129,000", and "온라인 단독 컬러".
4. Realistic poster details: add a small retail barcode area, QR-style square, product SKU line, size-range note, address/contact line, and tiny credit text such as "STYLED BY NB SEOUL" or "PHOTO CREDIT: KIM STUDIO" to make the ad feel like a finished commercial campaign.
5. Layout balance: align the ad elements so the {레이아웃} reads instantly at a glance, with the hero product leading, typography supporting the purchase decision, and secondary tags arranged like a real fashion retail poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean text, paired with a clean sans-serif like Helvetica Neue or Inter for English; brand line in bold semi-condensed weight, subtitle in medium weight, small info in regular weight, and micro labels in tight uppercase or Korean caption style.
- Color palette: build from {컬러 팔레트} with off-white #F5F3EE, soft gray #D9D9D9, deep charcoal #222222, and one restrained accent color matching the sneaker detail; use accent color for small stickers, price marker, or release-date tab.
- Graphic system: include thin rule lines, small product-spec chips, a barcode block, modest paper-label shapes, and subtle editorial dividers that feel like premium sportswear retail design.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity; keep product edges crisp and add believable contact shadows, surface grain, and natural photographic contrast.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end product photography look, shot on a Canon EOS R5 with a 100mm macro or 85mm prime at f/5.6 for crisp material detail, controlled depth, and sharp sneaker construction.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° combined with gentle daylight fill, plus a faint rim light from the right to define the silhouette and outsole edges; allow soft reflections on leather or mesh without making the product look plastic.
- Color grade: neutral cool-gray base with a subtle New Balance-style white balance, restrained contrast, realistic shadows, visible paper texture, and clean commercial color separation.

[6. MOOD]
Premium athletic editorial — a clean, modern sneaker campaign feel inspired by high-end sportswear ads, Korean fashion retail posters, and polished magazine product photography with tactile materials and purchase-ready information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the image must render these Korean strings exactly and legibly: "한글 부제", "클래식은 매일 새롭다", "2026 봄 에디션", "온라인 단독 컬러".
- English text accuracy: the image must render these English strings exactly and legibly: "New Balance", "MADE FOR EVERYDAY", "STYLED BY NB SEOUL".
- Price and retail text accuracy: if shown, keep "₩129,000", "SIZE 220–290", and "SEOUL EDITION" visually crisp and correctly formatted.
- Model-number accuracy: if shown, keep the sneaker model number visually crisp and correctly formatted.
- Product integrity: the sneaker must remain anatomically and structurally realistic, with correct sole shape, lace geometry, toe box volume, heel counter, side logo placement, material seams, and believable scale relative to the props.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]

Editorial commercial ad for sneakers / tracksuit / jacket, designed for a vertical 1024x1536 poster and social media campaign use, with realistic print-ad density: headline, drop date, store info, QR/barcode area, and short Korean feature blurbs.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {제품·소재} as the hero product, shown with a full-body model pose that feels campaign-ready, premium, and wearable in a real streetwear context.
- Subject placement: model occupies the center 65% of the frame, with a strong vertical stance, readable full-body silhouette, and bold copy placed around the upper and side areas without covering the key product details.
- Background treatment: urban street texture, concrete wall, asphalt edge, subway-tile fragments, layered street posters, worn paint, and architectural lines, slightly desaturated with realistic depth separation from the subject.
- Framing direction: {레이아웃} while keeping the product silhouette readable and the Adidas-style three-stripe energy visually dominant.
- Typography zone: integrate {카피·타이포} as the main campaign line, plus small retail details, model credit, product code, price label, and a QR/barcode-style block so the poster feels like a finished commercial advertisement.
- Ratio guidance: preserve {비율} as a tall vertical fashion poster layout with strong full-body scale and clear product visibility from head to shoes.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero zone: Place the full-body model and {제품·소재} as the primary visual anchor, with a confident stance, crisp separation from the background, and visible garment folds, shoe details, laces, seams, zipper pulls, and stripe accents.
2. Background layer: Build a city-leaning backdrop with concrete, asphalt, architectural shadows, scuffed wall texture, pasted poster remnants, subtle street signage, and realistic ground contact shadows beneath the model.
3. Brand accent layer: Add a small, restrained signature mark inspired by {브랜드 톤}; a compact trefoil-like mark, three-stripe motif, product-tag graphic, or small logo lockup may appear on the poster as part of the campaign design.
4. Motion and styling cues: Emphasize {시그니처 결} through pose energy, garment folds, sneaker angle, wind-touched fabric, sporty accessories, and sharp streetwear layering.
5. Copy block: Set {카피·타이포} in a clean advertising hierarchy with a bold Korean headline, compact subcopy, campaign season line, model-name credit, and short feature blurbs.
6. Campaign detail layer: Add realistic poster information such as “ORIGINALS CITY DROP”, “2026.05.18 RELEASE”, “서울 성수 플래그십”, “AM 11:00 OPEN”, “₩129,000부터”, “제품 코드: ORG-26-SS”, “MODEL: JIWON K.”, and a small QR/barcode area at the lower corner.
7. Color balance: Use {컬러 팔레트} across clothing highlights, shadows, concrete tones, typography, and graphic accents so the palette stays consistent and unmistakable.
8. Lighting integration: Apply {무드·라이팅} with fashion-campaign polish, realistic skin and fabric response, and ambient bounce from the urban environment.
9. Final polish: Match the overall advertising finish with crisp edges, premium contrast, realistic print texture, carefully layered typography, and a polished campaign look that feels ready for street posters, retail windows, and social media.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold sans-serif ad typography, inspired by Helvetica Neue / Akzidenz Grotesk / Pretendard Bold, with tight leading for the main line and medium weight for subtitles, product details, and Korean microcopy.

- Detail typography: include small campaign text blocks such as “VOL.026 / CITY SERIES”, “2026년 5월 캠페인”, “@originals_seoul”, “STYLE CODE A-726”, “DROP INFO”, and “SCAN FOR LOOKBOOK”.

- Graphic treatment: allow thin editorial divider rules, diagonal stripe accents, tiny barcode/QR retail marks, subtle product-callout labels, and polished campaign footer details; shadows remain soft and controlled under products, approx. 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, with subtle rim light for separation.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, shot on a Phase One IQ4 or Hasselblad medium format body with an 80–110mm lens at f/8 for crisp cosmetic detail and clean label rendering.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a large softbox, gentle fill from front-right, and a narrow rim light from behind to define edges and packaging contours; include realistic specular highlights on glass, metal caps, pumps, acrylic, and glossy cartons.
- Color grade: deep black-and-white luxury base with restrained neutral highlights, premium contrast, slight cool tint in shadows, clean editorial sharpness, and believable print-ad texture suitable for a flagship beauty campaign.

[6. MOOD]
Premium global beauty campaign — Sephora flagship launch editorial with a high-fashion retail presentation feel, combining dramatic studio luxury with realistic store-poster information, tactile cosmetic materials, and elegant Korean advertising copy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: "Sephora 톤", "글로벌 뷰티 + 럭셔리 + 시크", "프리미엄 화장품 / 향수 / 메이크업 / 스킨", "스튜디오 + dramatic 라이트 + 부드러운 그림자", "Sephora 블랙 + 화이트 + 시그니처 액센트", "영문 \"SEPHORA\" + 한글 부제 + 럭셔리 카피", "제품 hero + 럭셔리 결 + 작은 가격".
- Additional visible Korean retail copy should be clean and plausible: "2026.05.01 출시", "₩89,000부터", "강남 플래그십", "오늘의 럭셔리 루틴", "새로운 시그니처 광채".
- Composition invariant: maintain a luxury product hero-centered ad layout with vertical hierarchy, accurate spacing, premium editorial balance, realistic retail details, and strong focus on {제품·소재}.
- Text rendering: Korean and English letterforms must be clean, sharp, and correctly spelled with no broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, certification marks, or award badges
- Broken Korean characters or garbled mixed-language typography

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
K-beauty nature-inspired vertical ad poster for a skincare brand, editorial product campaign with premium retail polish and believable in-store campaign details.
Natural botanical composition, product-forward layout, social-media and print-ad ready, enriched with realistic campaign text, product callouts, date label, price cue, QR/barcode-style retail area, and small brand-credit typography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main product zone: place {제품·소재} as the central hero group, occupying about 42% of the frame height, with one dominant product slightly forward and the rest staggered behind for depth; set them on a pale stone or ceramic display slab with realistic contact shadows, dew beads, and a few scattered green-tea leaves.
- Botanical zone: surround the hero with fresh 제주-inspired leaves, stems, green tea sprigs, seed pods, soft plant textures, translucent gel droplets, and subtle paper-fiber texture that frame the products while keeping labels readable.
- Header zone: use the upper 18% for the INNISFREE wordmark or configured brand wordmark, a campaign date label, and a concise Korean headline. Add small editorial text such as "2026 SPRING GREEN TEA CAMPAIGN", "VOL.05", and "제주 자연에서 찾은 수분 루틴".
- Mid-copy zone: place 2–3 short Korean benefit blurbs around the product group as refined retail callouts, for example "수분 장벽 케어", "맑은 생기", "산뜻한 흡수감", aligned to the visual rhythm of {레이아웃}.
- Lower information zone: include supporting Korean copy, product-name credit, price cue, store/handle line, and a small QR/barcode-style block: "NEW GREEN TEA LINE", "기획세트 ₩28,000부터", "innisfree.com  |  @innisfreeofficial", "모델: 김하린".
- Background treatment: bright matte off-white base with subtle natural paper texture, faint green haze at the edges, soft botanical shadows, and a real printed-ad surface feeling.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃} as the customizable design direction while keeping the ad recognizably botanical and premium.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background first: build a premium cream-white field with visible natural paper grain, faint botanical wash, and soft shadow impressions like a high-end skincare print advertisement photographed on textured stock.
2) Hero products next: position {제품·소재} in the center-lower middle, front-facing, crisply separated, with realistic label clarity, specular highlights on caps or glass, and grounded shadows on the stone/ceramic surface.
3) Botanical framing: add 제주 자연 + 식물 accents to the left and right edges, including green tea leaves, small stems, droplets, and soft overlapping shadows that guide the eye toward the center products without covering important label text.
4) Brand headline area: place "INNISFREE" or the configured brand wordmark near the top center in a strong refined typographic lockup, with Korean subtitle just below: "제주 녹차 수분 루틴". Add a tiny date/series label such as "2026.05 | JEJU GREEN TEA EDITION".
5) Campaign copy area: add one short nature-driven line under the headline, for example "나다운 피부 균형을 위한 산뜻한 수분", plus two compact side blurbs near the products: "수분 장벽 케어" and "가볍게 스며드는 텍스처".
6) Retail detail layer: integrate small but legible product-ad details at the bottom, including "NEW", "기획세트 ₩28,000부터", "온라인 단독 구성", "QR로 성분 스토리 보기", a barcode/QR-style rectangle, and a small vertical credit line along one side: "PHOTO NATURAL LIGHT / MODEL 김하린 / JEJU BOTANICAL ARCHIVE".
7) Finishing details: integrate dew-like highlights, realistic leaf veins, paper fibers, soft leaf overlaps, tiny pollen specks, gentle surface reflections, and clean label visibility so the composition reads as a finished natural beauty advertisement rather than a blank mockup.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR SemiBold for the main Korean title, 46–64px feel; use Pretendard Medium for supporting text, 20–26px feel; use 9–14px feel microtype for product details, barcode label, campaign date, handle, and credit text; pair with clean all-caps sans serif for English.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with fresh greens like #2F6B3C and #7FB77E, clean white #F7F7F2, soft leaf beige #E8E1D0, and a small natural accent like botanical yellow #C9D26A.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity under products; allow faint printed-paper edge tonality, soft botanical cast shadows, and natural surface reflections, with no hard outline and no glossy frame.
- Layout discipline: keep a premium magazine-ad balance with clear hierarchy between wordmark, headline, hero products, benefit blurbs, and retail detail block; make product labels, campaign headline, and price/handle microcopy readable.
- Graphic details: add delicate dividers, tiny leaf icons, small rectangular date labels, a product-code line such as "GT-247 HYDRATION SET", and a barcode/QR-style area that feels like real retail campaign artwork.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio product photography look, 85mm f/1.8 for product isolation and gentle depth separation, with crisp label clarity.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left at roughly 45°, with a subtle fill from front-right and a faint leafy bounce creating natural green edge tones.
- Color grade: fresh cream + botanical green + soft earth accents, with restrained contrast and clean premium K-beauty tonality.
- Material realism: translucent skincare gel, matte paper stock, ceramic or stone pedestal, glass/plastic bottle reflections, moist leaf texture, and fine dew droplets should feel photographed rather than flat.

[6. MOOD]
Premium botanical skincare campaign — like a high-end Innisfree print ad with natural editorial restraint, retail-ready Korean beauty campaign polish, and a fresh 제주 green-tea atmosphere that feels tactile, bright, and realistic.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly and clearly when used in the design: {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율}.
- Required visible campaign text: include clean, correct Korean lines such as "제주 녹차 수분 루틴", "나다운 피부 균형을 위한 산뜻한 수분", "수분 장벽 케어", "가볍게 스며드는 텍스처", "기획세트 ₩28,000부터", and "QR로 성분 스토리 보기".
- Composition invariants: product labels must remain legible, the layout must stay vertically balanced, and the botanical framing must not obscure the hero products.
- Text rendering: all Korean and English text must be clean, correct, and free of broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean beauty retail advertisement poster, fashion-forward product-led brand promo for mobile feed and poster display.

The image should feel like a real in-store campaign poster photographed and designed for a flagship K-beauty retailer, with layered product information, retail tags, and seasonal promotion details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas is vertical poster format; the main product zone occupies the lower-mid 45% with a structured retail-display feel, while the model hero area takes 30%–35% of the upper half.
- Background uses a bright white base with Olive Young green accents, subtle gradient blocks, translucent category panels, glossy acrylic shelf cues, and faint store-light reflections; keep surfaces premium and commercially polished.
- Place {브랜드 톤} as the overall design direction, with {시그니처 결} expressed through dense but orderly category variety, layered labels, product swatches, and retail merchandising depth.
- Arrange {제품·소재} in grouped clusters rather than scattered single items: skincare bottles, cushion compacts, lip tints, serum ampoules, fragrance boxes, shampoo tubes, cotton pads, sample sachets, and small tester trays.
- Use {무드·라이팅} to create realistic beauty-store shine: soft reflections on plastic caps, glass serum bottles, metallic makeup cases, and laminated price tags.
- Keep {레이아웃} balanced: hero figure, product stack, headline, category tabs, promo stickers, and price labels should read instantly at thumbnail size while still containing rich retail detail up close.
- Use {비율} to guide the relationship between model, headline, product clusters, and promotion callouts.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): set the main Korean headline in bold retail typography, aligned center or slightly left depending on balance, with a strong brand-banner feel. Include a small campaign kicker such as "2026 SUMMER BEAUTY PICK", "올영 단독 기획", and a compact date label "2026.05.01–05.31".
2. Brand identity strip (upper-mid 10%): show {브랜드 톤} as a concise subline or brand voice cue, using compact sans-serif text and a clean separator rule. Add tiny retail microcopy: "APP 쿠폰 적용 가능", "오늘드림", "온라인·매장 동시 진행".
3. Hero area (mid 30%): present the model or fashion-beauty lead as a polished campaign subject, framed like a modern retail ad, with crisp cutout edges, glossy skin texture, fashionable hair styling, and a confident shopping-bag pose. Add a small model-name credit line near the figure: "MODEL. 지윤 / BEAUTY EDIT".
4. Product display zone (lower-mid 30%): show {제품·소재} as a curated assortment of skincare, makeup, color cosmetics, perfume, and hair products, ordered by category and size. Include readable category tabs in Korean: "스킨케어", "메이크업", "헤어·바디", "향수", plus small shelf labels and product-card tags.
5. Price and promo callouts (mid-lower 10%): include high-contrast retail labels with short Korean copy and realistic prices such as "신상", "가격", "오늘 특가", "1+1", "쿠폰가 ₩12,900", "기획세트 ₩24,000", "멤버십 추가 적립". Use sticker shapes, green pill labels, small orange accent flags, and barcode/QR-code style promo blocks.
6. Footer zone (bottom 10%): place supporting copy and brand signage in a retail footer band. Include store details and app CTA: "OLIVE YOUNG BEAUTY CURATION", "전국 매장 및 공식 온라인몰", "앱에서 쿠폰 확인", "고객센터 1522-0882", and a small disclaimer line in Korean.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline, Pretendard Medium for support text, and Noto Sans KR Bold for price callouts; headline size should feel billboard-like, support text compact and retail-clean.
- Apply {카피·타이포} to headline hierarchy and promo labels, ensuring Korean copy feels like authentic retail advertising rather than placeholder text.
- Color palette: Olive Young green, pure white #FFFFFF, cool light gray #EEF1F4, deep charcoal #1F1F1F, and one signature accent from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Border/shadow: use soft retail-product shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; add thin white borders around select callout labels for catalog clarity.
- Decorative retail elements: include glossy sticker badges, shelf-edge price cards, tiny barcode area, app QR placeholder, translucent rounded rectangles, product swatch circles, and subtle dotted divider lines.
- Korean retail text should be short and legible: examples include "나다운 뷰티 루틴", "요즘 뜨는 신상", "피부결 케어", "컬러 맛집", "장바구니 PICK".

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end commercial fashion ad look shot on a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 for the model and a 50mm lens for product grouping, crisp focus with shallow background separation.
- Lighting: bright softbox key from upper-left at 45°, subtle fill from right, controlled specular highlights on packaging, and gentle ambient bounce for a clean storefront finish.
- Color grade: fresh retail white with Olive Young green, balanced amber warmth, and slightly desaturated editorial contrast for a polished Korean beauty campaign look.
- Materials should feel real: semi-gloss paper labels, matte cosmetic tubes, glass serum bottles with liquid depth, reflective compact cases, laminated price cards, clear acrylic shelf risers, and soft cosmetic powder textures.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean beauty retail campaign — Olive Young flagship ad meets high-end magazine merchandising energy, like a Harper’s Bazaar Korea x urban beauty store promo.
The mood is bright, confident, trend-aware, and purchase-driven, with the lively density of an actual K-beauty promotion wall and the polish of a fashion editorial.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the final image:
  - "OLIVE YOUNG"
  - "신상"
  - "가격"
- Additional Korean text should be clear and plausible, such as "2026.05.01–05.31", "오늘드림", "APP 쿠폰", "쿠폰가 ₩12,900", "전국 매장 및 공식 온라인몰".
- Composition invariants: keep the retail-ad structure clearly readable with model hero, product clusters, headline, category tabs, app/promo details, and pricing callouts all visible in one frame.

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
CGV-style cinema advertisement poster, vertical promo composition for a popcorn combo and theater ticket set.
Designed as a cinematic retail ad with strong brand-led hierarchy, suitable for digital signage, social feed, or in-theater promotional display, with realistic multiplex lobby details, snack textures, ticket graphics, and readable Korean promo information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero placement: {시그니처 결} occupies the central 55% of the frame, with the largest visual mass slightly below center so the top area can carry the CGV logo, main headline, and short campaign label.
- Background treatment: deep theater-black backdrop with subtle vignette, faint screen-glow haze, soft auditorium wall texture, red aisle-light reflections, and a few blurred cinema lobby highlights in the distance.
- Framing direction: tall vertical poster layout, tight hero framing, energetic retail-ad layering, with headline information at the top, the popcorn combo hero in the center, and a ticket-style offer panel with price, period, venue, and app/QR area at the bottom.
- Brand expression: apply {브랜드 톤} consistently across the poster so the result reads like an official CGV promotional visual rather than a generic snack ad.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero zone (center 55%): place {시그니처 결} as the dominant centerpiece, with the popcorn hero rendered crisp, abundant, buttery, and overflowing; integrate realistic supporting cinema cues such as two red movie tickets, a folded paper ticket sleeve, drink cups with condensation, straw highlights, and scattered popcorn kernels.
2. Product cluster: position {제품·소재} in a layered arrangement beside or slightly behind the hero, with realistic depth separation, glossy reflections, ticket-edge shadows, cup condensation, paper bucket texture, and warm salt-butter highlights so the popcorn remains the primary focus.
3. Lighting accents: use {무드·라이팅} to create glossy highlights on kernels, ticket edges, plastic cup lids, condensation droplets, and red brand surfaces, with soft warm reflections that suggest a lobby counter and screen-lit environment.
4. Brand copy block: set {카피·타이포} in the upper zone as a polished ad headline system: include the CGV logo, a short Korean campaign line such as "오늘은 팝콘각", a secondary line such as "무비 콤보 스페셜", and a tiny English kicker like "MOVIE NIGHT COMBO".
5. Offer details: place {레이아웃} in the lower section as a realistic promotional ticket panel with compact information: "2인 영화관람권 + 라지팝콘 + 탄산 2잔", "₩29,000", "2026.05.01 - 05.31", "전국 CGV 매점 · CGV APP", small terms line "일부 극장 제외 / 재고 소진 시 종료", plus a small barcode or QR-code style box labeled "APP COUPON".
6. Color balance: anchor the design with {컬러 팔레트}, using CGV red as the brand accent while preserving strong contrast against the dark cinema background; allow warm gold popcorn tones, clean white type, charcoal panels, and small amber highlights.
7. Format control: keep {비율} as a full poster canvas with cinematic poster proportions, realistic ad layering, visible promo metadata, snack textures, ticket graphics, and small retail details that support the CGV movie-theater campaign.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main Korean brand line, with Noto Sans KR Medium for secondary English subcopy; headline size should feel poster-scale, roughly 64–92px equivalent, while offer text, date, venue, and terms stay compact and legible.
- Color palette: use CGV red, charcoal black, warm gold, and clean white from {컬러 팔레트}; allow amber popcorn highlights, metallic ticket edges, red gradient panels, and small white microcopy against black background dominance.
- Poster details: add a realistic lower ticket-strip area with perforation marks, small barcode block, app coupon icon area, price tag shape, section dividers, and short Korean feature blurbs such as "버터향 가득", "영화 시작 전 필수", "앱 쿠폰 사용 가능".
- Border/shadow: add a subtle cinematic drop shadow under the hero cluster, about 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, plus faint red-and-gold edge glow around the popcorn bucket, drink cups, and ticket stack for separation.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: premium studio product-photo look shot on a Canon EOS R5 with an RF 85mm f/1.2 for shallow depth separation, or a 50mm close commercial framing for the full hero cluster.
- Lighting: theater-inspired low-key lighting with a soft key from upper-left at 45°, warm fill from lower-right, and a thin rim light to outline the popcorn, red ticket edges, and drink glass.
- Color grade: rich cinema blacks, saturated CGV red accents, warm gold highlights, and clean white typography with mild contrast compression for an ad-like finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium cinema lobby promotional poster — polished CGV in-theater ad aesthetic with a premium multiplex campaign feel, appetizing popcorn realism, energetic ticket-night excitement, and a believable retail promotion layout.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly and cleanly as "CGV".
- Korean text accuracy: include clear Korean promo text such as "오늘은 팝콘각", "무비 콤보 스페셜", "2인 영화관람권 + 라지팝콘 + 탄산 2잔", "₩29,000", "2026.05.01 - 05.31", and "전국 CGV 매점 · CGV APP" with no broken characters.
- Layout invariant: popcorn hero must remain the dominant focal point, with cinema-related supporting elements, tickets, drinks, price, date, venue, app coupon, and small terms kept secondary.
- Composition invariant: strong dark background, warm light accents, CGV red emphasis, glossy snack realism, and a vertical promotional poster hierarchy must stay consistent throughout.

4. Price zone: set {대표 가격} or promo message in a large secondary block with high readability, heavy condensed numerals, won symbol, and a small red discount badge.
5. Promotion detail zone: include {프로모션명}, {행사 기간}, {쿠폰 코드}, and {CTA} as real ad information, placed in a compact ribbon or coupon strip.
6. Supporting product zone: show {서브 세트} as a smaller set near the hero food, with a drink cup, fries, sauce cup, or bucket element if appropriate, matching the same lighting and color tone.
7. Store/app info zone: add {매장·앱 정보}, {해시태그}, tiny delivery-app style icons, and QR-code placeholder at the bottom, like a finished retail campaign poster.
8. Frame control: maintain a vertical 1024x1536 ad composition that feels centered, premium, and immediately readable on mobile.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use bold sans-serif commercial fonts such as Pretendard ExtraBold, Noto Sans KR Bold, or Montserrat Black for the main headline; use smaller Noto Sans KR Medium for subcopy; keep price numerals heavy and condensed-looking.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with saturated red, clean white, and warm Kentucky brown; add warm beige, golden crust yellow, and dark cocoa shadow tones for appetizing depth.
- Graphic system: combine red blocks, white coupon strips, rounded price badge, diagonal speed lines, sauce-splash accents, and small “NEW”, “HOT”, “앱 주문” labels so the poster feels like a real limited-time QSR promotion.
- Food realism: emphasize crispy ridges, oil sheen, irregular crust flakes, pepper specks, steam hints, sauce gloss, and natural crumbs on the tray surface.
- Border/shadow: add a soft realistic drop shadow under the chicken hero, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; keep edge separation sharp and clean.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial food photography look, full-frame 85mm f/2.8 for the hero cutout, or 100mm macro detail for crispy texture close-up.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, strong fill from front-right, subtle warm rim light to define the crust and keep the chicken glossy.
- Color grade: warm fast-food campaign grade with saturated red, clean white balance, rich golden browns, controlled contrast, and appetizing specular highlights on fried crust and sauce.
- Finish: high-resolution print-ad finish, sharp typography, realistic product shadows, tactile paper texture in background, and clean mobile readability.

[6. MOOD]
Premium fast-food campaign poster — polished international QSR ad with the assertive hierarchy of a KFC promotional billboard, energetic Korean delivery-app promotion feeling, and indulgent crispy chicken close-up appeal.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “바삭함이 터지는 순간”, “오늘 저녁은 치킨으로 확정”, “앱 주문 전용”, “쿠폰코드: {쿠폰 코드}”, “행사기간: {행사 기간}”, “지금 주문하기” must render cleanly with no broken characters.
- Exact composition requirement: preserve the chicken hero + large price + small set hierarchy as a real fast-food ad layout.
- Include realistic small-print Korean copy near the bottom: “매장별 판매 여부와 가격은 다를 수 있습니다. 이미지는 연출된 예시입니다.”
- Add visible retail details: {브랜드명}, {프로모션명}, {대표 가격}, {매장·앱 정보}, QR-code placeholder, and {해시태그}.
- Typography must stay bold, legible, and commercially clean; price, coupon code, and headline must be readable at thumbnail size.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or public figure likeness
- Unreadable or deformed price, coupon, and menu text

[INPUT]
