- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Domino-style pizza advertisement poster, vertical food promo with a hero product shot, clear pricing emphasis, and family-friendly value messaging.
Retail-ready Korean ad layout for social, print, and in-store poster use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero placement: {제품·소재} occupies the center 55–60% of the frame, slightly above midline, with the pizza angled for maximum cheese and topping visibility.
- Supporting elements: side items and drink from {제품·소재} arranged in a neat lower-side cluster, scaled smaller than the hero so the price remains dominant.
- Background treatment: clean studio backdrop in {컬러 팔레트}, with subtle gradient depth, no messy props, and enough negative space for headline and pricing.
- Framing direction: strong top-to-bottom hierarchy with brand area at top, hero product in center, price block large and readable near lower third, and set details tucked into a compact footer.
- Use {브랜드 톤} and {레이아웃} to keep the layout aligned to the intended franchise-style ad structure.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top brand zone: place the brand expression from {브랜드 톤} near the upper area, with compact spacing and a clean promotional header feel.
2. Center hero zone: show {시그니처 결} in a glossy food-photography style, with melted cheese stretch, crisp crust edge, and visible toppings lit to emphasize freshness and value.
3. Side set zone: position {제품·소재} as a supporting bundle beside or below the hero, keeping each item clearly separated so the set reads instantly.
4. Price emphasis zone: place a large price block or value callout in the lower-middle area, using bold contrast and simple alignment so it is the first text after the hero.
5. Copy zone: include {카피·타이포} as stacked promotional text, with the main English wordmark and Korean subcopy balanced for quick readability.
6. Footer zone: finish with {레이아웃} structure and small informational copy, keeping margins consistent and the overall poster uncluttered.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for main Korean promo copy, Noto Sans KR Medium for supporting text, and an italic or condensed sans for price emphasis; headline size should feel oversized relative to the product.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with deep Domino-style blue, saturated red, and clean white; add small warm cheese-gold accents only where food realism needs emphasis.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow under the pizza 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; use crisp white text on blue/red blocks with minimal outline for legibility.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm full-frame product lens, f/5.6, slightly elevated 3/4 angle to keep the pizza circular, toppings readable, and set items structured.
- Lighting: studio softbox key at 45° from upper-left, gentle fill from front-right, faint rim light on crust and cheese strings to enhance gloss and separation.
- Color grade: punchy commercial food grade with vivid red-blue brand contrast, clean whites, and warm golden cheese highlights; keep blacks controlled and saturation moderate, not neon.

[6. MOOD]
Large-chain pizza campaign — polished fast-food advertising with the clean, high-contrast promotional feel of a major supermarket flyer and QSR poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "도미노피자", "신메뉴", "세트", "가격", "한글·영문 정확".
- Layout invariants: pizza hero must remain the largest visual element; the price block must be more dominant than supporting set details; typography must stay clean and commercial, with no distorted letters.
- All food items must remain recognizable and appetizing without exaggerated deformation.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Misspelled English or Korean promo text
- Overly glossy AI-smooth food surfaces
- Sexualized presentation
- Distorted food anatomy or unrealistic toppings

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean seasonal limited beverage advertisement poster in a premium cafe retail style, vertical 1024x1536 format for social media feed, store entrance standee, and counter-top promo signage.
Starbucks seasonal campaign visual with a polished commercial look, combining one hero drink, real cafe accessories, seasonal ingredients, concise Korean headline copy, price callout, campaign period, store/app purchase cue, and small retail-detail typography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {제품·소재} occupies the center-left hero zone at about 55% of the frame height, with supporting props arranged diagonally to the right and foreground for realistic depth.
- Background treatment: premium cafe studio set with a warm off-white to muted seasonal gradient, subtle paper stock or matte acrylic texture, faint counter surface seam, soft reflections, and small retail display details that feel natural for a seasonal beverage campaign.
- Framing and spacing: follow {레이아웃} and {비율}; reserve the top area for the Starbucks header and campaign headline, the center for the hero drink, and the lower area for price, event period, QR/app cue, and fine print.
- Brand expression: apply {브랜드 톤} across the overall visual language, with {시그니처 결} reflected in cup styling, sleeve texture, reusable tumbler finish, card design, printed label, and prop arrangement.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): place a Starbucks wordmark area and the main Korean campaign line from {카피·타이포}, styled as a premium commercial headline aligned upper-left or upper-center. Add a small date label such as "SEASON LIMITED · 2026 SPRING" and a short Korean subline like "지금 만나는 한정 메뉴".
2. Hero zone (middle 50%): feature {제품·소재} as the dominant focal point, rendered with glossy beverage surface, crisp cup edges, condensation droplets, whipped cream, foam, syrup drizzle, ice texture, or seasonal garnish depending on the drink concept.
3. Supporting props zone (mid-right and lower-right): add seasonal accents and product companions from {제품·소재}, such as a branded tumbler, paper sleeve, gift card, loyalty card, napkin, straw wrapper, mini tray, menu tag, ingredient pieces, ribbon, or small dessert plate. Arrange them with controlled overlap, believable contact shadows, and premium retail styling.
4. Seasonal mood layer: integrate {무드·라이팅} through warm highlights, soft shadows, rim reflections on the cup, gentle bokeh-like cafe glow in the far background, and seasonal surface color accents so the set feels like a real polished cafe campaign shoot.
5. Accent, price, and campaign info area (lower 15%): place a compact price label and promotional line near the bottom, for example "Tall ₩6,900" / "Grande ₩7,400" and "기간: 2026.05.01–05.31". Include a small app-order cue such as "사이렌 오더에서 먼저 만나보세요", a tiny QR code placeholder block, and a one-line store availability note.
6. Retail detail layer: add 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs in small badges or side labels, such as "시즌 한정", "달콤한 크림", "리유저블 컵 옵션". Add small footer credit text like "Photo styled by Starbucks Korea · Beverage image for seasonal promotion" and a tiny barcode/stock-code area to make the poster feel printed and realistic.
7. Color anchoring: use {컬러 팔레트} as the dominant palette, with deep green, cream white, and a season-specific accent color applied to the headline underline, small label tabs, garnish, props, or thin divider rules.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean copy, with bold sans weight for the main line and medium weight for supporting text; headline around 54–72px, subhead around 30–40px, price around 36–46px, fine print around 14–18px.
- Font handling: pair a clean English sans-serif for "Starbucks" with a neat Korean subtitle, maintaining tight kerning, strong hierarchy, and realistic print-ad alignment.
- Korean copy system: Set bold cover-style ad line in Korean from {카피·타이포}; add small supporting copy such as "스타벅스 시즌 한정", "오늘의 달콤한 리프레시", "앱 주문 가능", and "일부 매장 제외" where appropriate.
- Color palette: prioritize {컬러 팔레트}; use soft off-white background tones, deep Starbucks green, warm cream, and a seasonal accent such as blush pink, pumpkin orange, berry red, icy mint, or golden caramel depending on the selected season.
- Surface and shadow: use soft studio shadows under the drink and props, about 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 15% opacity. Preserve real material texture: paper sleeve fibers, plastic lid highlights, cup condensation, ice refraction, cream ridges, matte tray finish, and printed ink texture on labels.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial product photography look, 85mm lens at f/4 for the hero drink and props, crisp focus with shallow background separation.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a large softbox, subtle fill from front-right, and a faint rim highlight to define glass or cup edges.
- Color grade: warm cream + Starbucks green + seasonal accent, with controlled contrast, appetizing highlights, realistic shadows, and glossy cafe retail finish.
- Realism details: include small imperfections that make the image believable, such as tiny condensation beads, slight paper curl on a receipt or card, fine dusting of topping powder, subtle cup seam, gentle reflection on the counter, and readable micro typography where placed.

[6. MOOD]
Premium seasonal cafe campaign — polished Starbucks retail advertisement aesthetic with warm in-store realism, appetizing beverage detail, collectible seasonal props, and a refined commercial poster finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and without broken characters: "스타벅스", plus the season-specific Korean subtitle and season name used in {카피·타이포}.
- Include realistic poster text elements in Korean: a short headline, 2–3 feature blurbs, price callout such as "Tall ₩6,900", campaign period such as "2026.05.01–05.31", and footer/app cue such as "사이렌 오더에서 먼저 만나보세요".
- Layout invariants: maintain a clear hero-product-first composition, with one dominant beverage, supporting seasonal props, retail campaign details, and a compact pricing element; the image must still feel premium and product-led.
- Typography must remain legible and correctly aligned; no warped letters, no fake gibberish text, no mixed-up Korean syllables.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, certifications, or award badges
- Broken Korean characters or illegible mixed scripts
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized human likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean fast-food burger advertisement poster, vertical product hero layout for social feed, in-store menu board crop, and app promotion. Focus on a highly recognizable burger close-up with realistic pricing, promo details, store/app CTA, and fast-food brand copy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {제품명} placed as a large hero in the lower-middle 55% of the frame, angled slightly toward camera so {제품 구성} reads clearly through the bun, patty, cheese, vegetables, and sauce layers.
- Brand zone: top 15% features {브랜드 톤} with a bold fast-food ad hierarchy, a small campaign tag, and a date-style issue marker such as "2026 SPRING MENU" for realistic retail context.
- Secondary accent: {시그니처 그래픽} used as supporting visual language around the hero: yellow arch-inspired curves, red ribbon price burst, sesame-dot pattern, and small ingredient callout stickers.
- Copy block: {프로모션 문구}, {가격}, and {주문 CTA} positioned in a strong price-and-brand stack near the hero, with clear hierarchy and thumbnail-readable contrast.
- Retail info: add {행사 기간}, {매장 정보}, app-order note, pickup/delivery microcopy, and a small barcode or QR-style ordering mark in the bottom information band.
- Layout treatment: {레이아웃} with a compact promotional structure, allowing the burger to dominate while supporting it with realistic fast-food poster details, menu labels, and store-context cues.
- Background: studio backdrop in {컬러 팔레트}, with subtle paper grain, warm tabletop reflection, sauce-colored gradients, and appetizing food-photography depth.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): Place the main brand text "McDonald's / 맥도날드" in a bold fast-food ad style, centered or slightly left-aligned; include a small campaign label such as "오늘의 버거 픽" and "2026 SPRING MENU".
2. Hero product zone (mid 55%): Render the burger as a sharply lit macro food subject with visible toasted bun texture, sesame seeds, melted cheese edges, sauce sheen, crisp lettuce, onion, pickle, and browned patty texture; make it look freshly assembled and appetizing.
3. Promo copy zone (middle-right or lower-center): Add "{프로모션 문구}", "{제품명}", and "{가격}" in a compact stack using strong hierarchy; include a small badge reading "한정 특가" or "신메뉴 추천".
4. Retail detail zone (bottom 15%): Include "{행사 기간}", "{매장 정보}", "{주문 CTA}", "앱 쿠폰 적용 가능", and a small barcode/QR-style block labeled "M오더".
5. Context accent zone: Include a small illustrated storefront silhouette, tray liner texture, fries/soda icon stickers, or ingredient callout tags at a much smaller scale than the burger so the food remains the hero.
6. Background and framing: Maintain a polished commercial poster feel with energetic retail-ad graphics, red/yellow color fields, realistic paper/poster texture, and crisp product separation.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a bold sans-serif like Pretendard Black or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean, with condensed display handling for prices; sizes should feel poster-ready and highly legible from thumbnail view.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with precise high-contrast application; use saturated fast-food red and yellow as primary accents, white for copy fields, warm brown tones for burger realism, and small black text for retail details.
- Poster details: include realistic microcopy such as promotion period, store address line, order CTA, app coupon label, product option tags, and a barcode/QR-style ordering block without making them official certification marks.
- Graphic treatment: use arch-like curves, rounded price stickers, sesame-seed dot patterns, diagonal red/yellow ribbons, and small ingredient labels; shadows and highlights should feel printed-ad realistic rather than glossy UI.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the burger, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; keep edges crisp and food contours natural.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial food photography look, 100mm macro lens at f/8 for crisp ingredient detail and shallow background separation in a studio product setup.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a soft fill from front-right and a slight rim light behind the burger to emphasize gloss and texture.
- Color grade: saturated fast-food commercial grade with warm bun browns, vivid ketchup reds, clean cheese yellows, fresh lettuce greens, and bright white highlights on a neutral studio base.
- Material fidelity: toasted bun pores, sesame seeds, cheese melt, patty char marks, sauce gloss, paper wrapper folds, tray liner grain, and printed-poster ink texture must all feel tactile and appetizing.

[6. MOOD]
Classic fast-food campaign poster — high-impact McDonald’s-style commercial food photography with a cheerful retail-ad feel, energetic price promotion, and warm freshly made burger appeal.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구는 다음과 같음: "맥도날드", "{제품명}", "{가격}", "{프로모션 문구}", "{행사 기간}", "{주문 CTA}", "앱 쿠폰 적용 가능", "M오더".
- Required poster text examples: "오늘의 버거 픽", "한정 특가", "매장 픽업 · 배달 가능", "2026 SPRING MENU"를 작고 선명하게 배치.
- Composition invariants: burger hero must remain the dominant focal point; pricing and campaign copy must support the product; all Korean text must be clean, legible, and correctly spaced.
- Visual fidelity: keep the ad composition compact and commercial, with realistic burger layers, sauce, wrapper, tray liner, barcode/QR-style order detail, and fast-food poster graphics.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- AI-smooth plastic-looking food textures
- Celebrity composites or endorsement-style faces

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Coca-Cola 아이코닉 광고 포스터 스타일의 세로형 브랜드 비주얼. 차가운 음료 제품 hero, 친구들의 건배 순간, 캠페인형 행사 정보, 짧은 한글 카피를 함께 담아 소셜/매장/캠페인용으로 바로 사용할 수 있는 기억도 높은 광고 포스터를 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {제품과 장면}을 중앙 하단 45% 영역에 hero로 배치하고, {레이아웃}에 맞춰 상단에는 {메인 카피}, 중단 측면에는 친구·가족 스냅, 하단에는 캠페인 정보와 QR 안내를 결합한다.
- Background treatment: 밝은 화이트·크림 바탕에 {시그니처 결}을 보여주는 빨간 리본 그래픽, 탄산 버블, 얼음 조각 하이라이트, 종이 포스터 질감, 작은 축제형 패턴을 더해 Coca-Cola 광고 특유의 활기와 대비를 살린다.
- Framing and spacing: 상단 헤드라인, 중앙 제품, 하단 행사 정보가 한눈에 이어지도록 3단 포스터 그리드로 구성하고, 제품 라벨과 병의 실루엣이 친구들의 손동작·건배 컷과 자연스럽게 겹치게 한다.
- Use {브랜드 톤} and {시그니처 결} as the overall brand direction, with {메인 카피}, {서브 카피}, {캠페인 날짜}, {행사 장소}, {참여 안내}, {채널 핸들}, {후원 표기}, {QR 문구} placed as realistic printed poster text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (upper 20-25%): {메인 카피}를 가장 크게 배치하고, 바로 아래에 {서브 카피}를 넣는다. Coca-Cola식 빈티지 스크립트 감성과 굵은 한글 산세리프가 함께 읽히도록 레드 배너, 화이트 레터링, 얇은 골드 하이라이트를 조합한다.
2. Hero product zone (middle 40-55%): {제품과 장면}을 가장 밝고 선명한 초점으로 두고, 병/캔 라벨, 차가운 결로, 탄산 거품, 얼음이 담긴 잔, 병뚜껑 금속 반사, 유리 표면의 물방울을 고해상도로 강조한다. 제품 아래에는 부드러운 섀도와 붉은 반사광을 넣어 인쇄 광고처럼 안정적인 깊이를 만든다.
3. Social energy zone (mid-left or mid-right 25-35%): 친구·가족이 웃으며 건배하는 순간, 피크닉 테이블 위의 종이컵, 빨간 냅킨, 작은 스피커, 손글씨 메모 카드 같은 자연스러운 소품을 {시그니처 결}의 분위기로 배치한다. 인물은 제품보다 작게 두되 표정과 손동작에서 즐거움이 느껴지게 한다.
4. Poster information zone (lower 15-20%): {캠페인 날짜}, {행사 장소}, {참여 안내}를 실제 행사 포스터처럼 정렬하고, 우측 하단에 QR 박스와 {QR 문구}, 좌측 하단에 {채널 핸들}, 중앙 하단에 {후원 표기}를 작은 글씨로 넣는다. 티켓형 라벨, 점선 쿠폰 박스, 작은 바코드 느낌의 장식선을 더한다.
5. Brand accent details: Coca-Cola 빨강 포인트는 배경 리본, 병 라벨, 캡, 헤드라인 배너, 쿠폰형 하단 정보 박스에 반복해서 사용하고, 화이트와 골드 하이라이트로 프리미엄한 광고 지면 느낌을 강화한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Coca-Cola식 빈티지 스크립트와 굵은 산세리프를 혼합하되, Pretendard SemiBold, Noto Sans KR Bold, 또는 커스텀 스크립트 느낌으로 처리한다. 메인 헤드라인은 64-92px급, 서브 카피는 24-34px급, 하단 행사 정보는 15-22px급으로 위계를 분명히 만든다.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}의 Coca-Cola 빨강, 화이트, 골드, 차콜을 핵심으로 사용하고, 레드는 #E41E26 또는 유사한 선명한 코카콜라 레드 톤으로 유지한다. 탄산 하이라이트에는 아주 옅은 시안·실버 반사를 소량 넣는다.
- Border/shadow: 제품과 인물 주변에 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity의 부드러운 섀도를 넣고, 필요 시 얇은 화이트 아웃라인이나 라이트 글로우로 광고 지면 느낌을 살린다. 하단 정보 박스에는 얇은 점선, 라운드 코너, 티켓 스텁 형태의 절취선 장식을 적용한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 광고 포트레이트 렌즈 느낌과 50mm product hero 프레이밍을 혼합한 고해상도 스튜디오 광고 컷 스타일.
- Lighting: {무드·라이팅}. 상단 좌측 45° 방향의 자연광을 기본으로 하고, 반대편에는 소프트 fill light를 넣어 병의 곡면과 사람 얼굴의 윤곽을 선명하게 살린다. 골드 하이라이트는 컵/병 표면의 반사와 하단 티켓 장식에 얇게 적용한다.
- Color grade: 선명한 Coca-Cola red 중심의 warm editorial grade, 화이트는 밝고 산뜻하게, 차콜은 깊게 눌러 대비를 강하게 만든다. 인쇄 포스터처럼 미세한 halftone grain과 종이 섬유 질감을 추가한다.

[6. MOOD]
Classic Coca-Cola global campaign aesthetic — joyful holiday commercial poster feel with premium brand polish, lively Korean summer event energy, friendly street-campaign realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — "행복", "시원한 한 모금, 함께라서 더 맛있다", "2026.06.15 SAT", "서울숲 피크닉 광장", "오후 2시 - 8시", "무료 시음 & 포토존", "@cocacola_kr", "QR로 참여하기".
- Composition invariants: 제품 hero는 가장 먼저 보이도록 중앙 하단에 유지하고, 친구·가족 요소는 보조적 에너지로 사용하며, 하단에는 날짜·장소·참여 안내·QR 박스가 실제 캠페인 포스터처럼 읽히게 한다.
- Text handling: 한글과 영문은 모두 깨짐 없이 또렷하게 렌더링하고, 광고 카피는 짧고 명확하게 유지한다. Coca-Cola 로고와 라벨은 병/캔의 중심에서 선명하게 보이게 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized famous-person likeness mashups

[1. PURPOSE]
Outdoor sports advertisement poster in a North Face-inspired brand tone, designed like a premium mountain gear campaign with strong hero-product hierarchy, believable alpine field details, and editorial outdoor energy.
Vertical poster for social-feed ad placement, combining model, mountain landscape, product callouts, compact campaign information, and realistic poster typography so it feels like a finished outdoor apparel launch advertisement.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {브랜드 톤} as the overall brand mood, with the hero model and mountain scene occupying the central 60% of the frame, and {제품·소재} placed as a secondary supporting cluster in the lower-right 18%.
- Background treatment: dramatic alpine landscape with layered ridgelines, cold atmosphere, evergreen forest texture, rocky trail surfaces, wind-blown snow dust, distant hikers as tiny scale cues, and realistic outdoor depth.
- Spacing and framing: tall vertical framing with strong upward perspective; use the upper area for the main campaign title and date label, and one side for short feature blurbs, route markers, and technical gear notes.
- Visual hierarchy should prioritize {시그니처 결} first, then {제품·소재}, then {카피·타이포}, with {레이아웃} structure preserved.
- Keep {비율} feeling intentional: model, mountain, gear cluster, and text blocks should scale like a real printed campaign poster, not a flat mockup.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background plane: create a mountain-and-nature backdrop with dark slate shadows, evergreen accents, crisp high-altitude air, visible rock, snow patches, trail signs, rope line details, and atmospheric mist between ridgelines.
2. Hero zone (center 60%): place a dynamic outdoor model stance that feels wind-tested and expedition-ready, with realistic jacket folds, backpack straps, trekking gloves, trail pants, boots, and wind interaction; the model must be integrated into the mountain scene rather than floating separately.
3. Product area: show {제품·소재} as small but legible hero-support items, styled like premium technical gear detail shots, with realistic material texture, zipper pulls, seam taping, buckles, ripstop weave, outsole tread, and tiny Korean material labels.
4. Copy zone: place {카피·타이포} in a clear advertising hierarchy, with a bold English master line, a smaller Korean subtitle, and a compact model-name line beneath.
5. Campaign information layer: add realistic poster details such as "2026 F/W ALPINE FIELD TEST", "VOL.247", "2026.05.18 MON", "AM 06:30", "북한산 트레일 센터", "참가 신청 QR", "참가비 ₩7,500", and "SUPPORTED BY SEOUL TRAIL CLUB" in small readable blocks.
6. Feature blurbs: add 2-3 short Korean headline blurbs along the side or lower band, for example "비바람을 막는 쉘", "가볍게 더 멀리", "새벽 능선 테스트".
7. Utility graphics: include a small barcode/QR area, route-map line art, elevation number "ELEV. 1,842M", tiny coordinate text, sponsor strip, and subtle red locator dots that support the outdoor campaign story.
8. Layout balance: use {레이아웃} logic so the mountain hero remains dominant while product and information blocks stay secondary, functional, and print-ad realistic.
9. Brand consistency: maintain {브랜드 톤} throughout the full composition so the result feels like a real outdoor campaign page, not an abstract poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use condensed sans-serif advertising typography inspired by Helvetica Neue Condensed and Pretendard Bold; English title in bold uppercase, Korean subtitle in Pretendard Medium, small model line in Noto Sans KR Regular, title size roughly 88-110 px equivalent.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with deep charcoal #111318, mountain red #D22630, forest green #2E5D44, snow white #F5F7F2, and cold gray-blue highlights.
- Poster finish: subtle premium poster shadow with soft 6px vertical offset, 18px blur, 14% opacity; include realistic print grain, slight paper tooth, fine ink density variation, and restrained shadowing around layered text panels.
- Text system: combine large English brand/campaign lines with precise Korean microcopy; keep numbers, prices, date labels, location labels, and gear specifications aligned to a disciplined grid.
- Decorative elements: use alpine route-map lines, small weather icons, altitude marks, red technical callout arrows, tiny product SKU text, and field-note labels that match the campaign tone.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: cinematic outdoor campaign look shot on a Sony A7R V with 24-70mm f/2.8 at 35mm, f/5.6, preserving environment scale and product clarity.
- Lighting: {무드·라이팅}; overcast diffused mountain daylight with a slight directional rim from upper-left, plus restrained fill on the model face and gear edges for separation.
- Color grade: cool alpine grade with deep blacks, muted greens, sharp white highlights, and controlled red accents; keep contrast crisp and natural like a premium outdoor editorial print.
- Realism details: snow crystals on boots, damp fabric edges, subtle condensation in cold air, textured rock, needle-covered trail ground, realistic stitching, matte technical nylon, and believable contact shadows under the model and gear.

[6. MOOD]
Premium outdoor gear campaign — National Geographic adventure editorial meets a high-end technical apparel brand launch, with the realism of an actual mountain field test poster and the polish of a major outdoor brand advertisement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "한글 부제", "모델명".
- Additional Korean strings should be clean and legible: "비바람을 막는 쉘", "가볍게 더 멀리", "새벽 능선 테스트", "북한산 트레일 센터", "참가 신청 QR", "참가비 ₩7,500".
- English text accuracy: "The North Face" must be clean, correctly spelled, and legible.
- Composition invariant: hero model + mountain landscape + small product/info cluster + campaign detail typography must all be present in one vertical advertising layout.
- No anatomical distortion on the model; hands, limbs, face, boots, backpack straps, gloves, and gear attachments must look physically plausible and naturally connected.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity likeness or celebrity composite
- Distorted anatomy, floating gear, or physically impossible straps

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean curated fashion advertisement poster for 29CM-inspired editorial commerce, vertical magazine-cover-like composition.
Lifestyle product ad with a human model, styled home objects, issue/date details, product micro information, and premium e-commerce campaign feel.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {레이아웃} 느낌으로, 인물은 화면 중앙 55% 영역에 자연스러운 포즈로 배치하고 {상품명}은 착장 디테일, 손에 든 제품, 의자 옆 쇼핑백, 테이블 위 정물과 함께 읽히게 구성한다.
- Background treatment: 따뜻한 베이지 계열의 스튜디오 또는 햇살 드는 아파트 거실 배경에 미세한 종이/패브릭 텍스처, 나무 테이블, 패브릭 소파, 세라믹 컵, 접힌 니트, 잡지 더미 같은 실제 라이프스타일 디테일을 넣는다.
- Framing: 세로형 광고 포스터처럼 상단 헤드라인 15%, 중앙 모델·제품 60%, 하단 제품 정보·기획전 카피 25% 비율로 정리하되, 좌측에는 얇은 매거진 스파인 크레딧, 우하단에는 작은 바코드와 날짜 정보를 배치한다.
- Use {브랜드명}, {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {모델 스타일}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {캠페인 헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {기획전명}, {에디션번호}, {발행일}, {가격표기}, {장소라벨} as the customizable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): {브랜드명} 로고형 텍스트를 상단 좌측에 정확히 배치하고, 바로 아래에 {캠페인 헤드라인}을 큰 한글 헤드라인으로 넣는다. 우측 상단에는 {에디션번호}, {발행일}, “CURATED STYLE ISSUE”를 작은 매거진 정보처럼 배치한다.
2. Hero zone (middle 60%): {모델 스타일}의 모델을 메인으로 두고, {제품·소재}가 모델의 착장과 생활 장면 속에서 자연스럽게 보이게 연출한다. 코트의 질감, 니트 조직, 가죽 가방의 결, 머그컵의 유약, 테이블의 나뭇결처럼 촉각적인 소재 디테일을 살린다.
3. Editorial commerce details: 하단에는 {기획전명}, {상품명}, {가격표기}, “오늘의 큐레이션”, “무료 반품 안내”, “앱에서 더 보기” 같은 작은 커머스 정보 라벨을 카드형으로 넣고, 실제 광고처럼 바코드와 상품 코드 “STYLE-0526-A”를 함께 배치한다.
4. Feature headline accents: 좌우 여백에는 2–3개의 짧은 한국어 피처 헤드라인을 넣는다 — “봄을 닮은 데일리 룩”, “집 안에서도 단정한 실루엣”, “오래 입는 소재의 기준”. 얇은 구분선, 작은 페이지 넘버 “p. 024”, 원형 앰버 스티커 “EDITOR’S PICK”을 더한다.
5. Color balance: {컬러 팔레트}를 중심으로 베이지·차콜 기반의 안정적인 대비를 만들고, 따뜻한 amber 액센트는 스티커, 가격 라벨, 작은 그래픽 포인트에 반복해 통일감을 준다.
6. Copy integration: {브랜드 톤}에 맞는 {서브카피}를 헤드라인 아래 또는 우하단에 작게 배치하고, 좌측 세로 스파인에는 “{브랜드명} CURATION / {발행일} / {시그니처 결}” 크레딧을 넣어 매거진 커버 같은 완성도를 높인다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean body text, bold 700-800 for headline, 28-44px equivalent; English subcopy in clean sans-serif at 14-18px equivalent. Letter spacing slightly wide for a 29CM editorial feel.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 기반으로 #E8DCCB beige, #3A3531 charcoal, #D8A15D warm amber, soft ivory, muted brown, and one focused accent color for sticker or price label.
- Graphic system: Use thin editorial rules, small page numbers, barcode block, product-code micro type, rounded commerce labels, and one translucent amber sticker so the ad feels like a real curated fashion campaign.
- Texture/detail: Keep fabric weave, paper grain, ceramic surface, leather texture, hair strands, natural skin texture, and gentle environmental shadows visible for realistic editorial depth.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm portrait lens at f/2.0 for the model, with product details kept crisp and natural; composition should feel like a premium fashion catalog cover.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, balanced shadow softness, with warm amber bounce to match the curated lifestyle mood.
- Color grade: warm beige + amber highlights + muted charcoal contrast, slightly matte editorial finish, low saturation, clean skin tones, natural fabric color, and subtle film-like grain.

[6. MOOD]
29CM editorial commerce campaign — refined Korean fashion magazine spread with curated lifestyle styling, real home textures, warm afternoon light, and a premium e-commerce aesthetic.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함 — “29CM”, “{캠페인 헤드라인}”, “{기획전명}”, “{상품명}”, “{가격표기}”.
- Rendered magazine details must include: “{에디션번호}”, “{발행일}”, “EDITOR’S PICK”, “오늘의 큐레이션”, “앱에서 더 보기”, “봄을 닮은 데일리 룩”, “집 안에서도 단정한 실루엣”.
- Layout invariant: 모델과 제품이 하나의 스타일링 장면처럼 연결되어 보이게 하고, 헤드라인은 광고 포스터처럼 크게 읽혀야 한다.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean street fashion advertisement poster, editorial product campaign for a youth apparel brand. Vertical mobile-first layout with full-body model, Seoul city backdrop, realistic campaign information, and retail drop details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a full-body model occupies 55–60% of the frame, placed slightly off-center for a confident fashion-editorial stance, with {브랜드 톤} guiding the overall brand personality.
- Styling: show {모델스타일링} with layered streetwear proportions, visible garment texture, stitching, zippers, pockets, sneaker details, and natural fabric folds so {제품·소재} reads as the featured fashion focus.
- Background: urban Seoul street setting with realistic concrete, metal railings, glass storefront reflections, asphalt, crosswalk markings, delivery stickers, small shop signs, bus-stop panels, and distant pedestrians softened by depth of field.
- Framing: strong vertical composition with a bold upper headline stack, full-body silhouette through the center, and a lower retail-information block that feels like a real seasonal campaign poster.
- Keep {시그니처 결} visible in silhouette, pose, styling language, typography rhythm, and the mix of Korean street culture with contemporary retail polish.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero zone (center 55%): model in a confident street-fashion pose, sharply separated from the city background, with realistic clothing folds, crisp edge detail, natural hands, and grounded shoes touching the street surface.
- Background zone: layered urban backdrop with perspective depth; include believable Seoul street textures, window reflections, faint transit signage, pavement scuffs, and small environmental details that support the fashion narrative.
- Typography zone (upper 20%): place {메인카피} as the primary headline, with {서브카피}, {시즌명}, and {캠페인명} arranged as a premium editorial campaign stack.
- Product and drop zone (lower 18%): include a retail-style label card for {제품·소재}, {가격·드롭정보}, {날짜}, {장소}, {웹주소}, and {채널핸들}; add a small barcode or QR-like graphic block that looks like campaign metadata, not an official certification.
- Graphic accent zone: integrate {그래픽요소} such as a small sticker label, vertical side caption, thin divider lines, size-chip icons, and a streetwear hangtag motif to make the poster feel printed and realistic.
- Layout balance: {레이아웃} should feel like a premium Korean streetwear campaign with clear hierarchy between headline, model, city atmosphere, and product cue.
- Size treatment: maintain {비율} as the exact vertical format, optimized for social feed, store window poster, and mobile campaign display.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean headline text, bold 700–900 weight, with tight but readable tracking; pair with clean uppercase English set in a modern sans-serif style.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} anchored by charcoal #1E1E1E, white #F5F5F2, asphalt gray, cool glass blue, and a controlled accent color that supports street-fashion contrast.
- Text hierarchy: headline should be largest, campaign subtitle second, drop/date/location details smaller but legible, and metadata labels in compact caption style.
- Poster finishing: subtle soft drop shadow under text blocks, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; add tactile print-poster cues such as slight paper grain, gentle ink density variation, and realistic sticker-tag layering.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 fashion portrait look for the model, with enough compression to keep the silhouette sleek and editorial.
- Lighting: natural daylight with urban bounce, slightly directional from upper-left, plus gentle fill from the right to preserve face and garment detail.
- Color grade: cool urban neutrals with charcoal, white, and restrained accent tones; mild contrast, crisp blacks, clean highlights, and a modern retail-campaign finish.
- Detail rendering: realistic skin texture, believable hair strands, garment weave, sneaker rubber, metal zipper shine, glass reflections, asphalt grain, and subtle motion in distant street life.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean streetwear campaign — MUSINSA editorial energy with a clean Seoul city look, similar to a high-end fashion magazine ad spread, but with practical retail drop information and believable street-culture details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "무신사", "MUSINSA", "컬렉션", "서울 스트리트", "2026 S/S", "5월 18일 발매", "한정 드롭", "@musinsa.style"
- Required campaign copy: 메인 헤드라인은 "무신사"와 "MUSINSA"가 함께 보이고, 하단 정보 영역에는 "컬렉션", "서울 스트리트", "2026 S/S", "5월 18일 발매", "한정 드롭"이 읽혀야 함.
- Composition invariant: full-body model, city background, headline stack, lower product/drop label, barcode or QR-like metadata block, and small streetwear graphic accents must all appear in one vertical poster; do not crop the model into a half-body close-up.
- Preserve the intended ad style: modern Korean street-fashion retail campaign, not luxury jewelry, beauty, outdoor sportswear, or formal suit advertising.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul typography
- Fake official seals, government marks, certification badges, or misleading award emblems
- Celebrity likeness composites or implying a real celebrity endorsement
- Distorted hands, unnatural body deformation, or plastic-looking fabric

[1. PURPOSE]

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area: feature {모델 구성} as the dominant visual anchor, styled in {제품·소재} with fashion-forward layering, realistic skin texture, crisp seams, denim weave, knit ribbing, cotton wrinkles, metallic zipper highlights, and natural pose tension.
2. Campaign message zone: render the brand voice as {브랜드 톤}, with a large H&M-style red wordmark treatment, the headline {캠페인 카피}, the Korean subline {한글 부제}, and the collection name {컬렉션명} stacked like a high-street fashion launch poster.
3. Seasonal identity layer: emphasize {시즌명} and {시그니처 결} through accessory accents, sticker-like graphic bursts, red sale tabs, paper hangtag shapes, and outfit coordination so the season theme is visible at first glance.
4. Commerce details: include {가격 정보} as small but readable product pricing, plus item callouts such as “오버핏 셔츠”, “와이드 데님”, “크롭 재킷”, and “스니커즈” connected by thin editorial leader lines.
5. Campaign information block: add a realistic retail info strip with {행사 기간}, {매장 정보}, {온라인 정보}, {SNS 핸들}, and {QR 안내}, formatted like an actual in-store/social ad footer.
6. Color system: build the image around {컬러 팔레트}, with white as the visual base, red as the signature punch, and one vivid seasonal accent used in panels, stickers, hangtags, and small typographic highlights.
7. Typography zone: render {카피·타이포} as a bold headline stack with a clean sans-serif treatment; combine large Latin logo text, Korean campaign copy, collection name, product prices, date line, and microcopy in a polished retail hierarchy.
8. Layout structure: arrange {레이아웃} with editorial hierarchy—hero first, campaign headline second, pricing and shopping details third—using layered graphic elements, realistic signage, and magazine-ad polish.
9. Format control: maintain the vertical poster ratio of {비율}, with balanced upper, middle, and lower thirds suitable for 1024x1536 social advertising and store display crops.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a clean modern sans-serif such as Pretendard or Helvetica Neue for the main headline, bold weight around 700–800, with smaller supporting text at 300–500 weight and tight but readable line spacing.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} should read as bright white, signature red, and one seasonal accent in a vivid controlled tone; keep blacks deep and neutral for contrast.
- Graphic system: combine red rectangular price tabs, rounded sticker accents, thin product leader lines, barcode-like micro details, small social icons, and a QR-style shopping square as decorative retail information elements.
- Border/shadow: use subtle editorial drop shadows, 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, 12–18% opacity, to separate typography, price tags, and sticker graphics from clothing textures.
- Texture realism: show cotton, denim, nylon, leather, brushed metal, acrylic signage, glossy paper tags, and printed poster ink with believable highlights and shadows.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: fashion editorial studio photography, 85mm portrait lens at f/4 for a clean commercial look, or 50mm at f/5.6 if a fuller group composition is needed.
- Lighting: natural daylight feel mixed with controlled studio fill, key light from upper-left at 45°, soft bounce fill from front-right, and a gentle rim light to define silhouettes.
- Color grade: crisp white base with saturated red accents and slightly lifted highlights, maintaining a polished high-street campaign finish.
- Production feel: glossy retail campaign photography blended with realistic poster typography, in-store promo signage, and social commerce detail blocks.

[6. MOOD]
High-street fashion campaign energy — glossy editorial spread meets modern MZ streetwear advertising, with a lively retail launch atmosphere, confident styling, vivid seasonal color, and commerce-ready clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: “봄 데님 위크”, “지금 입는 스트리트”, “CITY POP 컬렉션”, “셔츠 ₩29,900 / 데님 ₩49,900”.
- 필수 정보 표기: “2026.05.01–05.14”, “명동 플래그십 · 온라인 동시 진행”, “@hm_korea”, “QR로 룩북 보기”를 실제 광고 문구처럼 선명하게 배치.
- Typography must remain clean and fully readable; no broken Korean characters, no warped Latin letters, no low-resolution text rendering.
- Keep model anatomy realistic and fashion-pose natural; if multiple models are used, preserve coherent styling across the group.
- The overall composition, color palette, lighting style, typography, retail detail blocks, and mood must stay aligned with the H&M-style commercial fashion look described here.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Counterfeit award badges or government-style marks

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Background treatment: editorial studio set with warm plaster wall, seamless paper sweep, polished concrete floor, soft floor reflection, garment-rack shadow, and one or two understated styling props such as folded fabric, shoe box, hanger, or acrylic block.

- Realistic retail context: include a discreet showroom/date/ticket-information area, price range cue, web/social handle, and campaign code so the image feels like an actual printed fashion advertisement.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (mid 60%): model in a sharply styled lookbook pose, full body visible, centered slightly off-axis for movement, with crisp garment edges, accurate folds, seams, stitching, buttons, hems, and realistic fabric drape.
- Brand and campaign header: large English wordmark "ZARA" at the top or upper side, paired with {메인 카피}, {한글 부제}, and {시즌명}; maintain luxury editorial hierarchy with strong typographic contrast.
- Product label block: small retail caption near lower corner or side rail containing {제품·소재}, {가격대}, item code, color note, and care-tag style micro text.
- Event / drop information strip: add realistic poster details such as {캠페인 날짜}, {드롭 정보}, {쇼룸 위치}, {티켓 정보}, {웹주소}, {소셜핸들}, and {룩북 번호}; include a compact barcode or QR-like graphic as a visual cue.
- Decorative graphics: use subtle crop marks, thin rule lines, fabric swatch chips, measurement ticks, lookbook page marker, and a small sponsor/partner area using {스폰서 라인}.
- Layout control: arrange the scene according to {레이아웃}, keeping the poster balanced, fashion-forward, and ad-ready with a strong vertical read.
- Fashion focus: emphasize the garment finish and material clarity from {제품·소재}, with accurate folds, seams, texture visibility, and layered styling under controlled lighting.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Helvetica Neue or Pretendard for the main brand line, bold 700–800 weight, large headline scale; use Noto Sans KR or Pretendard Medium for Korean subcopy; keep tight leading and generous letter spacing for the English wordmark.

- Poster finishing: allow fine editorial hairline rules, crop marks, barcode marks, price-tag micro labels, and a soft studio drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity under the model and product blocks.
- Printed realism: add slight paper grain, ink density variation, realistic kerning, tactile fabric texture, and subtle shadow interaction between the model, props, typography panels, and floor.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial fashion photography look, shot on a Phase One IQ4 or Hasselblad H6D with an 80mm–110mm portrait lens at f/5.6 for crisp garment detail and natural body proportions.
- Lighting: studio key light mixed with directional natural daylight, soft window light from upper-left at 45° plus a subtle fill from front-right, with dramatic shadow shaping and clean specular control.

- Layout invariants: maintain the dynamic full-body model composition, editorial studio set, small product label, campaign information strip, barcode/QR-style retail detail, and premium vertical advertisement hierarchy.
- Facial/body integrity: realistic fashion-model anatomy, proportional limbs, natural hands, no distortion or extra fingers.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 60%): place the model in a full-body pose with the outfit clearly visible from head to shoes, maintaining a strong natural silhouette and premium catalog feel; keep the body proportions natural and the clothing drape realistic.
2. Product emphasis: show {제품·소재} as the key apparel focus, with fabric texture, seams, hems, collar shape, pockets, stitching, and fit rendered clearly, so the basic styling reads instantly as wearable everyday fashion.
3. Campaign header: add a top-left red brand block or wordmark area with “유니클로”, a small seasonal label such as “2026 SPRING BASICS”, and a date label such as “2026.05.01 출시”.
4. Feature copy: include 2–3 short Korean retail blurbs around the hero, for example “가볍고 산뜻한 착용감”, “매일 입는 베이직”, “컬러 6종 전개”; keep them concise and aligned to the poster grid.
5. Layout block: reserve a boxed product info area near the lower-right, aligned to the grid, with thin divider rules, compact spacing, color swatches, barcode-like block, and price details to support the lookbook-ad structure of {레이아웃}.
6. Copy treatment: set {카피·타이포} in a polished commercial hierarchy; keep the main wordmark bold and legible, while the supporting Korean line, product name, style number, size note, and price are smaller and neatly aligned.
7. Brand tone integration: translate {브랜드 톤} into a modern retail identity, using practical everyday styling, simple geometry, authentic store-campaign details, and a clear mass-market fashion message.
8. Color and contrast: use {컬러 팔레트} with bright white dominant space, brand red used as a confident accent, and neutral clothing tones preserved for a clean mass-market editorial impression.
9. Format finishing: maintain the vertical poster proportion of {비율}, with readable print-safe text placement and no typography collisions that would weaken legibility.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean copy, bold 700–800 for the main title, 400–500 for supporting text, and compact sans-serif spacing for price labels; keep English wordmark sharp and modern.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} interpreted as UNIQLO-like red #E60012, pure white #FFFFFF, warm light gray #E9E9E9, black #111111, and muted beige/denim/charcoal garment tones.
- Retail graphic system: use thin 1px divider rules in light gray, small red category tabs, realistic color chips, tiny laundry-care pictograms, item-code microtext, and a compact barcode/QR-style rectangle in the product box.
- Box/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12–15% opacity for the info box, with precise edges and a printed-ad finish.
- Realistic detail: garment labels, shoe texture, subtle fabric weave, natural skin texture, hair detail, floor contact shadows, and slight paper/poster grain should be visible without overpowering the commercial layout.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/2.8 fashion portrait setup for the hero, with a neutral commercial perspective and low distortion suitable for a catalog-style lookbook.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, gentle fill from front-right, white seamless background or bright retail fitting-zone environment, and subtle floor bounce to keep the garments evenly readable.
- Color grade: crisp retail white balance with controlled red accents, slightly cool-neutral whites, natural skin tones, and clean garment color separation.
- Texture rendering: show realistic cotton, denim, knit, nylon, or blended textile surfaces according to {제품·소재}; preserve believable wrinkles, folds, seams, and layering.

[6. MOOD]
Japanese fast-fashion campaign aesthetic — polished Uniqlo seasonal catalog energy with everyday practicality, approachable confidence, bright retail freshness, and editorial realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following rendered text must appear exactly and without broken characters: “유니클로”, “신상 출시”, “가격”.
- Additional Korean retail text should appear clearly where appropriate: “2026 봄 베이직 컬렉션”, “매일 입는 편안함”, “가볍고 산뜻한 착용감”, “컬러 6종”, “모델 착용 M”, “온라인/전 매장”, “서울 명동점 촬영”.
- Product box text should include a realistic item line such as “AIRism 코튼 오버사이즈 티셔츠”, “STYLE NO. 465759”, and a price such as “₩19,900”.
- Layout invariant: the hero must remain full-body and dominant, with the product-price box clearly separated and legible.
- Typography invariant: the wordmark and Korean copy must be crisp, commercially styled, and aligned to the grid without distortion.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Sexualized styling or revealing emphasis
- Body deformation, extra limbs, or incorrect anatomy

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero product zone: Place {제품 라인} as the dominant subject, presented with crisp edges, premium contrast, accurate perspective, subtle dust-free glass/metal highlights, and a realistic shadow that anchors it to the studio surface.
2) Signature detail layer: Add a tight macro or close-up detail pass showing material finish, button geometry, lens surface, acoustic texture, OLED glow, or controller grip pattern depending on {제품 라인}, with cinematic emphasis on precision.
3) Header and campaign block: Set {메인 카피} in the strongest typographic hierarchy, with {한글 부제} as the emotional Korean subtitle and {캠페인명} as a compact launch-series label.

6) Mood reinforcement layer: Apply {무드 라이팅} across the full image using controlled highlights, deep blacks, polished specular accents, thin blue rim light, and a warm orange glint on key edges.
7) Color balance pass: Use {컬러 팔레트} so the composition feels like a premium Sony campaign, with dark body tones, white type contrast, and blue/orange accent energy.
8) Layout finishing: Structure the page as {레이아웃} with the hero product, detail macro, headline, feature chips, campaign footer, and QR/ticket-style info clearly connected as one premium poster system.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean copy, with a clean sans-serif English wordmark feel; headline around 56–76px, Korean subtitle 26–34px, feature chips 18–24px, footer information 15–18px, tracking slightly tightened for premium ad density.
- Color palette: Use deep charcoal #111111, near-black #0A0A0A, clean white #F5F5F5, Sony-like electric blue #1E5BFF, and warm orange accent #FF8A3D from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Graphic accents: Add thin technical divider lines, translucent blue/orange gradient bars, small spec chips, a QR-style square, and subtle micro-labels that support the electronics campaign identity.
- Border/shadow: Use a subtle soft drop shadow with 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 18% opacity for product grounding; allow faint reflection and rim glow where it enhances premium product realism.
- Product surface: Preserve realistic glass, plastic, rubber, metal, and coating differences; avoid overly smooth AI-like material and keep all buttons, ports, lenses, earcups, bezels, and seams physically plausible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: High-end product photography look, shot like a Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm–110mm macro lens at f/5.6 for product detail, or an 85mm f/1.4 equivalent for the hero hero section.
- Lighting: Studio setup with a key softbox at 45° from upper-left, a narrow rim light from the right, and a controlled top fill to reveal surface detail without flattening contrast.
- Color grade: Cool noir base with electric blue highlights and restrained warm orange accenting, keeping blacks rich, whites clean, and reflections sharp.
- Rendering finish: Premium commercial retouching, realistic contact shadows, glossy edge highlights, fine texture visibility, accurate product scale, and crisp print-ready typography for a 1024x1536 vertical poster.

[6. MOOD]
Premium electronics campaign — sleek Sony global ad energy with high-contrast studio polish, dramatic launch-poster presence, precise product-performance storytelling, and a refined futuristic retail atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 렌더링 문구: “SONY”, “눈앞의 순간을 작품으로”, “Alpha Series Launch”, “2026.05.18 공개”, “선명함의 기준을 다시 쓰다”, “4K 120p · AF TRACKING · HI-RES AUDIO”, “sony.co.kr/campaign”, “체험 예약 QR”, “제품 hero + 디테일 매크로 + 헤드라인”, “1024x1536”, “한글·영문 정확”.
- Include realistic poster information: release/date label, product spec chips, campaign subtitle, website/contact line, QR-style reservation block, and 2–3 Korean feature headlines.
- Product proportions must remain premium and realistic, with no warped surfaces, no distorted controls, no incorrect reflections, and no impossible lens/earcup/screen/controller geometry.
- Typography must stay crisp, evenly kerned, and fully legible in both Korean and English; feature chips and footer details must look intentionally designed, not randomly scattered.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or misspelled rendered text
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or unintended people in frame
- Counterfeit warranty marks or official-looking approval badges

1. Header zone (top 18%): place {카피·타이포} with strong hierarchy; use a clean luxury-tech wordmark feel, precise alignment, and a premium headline lockup. Include a small campaign tag in Korean: “테크 럭셔리 홈 케어”.

[7. CRITICAL]

- Broken Korean characters

1. Hero zone (center 50–60%): place {제품·소재} as the dominant visual anchor, rendered with crisp edges, realistic materials, glossy or matte surface response as appropriate, accurate reflections, subtle fingerprints or light-catching bevels, and a studio-grade polish inside the home setting.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: shot like a premium commercial interior scene using a 35mm full-frame lens at f/5.6 for balanced room depth and product clarity.
- Lighting: soft natural window light from the left at roughly 45°, with warm amber fill from the opposite side and mild ambient bounce to keep skin tones, textiles, wood, glass, and product surfaces realistic.
- Color grade: warm white interior base with LG red accents, amber highlights, soft charcoal contrast, natural skin tones, tactile fabric texture, realistic floor reflections, and clean commercial-grade saturation control.

[6. MOOD]
Premium home-appliance campaign visual with a contemporary Korean lifestyle-ad feel, similar to a high-end brand spread seen in Elle Decor or Kinfolk-style domestic storytelling, but enriched with real retail poster information, practical family-life details, and a believable showroom-quality home atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the rendered image must preserve every Korean string exactly as intended in the final copy area, with no broken characters or spacing errors.
- Verbatim text requirements: English “LG” must appear cleanly and sharply; Korean subcopy must remain natural, legible, and correctly rendered.
- Required visible poster text: include “LG”, “우리 집의 리듬을 더 편안하게”, “2026 SPRING HOME”, “VOL.247”, “모델명: LG Objet Collection HOME-247”, “공간에 맞춘 케어”, “조용한 저소음 설계”, “하루를 편안하게”, and “상담 1544-0000”.
- Composition invariant: the product remains the main hero, the family stays secondary, and the living-room setting must clearly communicate home + lifestyle + appliance advertising.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Samsung Galaxy dynamic-tech advertising poster, vertical product campaign key visual for premium mobile/tech branding.
Designed for a high-impact launch ad with a product hero, bold headline, event information, preorder CTA, and realistic retail campaign details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero product placement: {제품 라인업} occupies the central 55–65% of the frame in a dynamic diagonal pose, with a strong upward motion cue, visible polished glass/metal texture, camera lens detail, hinge seam or wearable sensor detail where relevant.
- Background treatment: deep Samsung blue-to-white studio gradient with layered light streaks, holographic interface fragments, fine grid glow, floating spec chips, and energetic tech reflections around the device.
- Spacing and framing: top area carries {메인 헤드라인}; mid area presents the product hero and accent graphics; lower area contains {한글 부제}, {대표 모델명}, launch date, preorder benefit, website, and a small QR-style code block.
- Visual direction must follow {브랜드 톤} and {시그니처 결}, with the overall composition feeling like a flagship launch poster seen in a subway station, electronics store, or outdoor digital signage campaign.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone (15–20%): set {메인 헤드라인} in large bold type, slightly off-center with energetic alignment; add a small campaign kicker such as “Galaxy Launch 2026” or “New Era of Mobile AI”.
2) Hero zone (mid 50–60%): present {제품 라인업} as the dominant subject, rendered with polished reflections, sharp edge separation, subtle fingerprints on glass, metallic highlights, and realistic screen glow.
3) Motion accent zone: add controlled dynamic streaks, curved light trails, pixel-spark particles, thin neon blue arcs, and tiny spec labels such as “AI Camera”, “Pro Performance”, “Seamless Sync” without covering the device silhouette.
4) Supporting info zone (bottom 15–20%): place {한글 부제}, {대표 모델명}, {출시 일정}, {행사 장소}, {예약 혜택}, {가격 정보}, and {웹사이트} in a precise ad-grid hierarchy with compact icons for calendar, location, gift, and web.
5) Campaign detail strip: include a realistic bottom strip with QR-style code, preorder CTA button, tiny legal-style note line, and partner/sponsor area reading “Galaxy Experience Zone · 온라인 생중계 · 매장 체험 가능”.
6) Layout rhythm: follow {레이아웃} with a premium tech-ad cadence — headline, product, motion graphics, then concise supporting copy — making the poster feel commercially complete and ready for display.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or SamsungOne-style sans serif, bold for headline, medium for subcopy, with crisp Korean readability, tight professional spacing, and clean numeric alignment for date/time and price.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with clean white accents, deep navy shadows, cool silver highlights, and dynamic cyan/violet accent tones for motion trails and CTA buttons.
- Graphic elements: add translucent UI cards, spec chips, small arrow markers, QR-style square, micro icons, and a bottom campaign information band while keeping hierarchy clear.
- Border/shadow: use subtle soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; edges should feel premium and sharply finished, not overly soft.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end studio product photography look, 85mm f/1.8 equivalent for hero separation, with a clean commercial advertising crop.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, controlled fill from right, plus thin rim light to define the product edges, glossy surfaces, hinge details, watch curves, or earbud contours.
- Color grade: Samsung blue, crisp white, cool silver highlights, and restrained dynamic accent tones with high contrast, polished clarity, and realistic reflective gradients.
- Rendering detail: product edges, screen reflections, camera rings, metal frame, speaker holes, buttons, and wearable straps should look physically plausible and premium.

[6. MOOD]
Premium flagship tech campaign — a Samsung Unpacked-style launch visual with dynamic motion, cinematic blue lighting, sharp commercial polish, and realistic retail/event poster information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: “Galaxy”, “삼성 갤럭시”, “{대표 모델명}”.
- 필수 렌더링 문구: “{메인 헤드라인}”, “{한글 부제}”, “출시 일정 {출시 일정}”, “장소 {행사 장소}”, “사전 예약 혜택 {예약 혜택}”, “{웹사이트}”.
- 하단 정보 예시 문구를 자연스럽게 포함: “Galaxy Experience Zone”, “온라인 생중계”, “매장 체험 가능”, “QR로 자세히 보기”.
- Composition invariants: keep a vertical ad-poster hierarchy with a dynamic product hero, large headline, compact event/supporting copy, realistic product detail, and strong motion energy.
- Typography must remain sharp and legible; no broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled typography
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
- Distorted product geometry or impossible device proportions

[INPUT]

- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
{브랜드 톤}의 정제된 프리미엄 제품 광고 포스터. 세로형 1024x1536 소셜 광고, 런칭 캠페인, 온라인 스토어 히어로 배너에 바로 사용할 수 있는 단일 제품 중심의 editorial product ad.
제품의 형태와 소재감을 강하게 보여주면서도 실제 런칭 광고처럼 헤드라인, 기능 포인트, 출시일, 가격, CTA, 판매 채널 정보를 포함한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero product placement: {제품명} / {제품 카테고리·소재}를 프레임 중앙에 배치하고 전체 높이의 약 45–55%를 차지하게 한다. 제품 모서리, 카메라 렌즈, 금속·유리 소재의 반사와 그림자를 현실적으로 표현한다.
- Header zone: 상단 12–15%에는 {핵심 헤드라인}을 크게 배치하고, 바로 아래에 {한글 부제}를 얇은 두께의 한글 서브카피로 정렬한다.
- Feature detail zone: 제품 주변 또는 하단 초입에 작은 rounded spec chips 3개를 배치한다: {핵심 기능 1}, {핵심 기능 2}, {핵심 기능 3}. 각 칩은 1px hairline, 작은 아이콘, 정교한 자간으로 구성한다.
- Commercial information zone: 하단 18–22%에는 {출시 정보}, {가격 정보}, {구매 CTA}, {웹사이트}, {판매 채널}을 실제 광고 하단 고지처럼 정리한다. 작은 QR-style square, legal microcopy, campaign code를 함께 배치한다.
- Background treatment: {배경 질감}을 사용한 smooth studio background. {컬러 팔레트} 기반의 matte finish, 부드러운 tonal transition, 제품 뒤의 은은한 halo light, 얇은 알루미늄 단상 또는 반사면을 허용한다.
- Framing direction: {레이아웃}을 기준으로 대칭형 프리미엄 광고 구도를 유지하되, 실제 제품 런칭 광고에 필요한 정보 레이어와 미세한 그래픽 장식을 자연스럽게 포함한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top headline area: {핵심 헤드라인}을 SF Pro-like sans serif 또는 Pretendard 700–800 weight로 크게 조판한다. {한글 부제}는 300–400 weight로 짧고 선명하게 배치한다.
2. Central hero area: {제품명}을 가장 강한 focal point로 표현한다. {제품 카테고리·소재}의 질감이 보이도록 macro product photography 느낌의 세밀한 edge definition, contact shadow, soft reflection을 적용한다.
3. Feature chips: 제품의 좌우 또는 하단 가까이에 {핵심 기능 1}, {핵심 기능 2}, {핵심 기능 3}을 작고 정교한 정보 태그로 배치한다. 아이콘은 단순한 선형 그래픽, 원형 dot, 작은 battery/camera/chip symbol을 사용한다.
4. Purchase information band: 하단에 {출시 정보}, {가격 정보}, {구매 CTA}를 hierarchy 있게 배치한다. CTA는 작은 pill button 또는 얇은 underline text로 표현한다.
5. Brand and channel details: {웹사이트}, {판매 채널}, {캠페인 코드}, {법적 고지}를 6–9pt 수준의 micro text로 넣어 실제 광고 하단처럼 보이게 한다.
6. Accent control: {컬러 팔레트}의 accent tone을 CTA, 작은 dot, spec chip outline, 제품 halo 중 1–2곳에 사용해 시선을 유도한다.
7. Final balance pass: 제품, 헤드라인, 기능 정보, 구매 정보가 하나의 고급 테크 광고 시스템처럼 연결되도록 spacing, alignment, kerning, shadow depth를 정밀하게 조정한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Helvetica Neue, SF Pro-like sans serif, or Pretendard for Korean. Headline 700–800 weight, subcopy 300–400 weight, commercial info 500–600 weight, legal microcopy 300 weight.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with white #FFFFFF, near-black #111111, soft gray #D9D9D9, brushed aluminum gray #BFC3C7, and one restrained accent tone.
- Graphic system: 1px hairline dividers, rounded spec chips, small dot indicators, QR-style square, subtle CTA pill, precise baseline grid.
- Shadow / reflection: ultra-soft drop shadow, 4px y-offset, 16px blur, 12–18% opacity; add a refined contact reflection where the product meets the surface.
- Text treatment: crisp kerning, disciplined tracking, clean line breaks, premium Apple-ad adjacency, Korean punctuation and spacing rendered naturally.
- Decorative product details: allow faint halo glow, polished metal highlight, glass reflection, tiny interface glint, and material swatch-like accent geometry when it supports the product story.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end studio product photography, 85mm macro or 100mm macro, f/8 to f/11, perfectly controlled sharpness and clean edges.
- Lighting: large softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, faint rim separation, polished studio reflections controlled to reveal glass, aluminum, ceramic, or matte texture.
- Color grade: neutral high-key grade with subtle cool whites, deep blacks, soft gray transitions, and a single restrained accent matching the product signature color.
- Rendering quality: premium product campaign still, precise highlights on curved edges, realistic screen/glass behavior, physically plausible shadow falloff.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Apple keynote campaign still — sleek product-luxury editorial with the disciplined clarity of a 2024–2026 tech launch poster. Quiet confidence, refined materials, launch-day anticipation, and polished commercial realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all Korean strings perfectly, especially “{핵심 헤드라인}”, “{한글 부제}”, “{출시 정보}”, “{가격 정보}”, “{구매 CTA}”, “{판매 채널}”, and “{법적 고지}”. No spacing errors, missing 받침, or broken syllables.
- Composition invariant: {제품명} must remain the clear hero, centered and dominant, while the headline, spec chips, launch details, CTA, and legal line support the product without taking over.
- Typography invariant: the poster must feel like a premium tech advertisement, not a playful sale flyer. Use refined sans serif hierarchy, accurate alignment, and polished micro typography.
- Commercial realism: include the visible ad details “{캠페인 코드}”, “{웹사이트}”, QR-style square, and three feature chips so the final image looks like a finished launch campaign asset.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness blending

[INPUT]

- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean large-mart advertising poster for LOTTE Mart / LOTTE Super, designed as a product-forward promotional layout with family-friendly retail energy. Vertical ad composition suitable for in-store signage, social media promotions, weekly circular flyer use, mobile app banners, and entrance standees.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero product cluster occupies the center 55–60% of the frame, with a clear promotional hierarchy that keeps the event title, sale dates, and price area highly legible.
- Background uses a bright real retail-ad setting with visible supermarket context: softly blurred shelves, aisle signage, shopping basket hints, refrigerated-case highlights, and lively accents in {컬러 팔레트}.
- Arrange copy blocks on a practical flyer grid with energetic retail density: headline, event dates, coupon callouts, product labels, price tags, small disclaimer lines, and footer details all feel like a real Korean hypermarket campaign.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, and {비율} as the customizable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone (upper 15–18%): place the main brand headline in bold Korean display type, with a concise English subtitle beneath it; include a small date label such as “2026.05.01 금 - 05.07 목”, a compact app/event badge “롯데마트GO 동시 진행”, and a short campaign line “이번 주 장보기 특가”.
2) Hero zone (middle 45–55%): arrange the product assortment as a layered supermarket promo cluster, with the most important item front and center, secondary items fanning behind it, and small retail price tags attached to each category. Include realistic items: glossy apples or strawberries, Korean beef or pork pack, milk or ramen multipack, laundry detergent, socks or basic T-shirt pack, and bakery/dessert such as roll cake or macarons.
3) Price / offer zone (lower-middle 18–22%): place a large promotional price block with high contrast, thick numerals, and compact supporting line. Include realistic offer details such as “대표상품 9,900원부터”, “엘포인트 회원가”, “2개 이상 구매 시 추가 할인”, and coupon-sticker shapes in LOTTE red/yellow.
4) Store info zone (bottom 10–15%): add compact retail detail text in a neat footer strip, aligned to the grid and sized smaller than the price block. Include store/channel information like “롯데마트·롯데슈퍼 전 점”, “앱 주문 가능”, “일부 점포 제외”, “행사 상품은 조기 품절될 수 있습니다”, a tiny QR-code placeholder, customer center line, address-style microcopy, and a small barcode/circular-flyer code area.
5) Category balance: ensure fresh food, processed food, clothing, household goods, and dessert references are all represented in a way that feels like a real Korean hypermarket campaign, not a generic collage.
6) Edge treatment: use subtle framing, colored tabs, coupon perforation marks, shelf-label graphics, small arrows, starburst price stickers, and diagonal sale ribbons so the composition feels like a polished advertisement with authentic flyer detail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for subcopy, and a compact sans for store details; price numerals should be oversized, tightly kerned, and supported by smaller Korean unit text.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with strong use of LOTTE red, warm yellow, clean white, and charcoal for hierarchy and legibility; add small blue/green category tags only where useful for product grouping.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity behind hero elements; thin white separators for price and footer areas; use realistic glossy highlights on packaging, plastic wrap, fruit skins, bakery film, detergent bottles, and paper price cards.
- Retail details: include small product/category labels in Korean such as “신선식품”, “가공식품”, “생활용품”, “패션잡화”, “디저트”, plus short price-card notes and membership labels that look printed, not floating.
- Decorative graphic elements: add sale burst shapes, coupon cut lines, small cart icon, L.POINT-style membership tag, app-order badge, shelf-talkers, and subtle confetti dots in brand colors while keeping the product and main price visually dominant.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial advertising look, equivalent to a 50mm full-frame product lens at f/5.6 for the hero cluster, with crisp detail and mild perspective depth.
- Lighting: bright store ambient light with overhead LED panels, softened by diffused fill from the front-left; subtle highlight control to keep packaging, produce, price cards, and Korean text sharp.
- Color grade: vivid retail red-yellow-white with clean neutral whites, slight contrast boost, and minimal warm tint for a polished Korean supermarket promo finish.
- Realism: product surfaces should feel tactile and varied — condensation on chilled packs, transparent plastic wrap on meat, paper texture on coupons, glossy snack packaging, woven texture on clothing basics, and bakery crumbs or cream detail visible in dessert items.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean retail campaign — polished hypermarket flyer aesthetic with a real-world supermarket promotional feel, similar to a mainstream weekly mart ad but cleaner and more premium. The mood should feel busy enough to be believable, with family-friendly savings energy, bright aisle atmosphere, and immediate “이번 주 장보기” urgency.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “롯데마트”, “롯데슈퍼”, “장보기 페스타”, “이번 주 특가”, “엘포인트 회원가”, “2026.05.01 금 - 05.07 목”, “대표상품 9,900원부터”, “앱 주문 가능”, and any Korean product/category labels must render without broken characters.
- Composition must preserve a clear hero product center, prominent price block, readable event dates, and smaller store information footer.
- Maintain the intended balance of fresh food, processed food, clothing, household goods, and dessert cues in the same promotional layout.
- Use realistic small-print retail disclaimer text in Korean, such as “행사 상품은 점포별 재고에 따라 조기 품절될 수 있습니다” and “일부 점포 및 온라인몰 가격은 상이할 수 있습니다”, kept tiny but aligned.
- Keep all typography clean, printed, and aligned to the flyer grid; prices and brand names must be readable at poster scale.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean agricultural supermarket advertisement poster for Hanaro Mart, vertical retail campaign visual with fresh local produce emphasis.
Editorial retail poster designed for social feed, store entrance signage, aisle-end promotion, and local weekly flyer usage, balancing premium grocery appeal with trustworthy farm-direct messaging and realistic retail information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero composition: a full-height produce arrangement occupies the lower 58% of the frame, with a recognizable brand header zone at the top 18% and a practical promotion / price / store-info zone integrated across the lower right and bottom band.
- Subject hierarchy: {제품·소재} is the primary focal point, displayed as abundant, fresh Korean produce in crates, baskets, trays, or neat retail packaging, with secondary farm-origin visual cues such as a small illustrated field horizon, farmer-market tag, Korean map pin, or harvest label behind or beside the hero.
- Background treatment: soft off-white to beige retail poster backdrop with tactile paper-grain texture, subtle printed flyer grain, faint produce silhouettes, small green line graphics, and warm supermarket lighting so the poster feels like a real in-store agricultural campaign.
- Spacing and framing: create a clear scan path from brand title to headline, hero produce, item prices, promotion period, and store contact; allow natural retail details such as price tags, small coupon blocks, divider lines, and shelf-label accents while keeping the product hero dominant.
- Use {브랜드 톤}, {시그니처 결}, {제품·소재}, {무드·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카피·타이포}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as configurable content cues.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): place the main Korean brand title in a strong, highly legible masthead treatment reading “하나로마트”, with a smaller English subline such as “KOREAN LOCAL FRESH MARKET” directly beneath it; add a tiny campaign code like “WEEKLY FRESH VOL.247” and a date label such as “2026년 5월 1주차” near the edge.
2. Main hero area (middle 50–58%): feature {제품·소재} as large, fresh, and abundant, with crisp edges, natural surface detail, believable stems, leaves, moisture, packaging edges, labels, rubber bands, paper wraps, or wooden-crate textures; add a subtle farm-direct visual element such as a small rice-field illustration, harvest truck icon, “국산 농산물” tag, or local origin placard.
3. Supporting message area: integrate short agricultural copy and trust cues near the hero, using compact line spacing and clear hierarchy. Include realistic Korean lines such as “우리 땅에서 온 신선함”, “오늘 들어온 산지직송”, “지역 농가와 함께합니다”, or “가까운 하나로마트에서 만나요”.
4. Price/callout area (lower right or lower left): create a supermarket-realistic price panel with 2–3 item rows and bold won pricing, for example “성주 참외 1봉 ₩7,500”, “완숙 토마토 1팩 ₩5,980”, “햇양파 1망 ₩3,990”; use small shelf-label shapes, green/red accent tabs, and handwritten-style freshness stickers without overpowering the hero.
5. Event and store detail band: add a bottom information strip with promotion period, store/branch placeholder, address/contact line, and a compact QR/coupon-style box. Example readable Korean strings: “행사기간 2026.05.01–05.07”, “매장문의 02-000-0000”, “NH멤버스 추가혜택”, “가까운 매장에서 가격 확인”.
6. Footer balance: use a practical retail anchor at the bottom edge such as a narrow Hanaro-green band, small sponsor/partner area reading “농협과 지역농가가 함께합니다”, tiny social handle “@hanaromart_fresh”, simple divider icons, and a small barcode or QR coupon area to make the poster feel printed and real.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main headline, Pretendard Medium for subcopy, and a clean sans serif for English support text; headline size should dominate the top band while prices use thick retail flyer numerals and captions stay compact but readable.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} should be interpreted as Hanaro Mart green, fresh red accents, warm white, beige paper tones, and natural produce colors; use green as the primary brand anchor and red for price tabs, stickers, or limited-time callouts.
- Retail graphic details: include realistic flyer elements such as thin divider rules, rounded price labels, small origin tags, coupon stamp shapes, farm-icon line art, QR/coupon box, barcode-like strip, and tiny production/credit text such as “사진은 연출된 이미지입니다” and “기획·디자인 하나로마트 신선식품팀”.
- Border/shadow: add a soft drop shadow around hero produce, price labels, stickers, and coupon blocks, about 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with gentle paper-layer depth and no harsh outline.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial food-photography look shot on a full-frame DSLR or medium-format system, equivalent to a 50mm or 85mm lens at f/4 for a natural retail-ad perspective with crisp product separation.
- Lighting: bright store-like ambient light combined with soft diffused key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, plus gentle fill from the front-right to preserve texture on fruits, vegetables, grains, meats, labels, paper tags, and packaging surfaces.
- Color grade: fresh green, clean white, warm beige, and restrained red accent grading with realistic saturation, slightly lifted highlights, natural shadow density, and believable printed-ad texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean grocery campaign — fresh, friendly, practical supermarket editorial with a trustworthy farm-direct retail feel, similar in clarity to modern food advertising seen in high-end grocery flyers, store entrance posters, and seasonal local-produce campaigns.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보이게 해야 하는 문자열: “하나로마트”.
- Korean text accuracy: include several readable Korean retail strings such as “우리 땅에서 온 신선함”, “이번 주 장보기 특가”, “행사기간 2026.05.01–05.07”, “국산 농산물”, “산지직송”, “매장문의 02-000-0000”, and 2–3 realistic item-price labels like “성주 참외 1봉 ₩7,500”.
- Korean text accuracy: if English subcopy is used, keep it clean and properly spelled without broken characters.
- Composition invariants: maintain a tall vertical ad structure with a dominant produce hero, compact brand header, practical supermarket price details, event period, coupon/store-info band, and clear retail hierarchy.
- Product realism: fruits, vegetables, rice, or meat must look fresh, clean, and commercially presentable, with natural proportions, varied textures, believable packaging edges, readable small labels where visible, and authentic Korean grocery-store presentation.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
