- reference_image: {원본 인물}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
4-panel i2i time-travel transformation poster showing the same person across 1970s, 1990s, 2010s, and 2030s. Designed as a horizontal editorial comparison graphic for social sharing, with magazine-style timeline metadata, Korean cover lines, and realistic era-specific environments.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- A 4-cut left-to-right grid fills the full 1536x1024 frame, each panel taking exactly 25% width with consistent gutters and identical portrait crop scale.
- The same identity in {원본 인물} appears in all four panels, centered in each panel with chest-up framing, matching headroom, and the same facial angle.
- Each panel uses {시대 구성} styling logic while keeping {의상헤어}, {배경}, {조명}, and {컬러} clearly differentiated by era.
- Add an editorial header band across the top with the title {포스터 제목}, issue/date text {발행 정보}, and a small magazine code line such as “TIME SHIFT FILE / PERSONA ARCHIVE”.
- Add 2–3 realistic Korean feature headlines around the header or footer: {특집 헤드라인1}, {특집 헤드라인2}, {특집 헤드라인3}.
- Include subtle but visible editorial details: thin vertical dividers, small page/timeline ticks, a tiny barcode-like graphic, creator credit {채널 핸들}, and hashtag line {해시태그}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Panel 1 (1970s, far left): Render {원본 인물} with 1970s disco styling — flared collar or patterned shirt, retro hair volume, warm analog film texture, disco ball reflections, vinyl poster fragments, amber club lights, and a vintage street or dance-floor background.
- Panel 2 (1990s, left-center): Show {원본 인물} with 1990s street styling — loose casual outfit, windbreaker or denim detail, sharper flash contrast, urban wall texture, payphone / arcade sign / graffiti cues, and slightly grainier photo finish.
- Panel 3 (2010s, right-center): Present {원본 인물} in 2010s modern styling — clean fashion-forward outfit, natural polished skin texture, café / studio / city-glass background cues, smartphone-era bokeh lights, and crisp digital clarity.
- Panel 4 (2030s, far right): Transform {원본 인물} into a futuristic 2030s look — sleek technical fabric, subtle wearable-device detail, holographic transit-map glow, smart-city light panels, and advanced cinematic grading.
- Maintain the same face identity, angle, crop, and shoulder position across all four panels so the transformation reads as one person moving through time rather than four different characters.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold or a similar clean Korean sans-serif for labels, 24–30 px for era labels and 38–56 px for the main title; use white, black, or era-contrasting color depending on panel contrast.
- Required era labels should sit inside each panel as realistic editorial captions, paired with a small year marker and optional one-line caption.
- Color palette: use {컬러} as the master grading guide, with era-separated tones such as amber-brown for 1970s, muted urban neutrals for 1990s, clean cool grays for 2010s, and neon-cyan / deep violet accents for 2030s.
- Editorial graphics: add slim dividers, small timeline dots, caption blocks, micro icons for save/share, barcode-style mark, and a footer note with {촬영 위치} and {하단 캡션}.
- Border/shadow: thin divider lines at 1–2 px in soft gray and subtle panel depth; keep the layout flat, readable, and editorial rather than scrapbook-like.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm portrait look, f/2.8, straight-on chest-up framing with consistent facial perspective across all four panels.
- Lighting: era-specific lighting per panel — 1970s warm tungsten club light, 1990s harder side light with flash feel, 2010s clean softbox frontal light, 2030s cinematic neon key with cool rim light.
- Color grade: 1970s sepia-amber film, 1990s slightly desaturated urban tones, 2010s neutral digital clarity, 2030s cool sci-fi grade with cyan-magenta contrast.
- Surface realism: preserve pores, hair strands, fabric weave, era-specific accessories, ambient reflections, and realistic print-poster texture.

[6. MOOD]
High-concept transformation editorial — like a modern magazine “then-to-now-to-next” spread with precise era progression, cinematic pop-culture styling, and playful social-media readability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear correctly as panel labels: “1970s 디스코”, “1990s 스트릿”, “2010s 모던”, “2030s 미래”.
- The header must include: “{포스터 제목}”, “{발행 정보}”, “{특집 헤드라인1}”, “{특집 헤드라인2}”, “{특집 헤드라인3}”.
- Add small readable Korean metadata: “촬영지: {촬영 위치}”, “크리에이터: {채널 핸들}”, “{해시태그}”, “{하단 캡션}”.
- The same person identity from {원본 인물} must remain consistent across all 4 panels.
- All 4 panels must have the same composition scale and chest-up framing.
- Keep the era progression visually obvious through styling, background objects, typography, lighting, and color grading.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or impersonation
- Face identity drift between panels
